# Dust Devil

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Id | `dust-devil` |
| Rarity | Common (bone ink `#cfc8b6`), 4 levels |
| Kind | Triggered power (no key) |
| Trigger | `jump` (new): the holder jumps off the ground with an enemy close by |
| Origin | New |

## Card

**Jump: a dust whirl cuts around you.** (7 words, 35 chars)

- Icon (48×48 line drawing): a small figure rising over a ground line, an open spiral wound round its feet with three short straight cut strokes inside the spiral.
- Hover loop (1.4 s): a figure crouches (0.2 s) and leaps (0.2 s), a spiral of dust winds up round its feet with short cut lines flicking in it (0.4 s); hold, fade.

## Idea

Leaving the ground near the boss kicks up a cutting whirl of dust: jumping in becomes an attack. The jump is the move players forget they have; this gives it a reason close in (jump a sweep, jump into a jump attack) and a look that sells the leap.

## Data

```js
{ id: 'dust-devil', name: 'Dust Devil', rarity: 'common',
  text: 'Jump: a dust whirl cuts around you.',
  power: { when: 'jump', then: 'whirl' },
  levels: [
    { damage: 10, cooldown: 2 },
    { damage: 13, cooldown: 2 },
    { damage: 16, cooldown: 2 },
    { damage: 19, cooldown: 2 },
  ] },
```

Numbers: two thirds of a light hit, to every enemy in reach. Jumps near the boss 4-10 a fight (the 2 s cooldown stops hopping on the spot from paying): about 40-100 more at level I and 75-190 at level IV, the low end of the effect commons for a player who rarely jumps, the middle for one who does. It hits all enemies in reach, so it is worth more against pairs.

## Engine work

- New `when: 'jump'`: fired as the holder leaves the ground by jumping (`Player` sets `PS.JUMP`, js/player.js), only when a live enemy's body is within `CONFIG.abilities.commons.whirlRadius` (2.4 m); otherwise nothing fires and no cooldown is spent. `ctx`: `{ x, y, z }` (the take-off point), `enemy` the nearest.
- New `then: 'whirl'`: `damage` to every live enemy whose body is within `whirlRadius` of the take-off point and `CONFIG.height.reach` of its height (the `blast` case in `fire`, with the config radius). `ABILITY_POWERS['jump/whirl'] = ['damage', 'cooldown']`. Not in `ON_ENEMY` (it needs a place, not an enemy).
- Shared by the effect commons: the validate.js kind rule and the camera-feel.js common skip (see Spark Step).

## Multiplayer

A person's jump is theirs, so `jump` joins `ABILITY_CLAIMS`: the browser claims it with the take-off point; the server checks the player's pose was jumping (or airborne) within the last 0.3 s and the point within 1.5 m of their recent poses, then resolves the whirl round that point. It hits enemies only; a teammate in the whirl sees it pass round them. Everyone sees the whirl.

## Effect

Layered, timed from the take-off (t = 0), anchored to the take-off point (it stays on the ground as the player rises):

| t | Layer | Look | Colour |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0.00 | Whirl | A short open spiral of dust round the take-off point (one pooled spiral band, 2.4 m wide at its top, 1.2 m tall), flat two-tone dust texture with dark ink edges | `#8c877b` body, `#4a4740` shade, `#cfc8b6` leading edge, `#16130f` ink edge |
| 0.00-0.35 | Spin | It winds up and turns one and a half turns, widening to `whirlRadius` | as above |
| 0.05-0.30 | Cuts | 4 hard bone-white cut lines flick inside the spiral (straight thin strokes, 0.8 m, each 0.08 s), spaced round it | `#f4f1e8` core, `#cfc8b6` edge |
| 0.10-0.45 | Grit | 14 dust grains as short streaks thrown outward and down | `#8c877b`, `#4a4740` |
| 0.30-0.55 | Settle | The spiral thins from the top and fades | to transparent |

Budget (Common class): 2 pooled meshes (the spiral band, the cut-line set), 14 particles (8 on Normal), no light, no ribbon, no impact frame. Peak 0.35 s. Reduced motion: the spiral fades in place without turning; the cuts stay as drawn.

## Sound

`abilityWhirl` (new, in `js/data/audio.js`): a gritty scrape transient (noise band-passed at 2 kHz, 20 ms), a body of a short spinning whoosh (noise band-passed at 400-900 Hz with a 12 Hz swell in its level, 0.35 s), no tail. Under the jump's own sound, vel 0.5.

## Camera

No camera kick: commons never take one.

## Images

- `img/dust-devil-1.webp`: the swordsman leaping upward from the arena floor, a spiral whirl of dust with sharp white cut lines spinning around their feet.

pool.md:
# Counterstep

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Id | `counterstep` |
| Rarity | Rare (cool blue `#8fb8dc`), 3 levels |
| Kind | Triggered (no key) |
| Trigger | `dodge`: a perfect dodge (a boss blow meets the dash's untouchable first frames) |
| Origin | Kept from js/data/abilities.js: was `dodge/riposte` (a perfect dodge opens a riposte, which the base game now does since pass 95); now `dodge/flashBehind`, with a shorter `window` and a `cooldown` |

## Card

**Perfect dodge: flash-step behind the boss.** (6 words, 42 chars)

- Icon (48×48 line drawing): a curved arrow hooking round a small circle (the boss), with three short ghost strokes along the arrow's tail.
- Hover loop (1.4 s): a small figure dashes through a falling blow (0.4 s), streaks round the boss in a blue arc with three fading ghost figures (0.25 s), lands behind it inside a blue ring and holds (0.5 s); fade.

## Idea

The perfect dodge already opens a counter. Counterstep makes that counter land from the best angle: the instant the dodge reads, you flash round the boss and stand at its back, facing it, with a slightly longer counter window. A shield-bearing boss can no longer turn the counter on its shield, and the step itself reads as the anime flash step the game is built on. It never fires on a plain dash, only on the skill.

## Data

```js
{ id: 'counterstep', name: 'Counterstep', rarity: 'rare',
  text: 'Perfect dodge: flash-step behind the boss.',
  perk: { when: 'dodge', then: 'flashBehind' },
  levels: [
    { window: 1, cooldown: 3 },
    { window: 1.2, cooldown: 2.5 },
    { window: 1.4, cooldown: 2 },
  ] },
```

Numbers: `window` replaces the counter window the perfect dodge opens (CONFIG.player.counterTime, 0.8 s) with 1-1.4 s, so the counter still fits after the 0.12 s step. `cooldown` keeps it from chaining on a boss's multi-hit combo: one step per 2-3 s, and a second perfect dodge inside the cooldown opens the plain counter. No damage of its own: its worth is position (every counter from behind, never into a shield) and the extra 0.2-0.6 s to land it.

## Engine work

- New perk `dodge/flashBehind`: ['window', 'cooldown'] in ABILITY_PERKS, replacing `dodge/riposte`. It runs on the body's owner (the browser for a person, the server for a bot) when the `dodge` event fires: if the attacker is within CONFIG.abilities.flashBehind.range (6 m) and its back is on walkable floor, the player moves to `radius + gap` (gap 1.2 m) behind the attacker's facing over 0.12 s, untouchable, turned to face it, and the open counter's time is set to `window`. If the spot behind is a wall, a pit or out of the arena, no step: the plain counter opens and no cooldown is spent.
- The step checks the floor the same way a dash does (the player's own collision and fall checks), so it can never put the player inside geometry.
- Perk clock `step` (s until it may step again) in abilityPerkState and abilityClocks.
- `validate.js`: CONFIG.abilities.flashBehind { range above 0, gap above 0, time above 0 }.

## Multiplayer

The player's movement is their own: the browser moves them and the server sees the new position as it sees a dash. The server's range checks on the counter that follows use that position, as for any blow. The step only moves its holder: it never passes through, pushes or swaps with a teammate (a teammate standing on the spot behind the boss shifts the landing up to 1 m sideways, else no step).

## Effect

Layered, timed from the perfect dodge (t = 0):

| t | Layer | Look | Colour |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0.00 | Streak | A flat ink-edged blue ribbon from the dodge point curving round the boss to the landing point | `#8fb8dc` edge, `#f2f6fa` core, `#0e1218` ink |
| 0.00-0.12 | Afterimages | 3 flat-shaded silhouettes of the player's pose, left at 0.04 s steps along the curve, each fading over 0.35 s | `#8fb8dc` fill, `#0e1218` ink rim |
| 0.12 | Landing ring | A hard-edged ring on the floor round the player's feet, growing 0.6 to 1.5 m | `#8fb8dc` to transparent |
| 0.12-0.40 | Flakes | 10 sharp blue flakes kicked out of the ring | `#f2f6fa` |

Budget (Rare class): 5 pooled meshes (3 afterimage silhouettes, 1 ring, the ribbon's mesh) + 10 particles (6 on Normal), no effect light, 1 ribbon, no impact frame. Peak 0.4 s. Reduced motion: the afterimages hold still and fade without trailing.

## Sound

`abilityStep` (kept, in `js/data/audio.js`): the swish and high chime, retimed so the chime lands at the landing (t = 0.12). A transient of a sharp cloth snap (filtered noise 3-5 kHz, 20 ms) added at t = 0 for the step itself.

## Camera

No camera kick and no turn: the perfect dodge and the counter already have theirs, and the camera stays the player's (with a lock on, it follows the step as it follows any move). The perk's shared `perkFov` (-0.9) plays at the landing; no `powers` entry.

## Images

- `img/counterstep-1.webp`: the swordsman flash-stepping from in front of a boss to behind it in a blue blur, three fading afterimages along a curved path, a blue ring at the landing.

# Vengeance

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Id | `vengeance` |
| Rarity | Rare (cool blue `#8fb8dc`), 3 levels |
| Kind | Triggered (no key) |
| Trigger | `hurt`: you lose health to any blow, burn or fall |
| Origin | Kept from js/data/abilities.js: the same perk, text and numbers; new look and sound |

## Card

**Get hit: next hit in {window} does {damage} more.** (9 words, 35 chars)

- Icon (48×48 line drawing): a blade pointing up with a jagged crack across its middle and two short flame tongues rising off the crack.
- Hover loop (1.6 s): a small figure takes a blow and staggers (0.3 s), blue-black flame climbs its blade (0.4 s), it lunges and the hit lands with a blue star (0.3 s); hold, fade.

## Idea

Getting hit stops being only a loss: for three seconds the blade carries cold fury, and the answer you throw at once hits much harder. It turns the moment after a mistake into a choice, back off and drink, or trade back right now.

## Data

```js
{ id: 'vengeance', name: 'Vengeance', rarity: 'rare',
  text: 'Get hit: next hit in {window} does {damage} more.',
  perk: { when: 'hurt', then: 'empower' },
  levels: [
    { window: 3, damage: 0.3 },
    { window: 3, damage: 0.4 },
    { window: 3, damage: 0.5 },
  ] },
```

Numbers: one empowered blow per blow taken. A player new to the genre takes 8-15 blows a fight; about half get answered inside 3 s, so 4-8 empowered blows of about 20-35 damage each: +25-90 damage a fight at levels I-III, more on a heavy. A comeback perk, kept small because it pays for being hit.

## Engine work

- None for the rule: `hurt/empower` exists (abilityHurt arms `vengeance`, abilityStrike spends it).
- New: the armed state is drawn. The `abilityPerk` event gets `perk: 'hurt/armed'` when the window opens (abilityHurt) and the existing `empower` when it is spent; js/ability-fx.js draws the blade flame while `perk.vengeance > 0` on the local player's body, reading the clock each frame (no allocation).

## Multiplayer

The perk runs where the blow is settled: health is the client's own, so the browser arms the window; the blow's extra damage is applied by the owner of the enemies (abilityStrike on the server), which keeps its own perk clocks from the claims it accepted. Only the holder's own blows are raised; nothing reaches a teammate.

## Effect

Layered, timed from the blow taken (t = 0):

| t | Layer | Look | Colour |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0.10-3.00 | Blade flame | A flat sheath of hard-edged flame tongues along the blade, blue-black body with a blue outer edge, licking up toward the tip; dims over the last 0.5 s of the window | `#1a2a3c` body, `#8fb8dc` edge, `#0e1218` ink |
| 0.10-0.30 | Eye glint | A small blue glint under the hood, once | `#cfe2f2` |
| 0.10-3.00 | Embers | 2 sharp blue flakes a second shed off the blade tip | `#8fb8dc` |
| hit | Answer | A hard-edged blue impact star at the hit point, 1.2 m, with 12 shard streaks thrown out | `#f2f6fa` core, `#8fb8dc` edge |

Budget (Rare class): 3 pooled meshes (blade sheath, glint, impact star) + 6 ember flakes and 12 shards (10 on Normal), 1 effect light (blue, 0.2 s at the answering hit, × 0.65 on Normal), no ribbon, no impact frame (the pool's look names one; a rare gets the impact star at the hit instead). Peak 0.15 s. Reduced motion: no change needed (no flash).

## Sound

`abilityEmpower` (kept) plays on the answering hit. New `abilityFury` when the window opens: a low cold whoosh of flame catching (band-passed noise 300-900 Hz, 0.25 s), a soft breath tail (0.3 s), under the hurt sound.

## Camera

No new kick: the hurt push and the hit punch already move the view. The shared `perkFov` (-0.9) plays on the answering hit; no `powers` entry.

## Images

- `img/vengeance-1.webp`: a wounded swordsman rising from a hit, blue-black flame crawling up the blade, eyes glinting blue, ready to strike back.

pool.md:
# Bloodthirst

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Id | `bloodthirst` |
| Rarity | Rare (cool blue `#8fb8dc`), 3 levels |
| Kind | Triggered (no key) |
| Trigger | `streak`: `hits` of your blows land in a row without you losing health |
| Origin | Kept from js/data/abilities.js: the same perk, text and numbers; each blow of the streak is now shown |

## Card

**{hits} hits unhurt: heal {heal}.** (5 words, 22 chars)

- Icon (48×48 line drawing): five small dots in an arc curling inward into a heart-shaped drop.
- Hover loop (1.8 s): a small figure hits a boss five times (one blue dot pops off per hit, 0.15 s apart, 0.8 s), the five dots spiral into the figure (0.4 s), a soft blue ring at its feet; hold, fade.

## Idea

A clean streak drinks back health: the reward for playing well rather than for a flask. Each blow of the streak shows its mote, so the player can see the count and play for the fifth hit, and a blow taken scatters the motes and resets it.

## Data

```js
{ id: 'bloodthirst', name: 'Bloodthirst', rarity: 'rare',
  text: '{hits} hits unhurt: heal {heal}.',
  perk: { when: 'streak', then: 'heal' },
  levels: [
    { hits: 5, heal: 0.08 },
    { hits: 5, heal: 0.11 },
    { hits: 5, heal: 0.14 },
  ] },
```

Numbers: a good player lands 40-80 blows a fight with 6-12 clean streaks of five, healing 50-100% of the bar at level I and up to 1.7 bars at level III over a whole fight, but only while not being hit: the heal follows good play and never saves a bad stretch. A flask heals about 40%.

## Engine work

- None for the rule: `streak/heal` exists (abilityLanded).
- New event for the count: abilityLanded emits `abilityPerk` with `perk: 'streak/step'` and `n` (1 to `hits` - 1) for each blow of the streak, and abilityHurt emits `perk: 'streak/lost'` when it resets a streak above 0. js/ability-fx.js keeps the motes on 5 pooled meshes.

## Multiplayer

Health is the client's own: the browser counts the streak and heals its own body. Only the holder heals; nothing reaches a teammate.

## Effect

Layered, timed from each landed blow of the streak (t = 0):

| t | Layer | Look | Colour |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0.00 | Mote | A hard-edged diamond mote torn off the hit point, a blue shell with a thin red thread in its core, flying to orbit the player's chest at 0.6 m | `#8fb8dc` shell, `#a8303a` thread, `#0e1218` ink |
| last hit, 0.00-0.40 | Spiral | All motes spiral inward into the chest and vanish | as above |
| last hit, 0.35 | Ring | A soft-edged heal ring at the feet, 0.5 to 1.6 m | `#8fb8dc` to transparent |
| reset | Scatter | Held motes fall to the floor and fade over 0.3 s | `#8fb8dc` |

## Card

**Below {below} health: endless dashes.** (5 words, 31 chars)

- Icon (48×48 line drawing): a running foot with three trailing ghost outlines and a small breath puff ahead of it.
- Hover loop (1.8 s): a small figure's health bar drops red (0.3 s), the figure dashes four times in a row round a boss, each dash leaving a chain of blue ghosts (1.2 s); fade.

## Idea

Near death the dash stops costing. The comeback is all footwork: dash through every blow, drink when the boss commits, and walk back out of the low band. It gives new players a second chance without healing them.

## Data

```js
{ id: 'last-breath', name: 'Last Breath', rarity: 'rare',
  text: 'Below {below} health: endless dashes.',

  levels: [
    { below: 0.25 },
    { below: 0.3 },
    { below: 0.35 },
  ] },
```

Numbers: the player has 3 dash charges refilling over 1.3 s each; endless dashes in the low band mean no lost blow for want of a charge. The band widens from a quarter to over a third of the bar. It deals nothing and heals nothing, so it can't carry a run alone.

- None for the rule: `low/freeDash` exists.
- New: the state is drawn. js/ability-fx.js reads the local player's health against `below` each frame and draws the breath and the afterimage chain on each dash while it holds (no event needed; no allocation).

## Multiplayer

The dash is the client's own movement; the server sees it as any dash. Only the holder's dashes are free; nothing reaches a teammate.

| | |

| Origin | Kept from js/data/abilities.js: was `open/damage` (an off-balance boss) at 30/40/50%; now `cracked/damage` at 25/35/45%, with the new text |

## Card

**Cracked guard: your hits do {damage} more.** (7 words, 35 chars)

- Icon (48×48 line drawing): a round shield with a forked crack, two short splinter strokes flying off the crack.
- Hover loop (1.6 s): a small figure lands a counter and a crack opens on the boss's guard (0.4 s), the crack lights blue, the figure hits twice and blue splinters fly off each hit (0.8 s); fade.

## Idea

A counter cracks the boss's guard, and two cracks open the Finishing Blow. Opportunist makes the time between the first crack and the Finishing Blow the moment to press: while a crack shows, every blow does more. It ties the perk to the game's own loop (counter, press, finish) instead of the old, hard-to-read "off balance" states.

## Data

```js
{ id: 'opportunist', name: 'Opportunist', rarity: 'rare',
  text: 'Cracked guard: your hits do {damage} more.',
  perk: { when: 'cracked', then: 'damage' },
  levels: [
    { damage: 0.25 },
    { damage: 0.35 },
    { damage: 0.45 },
  ] },
```

Numbers: a crack lasts up to CONFIG.finisher.fade (10 s) and a boss shows one for perhaps a third of a fight once the player counters well. A third of a player's 600-1200 blow damage a fight, raised 25-45%: about +50-180 a fight. Slightly lower than the old 30-50% because cracks show more often and longer than the old off-balance states.

## Engine work

- New perk `cracked/damage`: ['damage'] in ABILITY_PERKS, replacing `open/damage`. abilityStrike adds `damage` when `e.cracks > 0`. ABILITY_OPEN and abilityOpen go if nothing else uses them.
- js/ability-fx.js: while the local player holds it, an enemy with cracks gets the crack glow tinted blue (enemy tint `CRACK_COLOR` stays for everyone else), and each of the holder's blows on it throws the splinter burst.

## Multiplayer

Cracks live on the shared enemy, which the server owns; abilityStrike runs there and reads `e.cracks` from its own enemy. The cracks are everyone's (any teammate's counter cracks the guard), but only the holder's blows are raised. The blue crack tint is drawn only on the holder's screen.

## Effect

Layered, timed from each of the holder's blows on a cracked enemy (t = 0):

| t | Layer | Look | Colour |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| while cracked | Crack glow | The existing guard-crack glow drawn blue instead of amber on the holder's screen, a slow 0.8 s pulse (well under 3 Hz) | `#8fb8dc`, `#f2f6fa` core |
| 0.00-0.30 | Splinters | 8 hard-edged blue shards thrown from the hit point, tumbling and falling | `#8fb8dc` edge, `#f2f6fa` face, `#0e1218` ink |
| 0.00-0.12 | Chip | A small flat crack-shaped flash on the hit point, 0.5 m | `#f2f6fa` |

Budget (Rare class): 1 pooled mesh (the chip) + 8 shards a blow (5 on Normal), no effect light, no ribbon, no impact frame. Peak 0.12 s. Reduced motion: the crack glow holds steady instead of pulsing.

## Sound

New `abilitySplinter` on each raised blow, over the hit sound: a dry crack of stone (white noise high-passed at 3 kHz, 25 ms, driven) and a short glassy ring (sine 880 Hz with a 2.4 partial, 0.2 s).

## Camera

No camera kick: blows already punch the view, and a kick per blow would be noise. No `powers` entry.

## Images

- `img/opportunist-1.webp`: an armoured boss whose guard is covered in glowing blue cracks, the swordsman hammering hits into it with blue splinters flying.

# Stone Guardian

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Id | `stone-guardian` |
| Rarity | Rare (cool blue `#8fb8dc`), 3 levels |

| Trigger | `low`: your health drops to or under `below` (a third) of the bar; once a fight |

## Card

**Low health: a guardian holds the boss for {draw}.** (9 words, 44 chars)

- Icon (48×48 line drawing): a tall rectangular tower shield rising out of a broken floor line, two short rune strokes on its face.
- Hover loop (2.0 s): a small figure's health bar drops red (0.3 s), the floor cracks and a stone figure with a tower shield breaks up between the figure and the boss (0.6 s), it slams the shield forward and the boss turns to it (0.5 s), the small figure drinks behind it (0.4 s); fade.

## Idea

Once a fight, nearly down, a guardian of stone rises between you and the boss and takes its attention: the breather to drink. It's the safety net that lets a friend new to the genre survive their first bad stretch, and it hits back with its shield while it holds.

## Data

```js
{ id: 'stone-guardian', name: 'Stone Guardian', rarity: 'rare',
  text: 'Low health: a guardian holds the boss for {draw}.',
  power: { when: 'low', then: 'guardian', once: true },
  levels: [
    { below: 0.33, time: 9, every: 2, damage: 14, draw: 4 },
    { below: 0.33, time: 11, every: 1.8, damage: 18, draw: 5 },
    { below: 0.33, time: 13, every: 1.6, damage: 22, draw: 6 },
  ] },
```

Numbers: `draw` (4-6 s) is the breather: long enough to back off and drink one flask (about 1.5 s) with time to spare. The guardian stays `time` s, bashing every `every` s: 4-8 bashes of 14-22, about 60-180 damage, so its worth is the held boss, not the damage. Once a fight keeps it a safety net.

## Engine work

- None for the rule: `low/guardian` exists (a summon in abilityPowers, CONFIG.abilities.summons.guardian, drawn by js/summon-figures.js).
- The moves change with the model: CONFIG.VISUALS.abilityFx.guardian.moves become a Shield Bash and a Shield Slam (key poses in js/data/attack-poses.js), and its `cry` (drawing the boss's eye) becomes the braced shield strike below.
- Model: its own Blender model, `tools/blender/guardian.py` (pass 78's model, rebuilt; same game rig at scale 1, rigid parts named `guardian:<bone>__<slot>`, slots `stone`, `worn` and `rune`), built with `run_asset.py` and packed to `js/baked/` by `node tools/pack-baked.cjs`. A hulking tomb guardian of cut stone, about 2.4 m tall in the game (scale 1.37) and 1.4 m across the shoulders: a deep stone hood with two slits of blue light, squared block shoulders, a broad faceted chest split by a glowing seam, thick stone drums for arms and legs bound by rings of light, and a tower shield about 1.8 m tall and 0.9 m wide carved with a ring-cross, blue runes cut into its seams. No sword: the shield is its weapon. About 3,000 triangles. Its 3 animations, as key poses on the game rig:
  - Rise (0.9 s): crouched under the floor, it pushes up through the slabs shield first and straightens.
  - Shield Bash (0.5 s wind-up, 0.12 s strike, 0.55 s recovery): the shield drawn back on its left arm, then driven forward from the shoulder.
  - Brace (its `cry`, 1.2 s): the shield planted in the floor with a ringing strike of the fist on its face, as it draws the boss's eye.

## Multiplayer

As today: the server owns the summon. It draws only the boss it rises beside, only between that boss's attacks, and never blocks, pushes or stands in for a teammate; teammates walk through it. Every browser draws it.

Layered, timed from the call (t = 0):

| t | Layer | Look | Colour |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

| while out | Runes | Blue light in its seams, eye slits and joint rings, a slow 1 s pulse | `#8fb8dc`, `#e8f6ff` core |
| each bash | Bash | A flat blue shock ring off the shield face at the hit, 1.6 m, and 8 shards | `#8fb8dc` edge, `#f2f6fa` core |
| draw | Brace | A ring of blue light spreading from the planted shield across the floor, 3 m | `#8fb8dc` to transparent |
| end, 0.90 s | Crumble | It sinks back into the floor as dust, runes fading last | `#6e6a62`, `#8fb8dc` |

Budget (Rare summon class): the model + 3 pooled meshes (crack decal, shock ring, brace ring) + up to 34 particles (19 on Normal), 1 effect light while it bashes (blue, 0.25 s, × 0.65 on Normal), no ribbon, no impact frame. Its time is `time`. Reduced motion: the rune pulse holds steady; the bash shake goes.

## Sound

Kept: `abilityGuardian` (the stone grinding up and the deep thud as it stands), `abilityBash` per bash, `abilityChallenge` on the draw, its horn-like call now a struck shield of stone (brown noise thump at 200 Hz under the ring).

pool.md:
# Static Edge

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Id | `static-edge` |
| Rarity | Rare (cool blue `#8fb8dc`), 3 levels |
| Kind | Triggered (no key) |
| Trigger | `hits`: every `hits`th blow of yours that lands (unblocked) |
| Origin | Kept from js/data/abilities.js: the same power, text and numbers; the bolt now jumps from the blade instead of falling from above, and the count shows on the blade |

## Card

**Every {hits}th hit: a spark strikes the boss.** (8 words, 40 chars)

- Icon (48×48 line drawing): a blade with three short zigzag ticks along its edge and a zigzag bolt leaving its tip.
- Hover loop (1.6 s): a small figure hits a boss four times, the blade gaining one blue crackle each hit (0.8 s), the fifth hit throws a short zigzag bolt into the boss with a star (0.3 s); fade.

## Idea

The blade gathers static as it hits. The crackle on the edge grows with each blow, so the player sees the bolt coming, and every few hits a short hard bolt jumps to the boss. A plain, steady reward for keeping up pressure.

## Data

```js
{ id: 'static-edge', name: 'Static Edge', rarity: 'rare',
  text: 'Every {hits}th hit: a spark strikes the boss.',
  power: { when: 'hits', then: 'spark' },
  levels: [
    { hits: 5, damage: 30 },
    { hits: 4, damage: 34 },
    { hits: 4, damage: 44 },
  ] },
```

Numbers: 6 extra damage a blow at level I (30 / 5), 8.5 at II, 11 at III, about +40-70% on a light hit. A player landing 50-80 blows a fight adds 300-880. A strong rare, but it asks for blows that land, and its own sparks never count toward the next.

## Engine work

- None for the rule: `hits/spark` exists.
- New: the count is shown. The engine's count lives in abilityPowers (`counts`), where the enemies are owned; the browser keeps its own count of its holder's landed blows for the look only (js/ability-fx.js reads it), reset on each `spark` event. The bolt is drawn from the holder's blade tip to the enemy's chest (CONFIG.VISUALS.abilityFx `spark`: `from: 'blade'` in place of `height`).

## Multiplayer

The server counts the holder's landed blows and resolves the spark on the shared enemy (as today); enemies only. The browser's crackle count is only a look and is set right by each spark event.

## Effect

Layered, timed from the spark (t = 0):

| t | Layer | Look | Colour |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| each blow | Crackle | One more short jagged line crawling on the blade (1 to `hits` - 1), flickering at 2 Hz | `#8fb8dc`, `#f2f6fa` core |
| 0.00-0.12 | Bolt | A short hard zigzag bolt from the blade tip to the boss, 2-tone, ink edge | `#f2f6fa` core, `#8fb8dc` edge, `#0e1218` ink |
| 0.02-0.20 | Star | A four-pointed impact star on the boss, 0.9 m | `#f2f6fa`, `#8fb8dc` |
| 0.02-0.30 | Sparks | 10 hard spark streaks off the star | `#cfe2f2` |

Budget (Rare class): 3 pooled meshes (blade crackle, bolt, star) + 10 particles (6 on Normal), 1 effect light (blue-white, 0.15 s, × 0.65 on Normal), no ribbon, no impact frame. Peak 0.2 s. Reduced motion: the crackle holds still instead of flickering.

## Sound

`abilitySpark` (kept): the sharp electric snap and crackle. A faint rising crackle tick (noise 5 kHz, 20 ms, one step higher per blow) as the count builds.

## Camera

Kept: `CONFIG.camera.feel.powers.spark = [-0.8, 0.02]`.

## Images

- `img/static-edge-1.webp`: blue static crawling along a sword in mid-combo, a short jagged bolt leaping from the blade into the boss with a star-shaped impact.

# Grave Feast

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Id | `grave-feast` |
| Rarity | Rare (cool blue `#8fb8dc`), 3 levels; a crate reward |
| Kind | Triggered (no key) |
| Trigger | `finisher`: your Finishing Blow lands (its cut lines open) |
| Origin | Kept from js/data/abilities.js: the same perk, text, numbers and crate; the heal is drawn from the cut lines |

## Card

**Finishing Blow: heal {heal}.** (4 words, 23 chars)

- Icon (48×48 line drawing): three crossing cut lines with a thin stream curling off them into a drop.
- Hover loop (1.8 s): a small figure flashes through a boss leaving three white cut lines (0.5 s), the lines open and blue light streams from each back into the figure (0.6 s), a soft ring at its feet; fade.

## Idea

A crate reward: the Finishing Blow heals big. The boss's cut lines bleed blue light back into you, so the moment of the fight that already feels best also turns it around.

## Data

```js
{ id: 'grave-feast', name: 'Grave Feast', rarity: 'rare', crate: true,
  text: 'Finishing Blow: heal {heal}.',
  perk: { when: 'finisher', then: 'heal' },
  levels: [
    { heal: 0.25 },
    { heal: 0.35 },
    { heal: 0.45 },
  ] },
```

Numbers: 2-4 Finishing Blows a fight, each worth half a flask to a full one (a flask is about 40%). Big, but every heal is earned by two counters and the Finishing Blow, so it follows skill.

## Engine work

- None for the rule: `finisher/heal` exists (its cue is `execute/heal` in js/ability-fx.js and js/audio.js; rename it `finisher/heal` with the perk).
- New look: the heal cue reads the Finishing Blow's cut lines (js/finisher.js keeps their ends) and sends one stream from each line's middle to the player's chest.

## Multiplayer

The heal is the client's own (health is the player's). The Finishing Blow itself is checked by the server as today. Only the holder heals.

## Effect

Layered, timed from the cut lines opening (t = 0):

| t | Layer | Look | Colour |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0.00-0.50 | Streams | One flat ribbon of blue light from each cut line's middle, curving into the player's chest, its head a hard white droplet | `#8fb8dc` edge, `#f2f6fa` head, `#0e1218` ink |
| 0.40-0.80 | Fill | 20 small hard flakes rising round the player | `#cfe2f2` |
| 0.45 | Ring | A soft-edged heal ring at the feet, 0.5 to 2 m | `#8fb8dc` to transparent |

Budget (Rare class): 4 pooled meshes (3 stream heads, 1 ring) + 20 particles (11 on Normal), 1 effect light (blue, 0.4 s, × 0.65 on Normal), 1 ribbon (the streams share one ribbon of 3 strands), no impact frame (the Finishing Blow keeps its own frozen frame). Peak 0.8 s. Reduced motion: no change needed (no flash).

## Sound

`abilityHeal` (kept, pitch 0.8): the soft rising chord, started as the streams reach the chest (t = 0.45), with a low breath of air (pink noise 300-800 Hz, 0.4 s) as the streams draw out.

## Camera

No camera kick: the Finishing Blow already has its own camera moment. No `powers` entry.

## Images

- `img/grave-feast-1.webp`: the cut lines of a multi-cut finishing blow on a boss bleeding streams of blue light that flow back into the swordsman.

pool.md:
# Riptide

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Id | `riptide` |
| Rarity | Rare (cool blue `#8fb8dc`), 3 levels |
| Kind | Triggered (no key) |
| Trigger | `counter`: a counter lands (the hit in the window after a perfect dodge or a last-blow deflect) |
| Origin | New |

## Card

**Counter: a wave follows the cut.** (6 words, 32 chars)

- Icon (48×48 line drawing): a curved blade stroke with a wave crest curling off its end.
- Hover loop (1.6 s): a small figure sidesteps a falling blow (the perfect dodge, 0.4 s), swings back (0.2 s), and a blue crest rolls off the end of the swing and runs across the card (0.6 s); hold, fade.

## Idea

The counter is the skill the whole fight turns on. Riptide makes it reach: the cut drags a wave of water through its arc and on for eight metres, so a counter landed on one boss also hits the second boss behind it, and a counter thrown from the edge of the window still connects. It rewards the players who learned the counter with a spectacle that grows with their skill, and it never fires on its own.

## Data

```js
{ id: 'riptide', name: 'Riptide', rarity: 'rare',
  text: 'Counter: a wave follows the cut.',
  power: { when: 'counter', then: 'wave' },
  levels: [
    { damage: 40, reach: 8, width: 2 },
    { damage: 55, reach: 9, width: 2.2 },
    { damage: 70, reach: 10, width: 2.4 },
  ] },
```

Numbers: a counter does about 2.6× a light hit (about 42); level I adds about one more counter's worth. Counters land 4-8 times a fight, so about 160-560 damage a fight at levels I-III against bosses of 1600-3500 health: a solid rare, below a legendary.

## Engine work

- New power `when: 'counter'` already exists (Pyre uses it). New `then: 'wave'`: a line hit from the player along the counter's swing direction, `reach` long and `width` wide either side, once per enemy. The same `wave` resolver serves Tidal Arc (key 1), so build them in the same pass.
- `validate.js`: `wave` needs `damage`, `reach`, `width`.

## Multiplayer

The server resolves the wave from the client's counter claim (it already range-checks counters): it hits enemies only, never teammates; a teammate standing in the line sees the wave pass through them. No shared effect.

## Effect

Layered, timed from the counter's hit frame (t = 0):

| t | Layer | Look | Colour |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0.00 | Crest | A flat crescent of water mesh following the blade's arc, swept from the hilt, 2-tone (deep blue body, white foam claws on the leading edge), dark ink outline | `#2c5f8a` body, `#8fb8dc` edge, `#f2f6fa` foam |
| 0.05-0.40 | Run | The crest leaves the blade and slides along the ground to `reach`, scaling up 1.3×, foam claws curling forward | as above |
| 0.10-0.45 | Spray | 18 hard-edged droplet streaks thrown up from the crest's base, falling in arcs | `#f2f6fa` |
| 0.40-0.70 | Break | The crest collapses into a flat foam ring at its end point and fades | `#8fb8dc` to transparent |

Budget (Rare class): 2 pooled meshes (crest, foam ring) + 18 particles (10 on Normal), 1 effect light (blue, 0.4 s, intensity × 0.65 on Normal), no ribbon, no impact frame. Peak 0.4 s. Reduced motion: no change needed (no flash).

## Sound

`abilityWave` (new, in `js/data/audio.js`): a sharp water slap transient (filtered noise burst, 2-4 kHz, 30 ms), a body of rushing water (band-passed noise sweeping 600 to 300 Hz over 0.4 s), a tail of a soft hiss (0.3 s). Played at the crest's start; the break adds a small low thud (90 Hz, 80 ms).

## Camera

No camera kick: the counter already has one. `CONFIG.camera.feel.powers.wave = [0.8, 0]`, used only when it hits two or more enemies.

## Images

- `img/riptide-1.webp`: the counter slash followed by the painted-style water crescent crashing through the boss.

pool.md:
# Petal Storm

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Id | `petal-storm` |
| Rarity | Rare (cool blue `#8fb8dc`), 3 levels |
| Kind | Triggered (no key) |
| Trigger | `finisher`: your Finishing Blow lands (its cut lines open) |
| Origin | New |

## Card

**Finishing Blow: a storm of petals cuts all near.** (9 words, 48 chars)

- Icon (48×48 line drawing): a spiral of five small pointed petal shapes whirling out from a centre dot.
- Hover loop (1.8 s): a small figure flashes through a boss leaving cut lines (0.5 s), the lines open and a spiral of blue petal blades whirls out from the boss and cuts a second boss beside it (0.7 s); fade.

## Idea

When the Finishing Blow's lines open, a storm of blade-sharp petals bursts out of the boss and cuts everything near. On one boss it is a little more damage at the best moment; on a two-boss fight it is the reason to take it, because the Finishing Blow now reaches the second boss too.

## Data

```js
{ id: 'petal-storm', name: 'Petal Storm', rarity: 'rare',
  text: 'Finishing Blow: a storm of petals cuts all near.',
  power: { when: 'finisher', then: 'petals' },
  levels: [
    { damage: 80, radius: 5 },
    { damage: 110, radius: 5.5 },
    { damage: 140, radius: 6 },
  ] },
```

Numbers: 2-4 Finishing Blows a fight, 80-140 to each enemy within 5-6 m of the finished one: 160-560 a fight on one boss, nearly double on two. In line with Riptide; it comes only after two counters and the Finishing Blow.

## Engine work

- New power `finisher/petals`: ['damage', 'radius'] in ABILITY_POWERS. New `when: 'finisher'` for powers: abilityPowers.trigger fires it from the `finisher` event (js/finisher.js), where the enemies are owned, with `ctx.enemy` the finished one. `petals` wounds every enemy within `radius` m of it, the finished one too if it is still alive and can be hurt (wound already skips one held or between phases).
- `validate.js`: `petals` needs `damage`, `radius` (from ABILITY_POWERS).

## Multiplayer

The server resolves the Finishing Blow already, so it fires the petals itself; no claim. Enemies only: a teammate inside the radius sees the petals pass through them. Every browser draws the storm.

## Effect

Layered, timed from the cut lines opening (t = 0):

| t | Layer | Look | Colour |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0.00 | Burst | A flat ring of light at the boss's middle, 1 m, opening the storm | `#f2f6fa` core, `#8fb8dc` edge |
| 0.05-0.90 | Storm | 60 hard little petal slivers whirling out from the boss in a two-armed spiral to `radius`, each a flat pointed blade, 2-tone with an ink edge | `#cfe2f2` face, `#8fb8dc` edge, `#0e1218` ink |
| 0.05-0.70 | Wind | One spiral ribbon tracing the storm's leading arm | `#8fb8dc`, to transparent |
| 0.70-1.20 | Settle | The petals slow, tumble and fall flat, fading on the floor | `#cfe2f2` to transparent |

Budget (Rare class): 2 pooled meshes (burst ring, the instanced petal mesh) + 60 petals (33 on Normal), 1 effect light (blue, 0.5 s, × 0.65 on Normal), 1 ribbon, no impact frame (the Finishing Blow keeps its own frozen frame). Peak 0.9 s. The storm goes 50% translucent within 1.5 m of a second boss's weapon. Reduced motion: the spiral spins at half speed.

## Sound

`abilityPetals` (new, in `js/data/audio.js`): a transient of a sharp paper-cut slice (white noise high-passed at 4 kHz, 30 ms), a body of a whirling rush (band-passed noise sweeping 800 to 2400 Hz over 0.6 s, with a 6 Hz tremolo for the whirl), a tail of soft fluttering (pink noise, 0.4 s). Played at the burst.

## Camera

`CONFIG.camera.feel.powers.petals = [1.4, 0.04]`: a small widening as the storm opens, after the Finishing Blow's own camera.

## Images

- `img/petal-storm-1.webp`: an explosion of pale blue blade-sharp petals spiralling outward from a boss as a finishing blow lands, the swordsman in a held pose.

pool.idea: Drinking turns the skin to blued steel: heavy blows can no longer stagger you while you heal and strike back.
pool.look: Blue-steel plates ripple over the skin from the flask hand outward, and blows on it throw blue sparks.

pool.md:
# Ironclad

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Id | `ironclad` |
| Rarity | Rare (cool blue `#8fb8dc`), 3 levels |
| Kind | Triggered (no key) |
| Trigger | `flask`: you start drinking a flask |
| Origin | New |

## Card

**Flask: no blow staggers you for {time}.** (7 words, 34 chars)

- Icon (48×48 line drawing): a small flask with three overlapping plate shapes behind it, like scales.
- Hover loop (1.8 s): a small figure lifts a flask (0.3 s), blue plates ripple over it from the hand outward (0.3 s), a boss's heavy blow lands on it and glances off in blue sparks while it keeps drinking (0.6 s); fade.

## Idea

Drinking turns the skin to blued steel: heavy blows can no longer stagger you or cut the drink short while you heal and strike back. The player still takes the damage, so it buys certainty, not safety. It takes the most punishing moment for new players (a drink cut short) and makes it a choice.

## Data

```js
{ id: 'ironclad', name: 'Ironclad', rarity: 'rare',
  text: 'Flask: no blow staggers you for {time}.',
  perk: { when: 'flask', then: 'unshaken' },
  levels: [
    { time: 3 },
    { time: 4 },
    { time: 5 },
  ] },
```

Numbers: a drink takes about 1.5 s, so 3 s covers the drink and one answer; 5 s covers the drink and a full light string. Blows still deal full damage, so drinking into a combo still costs health; it only keeps the heal and the answer.

## Engine work

- New perk `flask/unshaken`: ['time'] in ABILITY_PERKS, on the body's owner. Perk clock `unshaken` (s left) in abilityPerkState and abilityClocks, set to `time` when the drink starts (Player.useItem, where `flask` is reported).
- Player.takeHit (js/player.js): while `perk.unshaken > 0`, a blow that lands deals its damage but sets no `HURT` or stagger state, no knockback, and does not cut a drink short. Deaths still go through Player.die().
- `abilityPerk` cues `flask/unshaken` at the start and `unshaken/glance` on each blow taken in it.

## Multiplayer

Health and defence are the client's own (AGENTS rule 7): the browser applies the perk to its own body. It never touches a teammate, and a boss's blow still reaches the holder.

## Effect

Layered, timed from the drink's start (t = 0):

| t | Layer | Look | Colour |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0.00-0.30 | Plates | Flat blue-steel plates rippling over the player from the flask hand outward, a scale-like overlay with ink seams | `#3d5c78` plate, `#8fb8dc` edge, `#0e1218` ink |
| 0.30-time | Sheen | The plates settle into a thin blue rim on the body's silhouette, fading over the last 0.5 s | `#8fb8dc` |
| each blow | Glance | 12 hard blue sparks thrown off the hit point and a small flat star | `#f2f6fa`, `#8fb8dc` |

Budget (Rare class): 2 pooled meshes (the plate overlay shell, the glance star) + 12 sparks a blow (7 on Normal), no effect light, no ribbon, no impact frame. Peak 0.3 s. Reduced motion: no change needed (no flash).

## Sound

`abilityIronclad` (new, in `js/data/audio.js`): a transient of a metallic clink (sine 1.1 kHz with inharmonic partials 2.4 and 3.9, 40 ms), a body of steel plates sliding into place (band-passed noise 1.5-3 kHz, three quick 30 ms grains), a tail of a low ring (sine 220 Hz, 0.5 s). Each blow glancing off adds a short anvil tick (sine 1.8 kHz, 0.12 s) over the hurt sound.

## Camera

No camera kick: the blows taken still push the view as usual. No `powers` entry.

## Images

- `img/ironclad-1.webp`: the swordsman drinking a flask as plates of blued steel ripple across their skin, a boss's heavy blow glancing off in blue sparks.

pool.md:
# Overcharge

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Id | `overcharge` |
| Rarity | Rare (cool blue `#8fb8dc`), 3 levels |
| Kind | Triggered (no key) |
| Trigger | `ready`: one of your number keys is full and you keep earning points without pressing it |
| Origin | New |

## Card

**A full key overcharges: up to {damage} stronger.** (8 words, 41 chars)

- Icon (48×48 line drawing): a square key cap with a jagged rim of short zigzags breaking out of its edge.
- Hover loop (2.0 s): a small key cap fills (0.4 s), keeps filling past full while a blue crackling rim grows round it (0.8 s), then fires and the technique comes out larger, ringed in blue arcs (0.5 s); fade.

## Idea

A full key keeps charging past full, and its technique comes out stronger the longer you hold it. Risk for size: holding a strike or an ultimate through a dangerous stretch of the fight, then spending it big at the opening.

## Data

```js
{ id: 'overcharge', name: 'Overcharge', rarity: 'rare',
  text: 'A full key overcharges: up to {damage} stronger.',
  perk: { when: 'ready', then: 'overcharge' },
  levels: [
    { damage: 0.3 },
    { damage: 0.45 },
    { damage: 0.6 },
  ] },
```

Numbers: points earned past full fill an overcharge of the same size as the key's own `charge` (a 14-point key overcharges fully at 28 points, about another 14 s of good play). The technique fires × (1 + `damage` × the share filled): at most +30-60%. Waiting a whole second charge for +60% is roughly even with firing twice, so the gain is choosing the moment, not raw damage.

## Engine work

- New perk `ready/overcharge`: ['damage'] in ABILITY_PERKS. abilityGain lets a full key's count run on up to twice its `charge` when the kit holds it (`st.charge[key]` up to 2 × `charge`).
- A press takes the share past full, `over = (count - charge) / charge`, and raises the fired level's numbers: `damage` and `heal` by × (1 + `damage` × over); a summon's `damage` a blow. Times, reaches and radii stay as they are. The raised numbers are a copy made once per press (not per frame).

## Multiplayer

The server already counts each key's charge from the claims it accepted; it counts the overcharge the same way, and a press's raise uses its own count (with CONFIG.abilities.press.slack as for any press). Only the holder's techniques are raised.

# Echoing Blade

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Id | `echoing-blade` |

## Card

**After a key fires: next {hits} hits echo.** (8 words, 36 chars)

- Icon (48×48 line drawing): a sword stroke with a second, dotted copy of the same stroke offset just behind it.
- Hover loop (1.8 s): a small key cap fires (0.3 s), a figure hits a boss three times, a translucent blue copy of each swing repeating it a beat later (1.0 s); fade.

## Idea

Firing any key leaves ghost blades on you: your next few hits each land again a beat later. It ties the keys to the sword: spend a technique, then follow up at once to cash in the echoes.

## Data

```js
{ id: 'echoing-blade', name: 'Echoing Blade', rarity: 'rare',
  text: 'After a key fires: next {hits} hits echo.',
  power: { when: 'cast', then: 'ghostBlade' },
  levels: [
    { hits: 3, damage: 12 },
    { hits: 4, damage: 14 },
    { hits: 5, damage: 16 },
  ] },
```

Numbers: 36-80 extra damage a key fired. A player with two or three keys fires one every 6-10 s, so about +4-10 damage a second while they follow up. The echoes wait at most CONFIG.abilities.echo.keep (6 s) for the blows.

## Engine work

- New power `cast/echo`: ['hits', 'damage'] in ABILITY_POWERS. New `when: 'cast'`: abilityPowers fires it on any accepted press (it already sees every press where the enemies are owned). It arms `hits` echoes for the holder for `keep` s; each landed blow of the holder's (the `hits` trigger) spends one and queues a running strike `ECHO_DELAY`-style at CONFIG.abilities.echo.delay (0.15 s) on that enemy for `damage`, with its own `abilityPower` event (`strike`: its number).
- An echo is a power's strike: it never counts as a blow, never sets off another power, and never echoes itself.
- `validate.js`: CONFIG.abilities.echo { keep above 0, delay from 0 to 0.5 }.

## Multiplayer

The server sees the press and the landed blows, so it arms and resolves the echoes itself; no new claim. Enemies only. Every browser draws the ghost blade on the holder.

| --- | --- | --- | --- |

| 0.15 | Cut | A thin blue slash line on the enemy where the ghost lands, 1.6 m, gone in 0.25 s | `#f2f6fa` core, `#8fb8dc` edge |
| 0.15-0.35 | Chips | 6 hard flakes off the cut | `#cfe2f2` |

Budget (Rare class): 3 pooled meshes (ghost blade, slash line, the orbiting glints as one mesh) + 6 particles an echo (4 on Normal), no effect light, 1 ribbon (the ghost blade's trail), no impact frame. Peak 0.35 s an echo. Reduced motion: no change needed (no flash).

## Sound

`abilityGhostBlade` (new, in `js/data/audio.js`): a transient of a thin glassy slice (white noise band-passed at 5 kHz, q 3, 25 ms), a body of a short hollow whoosh (band-passed noise 1.2-2.4 kHz, 0.12 s), a tail of a faint ring (sine 1.5 kHz, 0.3 s). Each blow your summon lands marks the boss for you: fight with your summon, not beside it. It turns a summon from a timer you wait out into a partner you follow up.


## Idea

The heavy that ends a light string throws a ring of steel ribbons round you. It rewards finishing the string with a heavy rather than drifting off it, and it hits everything close: a second boss, or a boss whose body is wider than the blade.

## Data


| 0.00-0.50 | Rise | The ring rises from the feet to 1.9 m, narrowing to 0.8 m; three thin vertical calligraphy strokes sweep up inside it, each tapering at the top | as above; strokes `#f2f6fa` with `#8fb8dc` edges |

# Iron Stance

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Id | `iron-stance` |
| Rarity | Rare (cool blue `#8fb8dc`), 3 levels |
| Kind | Key 2, Guard |
| Trigger | `press`: key 2 pressed with its charge full (12 points at every level) |
| Origin | Kept from js/data/abilities.js: numbers and text unchanged; the gold sparks and floor ring become a hard blue outline aura and a blue starburst on every blow; untimed deflects in the stance no longer fill the Guard key. |

## Card

**Deflect blows for {time}, no timing needed.** (7 words, 38 chars)

- Icon (48×48 line drawing): a figure's outline drawn as a hard double line, a short slash meeting it from the side and bursting into a four-point star.
- Hover loop (1.8 s): the key 2 square lights (0.2 s); a hard blue outline snaps round a small figure (0.1 s); three falling blows strike it one after another, each bursting into a blue star while the figure stands still (1.2 s); the outline breaks away; fade.

## Idea

Plant your feet and weather a whole combo. For a few seconds every blow a guard could deflect is deflected as if perfectly timed, mid-swing or mid-drink too, each with its clang and spark. It teaches newcomers what a deflected string feels like, and gives skilled players a way to keep attacking straight through a boss's flurry. The blue wind-up of an undeflectable attack still means dash: the stance does not stop it.

## Data

```js
{ id: 'iron-stance', name: 'Iron Stance', rarity: 'rare', key: 'guard',
  text: 'Deflect blows for {time}, no timing needed.',
  perk: { when: 'press', then: 'stance' },
  levels: [
    { charge: 12, time: 2.5 },
    { charge: 12, time: 3 },
    { charge: 12, time: 3.5 },
  ] },
```

Numbers: a boss string runs 3-5 blows in 2-3 s, so 2.5 s covers one string and 3.5 s a string and its follow-up. Each deflect fills the boss's posture and a deflected last blow opens a riposte (2.4× a light hit), so a well-timed press is worth a riposte or a Finishing Blow. 12 points at about 1-1.4 a second comes every 9-12 s. Each deflect gives 3 points to every key, so a four-blow string deflected in the stance would refill the Guard key by itself: the stance's untimed deflects give no points to the Guard key (the other keys still fill).

## Engine work

- Exists: `press/stance` in `ABILITY_PERKS`, `perk.stance` and `canDeflectNow` (js/combat.js) deflect every deflectable blow while it runs.
- New: a deflect made only because `perk.stance > 0` (the player wasn't blocking or tapping) skips `gainCharge` for the `guard` key. `abilityGain` takes an optional key to leave out; the server's count does the same for a stance deflect claim.
- Drawing only: the `press/stance` cue in js/ability-fx.js becomes the aura below; each `parry` event while `perk.stance > 0` adds the starburst.

## Multiplayer

The stance is its holder's own defence (the client owns it). The server already knows the stance from the press it accepted, so it takes untimed deflect claims for `time` s plus its slack, still range- and rate-checking each one against the boss's live blow. Holder only; it never touches a teammate.

## Effect

Layered, timed from the press (t = 0):

| t | Layer | Look | Colour |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0.00-0.10 | Snap | A hard outline aura snaps onto the body: an inverted-hull shell 4 cm out, flat colour, its outer edge ink-dark | `#8fb8dc` shell, `#0b0d12` outer line |
| 0.00-`time` | Hold | The shell holds, a faint white line running up it every 0.8 s; a thin hard ring on the floor at the feet | `#8fb8dc`, `#f2f6fa` line |
| each deflect | Starburst | A flat four-to-six point star of hard spikes at the contact point, 0.9 m across, white core, plus 8 spark streaks thrown along the blow's direction | `#f2f6fa` core, `#8fb8dc` spikes, `#0b0d12` outline |
| `time`-+0.3 | Break | The shell cracks into 6 flat shards that fall and fade | `#8fb8dc` to transparent |

Budget (Rare class): 4 pooled meshes (shell, floor ring, starburst, shard sheet) + 8 sparks a deflect (at most 32 alive; 18 on Normal), 1 effect light (blue, 0.15 s a deflect, intensity × 0.65 on Normal), no ribbon, no impact frame. Peak 0.1 s a deflect; at most 3 deflects a second, so no flash passes 3 Hz. Reduced motion: no change needed.

## Sound

`abilityStance` (new, in `js/data/audio.js`, replacing `abilityCharge` for `press/stance`): a transient of a sword drawn short and set (band-passed white noise 2-5 kHz, 60 ms), a body of a low iron hum (sine 98 Hz with a 2.01 partial, 0.6 s, swelling in over 0.1 s), a tail of a ring (sine 784 Hz, 1 s). Each deflect in the stance plays the normal deflect clang with an added bright blue ping (sine 1568 Hz, 0.25 s), pitched up 2 semitones a deflect in one string so a weathered combo climbs.

## Camera

No new entry: the perk kick (`perkFov`) plays on the press and every deflect already has its own `parryFov`.

## Images

- `img/iron-stance-1.webp`: the swordsman in a planted stance with a hard blue outline aura, deflecting a flurry of boss blows that burst into starbursts of blue sparks.

# Mirror Ward

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Id | `mirror-ward` |
| Rarity | Rare (cool blue `#8fb8dc`), 3 levels |
| Kind | Key 2, Guard |
| Trigger | `press`: key 2 pressed with its charge full (14, 13, 12 points) |
| Origin | New |

## Card

**The next blow bounces back at the boss.** (8 words, 39 chars)

- Icon (48×48 line drawing): a tall upright pane with two crack lines, an arrow striking it and a second arrow flying back out the way it came.
- Hover loop (1.6 s): the key 2 square lights (0.2 s); a blue pane forms in front of a small figure (0.2 s); a boss's falling blow hits the pane and stops dead (0.3 s); the pane shatters outward and its shards fly back into the boss (0.5 s); fade.

## Idea

A pane of blue glass forms in front of you for a breath. The next blow that meets it is stopped whole and a share of its force flies back into the boss as the glass shatters outward. It rewards reading the boss: the bigger the blow you catch, the harder it bounces, so the right moment is the slam you know is coming.

## Data

```js
{ id: 'mirror-ward', name: 'Mirror Ward', rarity: 'rare', key: 'guard',
  text: 'The next blow bounces back at the boss.',
  perk: { when: 'press', then: 'reflect' },
  levels: [
    { charge: 14, time: 1.5, share: 0.6 },
    { charge: 13, time: 1.5, share: 0.8 },
    { charge: 12, time: 1.5, share: 1 },
  ] },
```

Numbers: boss blows run 6-70 damage on a 120-health player (median 34). The pane takes the whole blow, so it is worth one avoided blow, like a deflect without timing but with a 1.5 s window you must place. A reflected `share` of 34 alone would be 20-34 damage on a boss of 1600-3500 health, too little for a rare, so the bounce is `share` × the blow's damage × `CONFIG.abilities.reflect.mul` (3): about 61-102 on a median blow and up to 126-210 on a big slam. That sits beside Fire Burst (70-110 on key 1) and rewards catching the big one.

## Engine work

- New perk `press/reflect` in `ABILITY_PERKS` (`['charge', 'time', 'share']`), with a `ward` clock in `abilityPerkState` (s left) and `abilityClocks` counting it down.
- `Player.takeHit`: while `perk.ward > 0` and the blow comes from the front half (`isInFront`), the blow does nothing to the body (no damage, knock, flinch or counter lost), `perk.ward` goes to 0, and the holder reports a new `reflect` claim with the attacker (`ABILITY_CLAIMS`). Any blow from the front counts, deflectable or not, grabs included; area hits and shots from behind do not meet the pane.
- `abilityPowers` gets a `reflect` resolver: `wound(e, blow damage × share × CONFIG.abilities.reflect.mul)`, emitted as `abilityPower` with `then: 'reflect'` so every browser draws the shatter.
- `CONFIG.abilities.reflect: { mul: 3 }`; `validate.js`: `press/reflect` needs `charge`, `time`, `share` (a share, at most 1), and `reflect.mul` above 0.

## Multiplayer

The pane is its holder's own defence: the browser stops the blow on its own body (the client owns its health) and claims the reflect. The server checks that it accepted a press within `time` s plus its slack, that the attacker's blow is live and within reach of the holder, and computes the damage from its own copy of the attack. The pane stops blows on its holder only: a teammate behind it is not covered, and it never blocks a teammate's movement or blows.

## Effect

Layered, timed from the press (t = 0) and from the blow meeting the pane (t = h):

| t | Layer | Look | Colour |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0.00-0.15 | Form | A tall flat pane, 2.2 m high and 1.6 m wide, 0.8 m in front of the holder and turning with them, grows from a vertical line; a cracked-ice texture of straight fracture lines (no hexagons), an ink outline | `#8fb8dc` edge, `#cfe4f2` face at 35% opacity, `#0b0d12` lines |
| 0.15-1.50 | Hold | The pane holds; a white glint slides across it once | `#f2f6fa` glint |
| h | Stop | The blow halts against the pane; a white star of cracks spreads from the contact point in 0.05 s | `#f2f6fa` cracks |
| h+0.05-h+0.45 | Shatter | The pane bursts into 14 flat triangular shards flying in a cone at the boss, each with a short white streak; they vanish on reaching it | `#8fb8dc` shards, `#f2f6fa` streaks |
| h+0.40 | Bounce | A blue starburst on the boss where the shards land | `#8fb8dc`, `#f2f6fa` core |
| 1.50-1.80 | Fade | Unused, the pane dims and slides down into the floor | to transparent |

Budget (Rare class): 3 pooled meshes (pane, crack sheet, starburst) + 14 shards and 10 streaks (24 particles; 13 on Normal), 1 effect light (blue, 0.3 s at the shatter, intensity × 0.65 on Normal), no ribbon, no impact frame. Peak 0.4 s. Reduced motion: no change needed (no flash). The shards fly away from the boss's weapon arm when they would cover it.

## Sound

`abilityWard` (new, in `js/data/audio.js`): on the press a thin glass note forming (sine 1760 Hz with a 2.4 partial, 20 ms attack, 0.6 s); on the stop a hard transient (white noise band-passed at 4 kHz, 25 ms, plus a 140 Hz thump); the shatter's body (high-passed noise above 3 kHz, many short grains over 0.3 s); a tail of tinkling shards (three sines 2.6, 3.1 and 3.7 kHz, 0.4 s, scattered).

## Camera

`CONFIG.camera.feel.powers.reflect = [-1.2, 0.03]`: a small push in as the glass bounces into the boss.

## Images

- `img/mirror-ward-1.webp`: a tall pane of blue glass forming in front of the swordsman stopping a boss blow, cracking and shattering outward into the boss.

# Ash Husk

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Id | `ash-husk` |
| Rarity | Rare (cool blue `#8fb8dc`), 3 levels |
| Kind | Key 2, Guard |
| Trigger | `press`: key 2 pressed with its charge full (13, 12, 11 points) |
| Origin | New |

## Card

**Leave a husk that explodes when struck.** (7 words, 39 chars)

- Icon (48×48 line drawing): a standing figure outline drawn in broken dashes, a second solid figure stepping away behind it, a burst of short lines on the dashed one.
- Hover loop (1.8 s): the key 2 square lights (0.2 s); a small figure slips a step back and leaves a grey copy of itself (0.3 s); a boss blow falls on the copy (0.4 s); the copy bursts in a blue-cored blast that throws the boss back (0.5 s); fade.

## Idea

The substitution trick. You slip a step back and leave a husk of ash standing in your guard pose; the boss's next blow goes into it and the husk blows up in its face. It turns a blow you would have had to dodge into damage, and its timing is the same skill as a dodge: press it as the wind-up ends.

## Data

```js
{ id: 'ash-husk', name: 'Ash Husk', rarity: 'rare', key: 'guard',
  text: 'Leave a husk that explodes when struck.',
  power: { when: 'press', then: 'husk' },
  levels: [
    { charge: 13, time: 3, damage: 40 },
    { charge: 12, time: 3, damage: 55 },
    { charge: 11, time: 3, damage: 70 },
  ] },
```

Numbers: one avoided blow (median 34 of 120 health) plus 40-70 damage, about one or two counters' worth (a counter is about 42). Fire Burst on key 1 does 70-110 with no defence in it; the husk trades raw damage for the avoided blow. 13 points at 1-1.4 a second is a husk every 9-13 s. A husk the boss never strikes within 3 s crumbles harmlessly, so a press thrown at nothing costs its charge.

## Engine work

- New power `press/husk` in `ABILITY_POWERS` (`['charge', 'time', 'damage']`), resolved where the enemies are (`abilityPowers`).
- On the press: the holder takes a short backstep (`CONFIG.abilities.husk.step` 1.6 m over 0.2 s, its own movement, the same motion as a dash's start with no i-frames), and the engine places a husk at the spot they left: `{ holder, x, y, z, yaw, until, decoy }`, one per holder (a new press replaces it).
- The husk is a decoy like a summon's: `abilityPowers.decoy(e)` also returns a husk, so the targeted enemy's next attack begun within `time` s is aimed at it, and a blow already in flight at the holder's old place meets it. It draws one attack only, then lets go.
- Any enemy hitbox that overlaps the husk (`radius` 0.5 m, height 1.8 m) bursts it: `wound` every enemy within `CONFIG.abilities.husk.radius` (2.5 m) for `damage`, emitted as `abilityPower` `then: 'husk'` with `burst: true`.
- The husk is not a summon: it does not take the summon slot and a summon out keeps its place.
- `validate.js`: `press/husk` needs `charge`, `time`, `damage`; `CONFIG.abilities.husk` `step`, `radius` above 0.
- Drawing: the husk copies its holder's figure (js/rig.js's figure, posed as they were at the press, the way the Ember Twin is drawn), in an ash shader. Not a summon, so no Blender model of its own.

## Multiplayer

The press is claimed like every press; the server places the husk where it accepted the holder to be (range-checked against its last pose) and runs the decoy and the burst, since it owns the boss. The husk has no collision: teammates walk and strike through it, and their blows never burst it. Only the boss's blows do. It never draws the boss off a teammate it is already attacking mid-swing.

## Effect

Layered, timed from the press (t = 0) and from the blow on the husk (t = h):

| t | Layer | Look | Colour |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0.00-0.20 | Slip | The holder steps back; a brush smear of ash streaks between the two places | `#9a958c` smear, `#0b0d12` ink edge |
| 0.00-0.25 | Set | The husk greys from the feet up: a matte ash statue of the holder in their guard pose, cracked with thin blue seams | `#9a958c` ash, `#2a2827` char, `#8fb8dc` seams |
| 0.25-3.00 | Wait | Ash flakes drift off its shoulders; its seams glow brighter in the last 0.5 s | `#9a958c`, `#8fb8dc` |
| h | Burst | The husk bursts: a white-cored blue shell of flat shards, 2.5 m across, inside a cloud of hard-edged ash chunks | `#f2f6fa` core, `#8fb8dc` edge, `#9a958c` chunks |
| h-h+0.6 | Fall | 20 ash chunks and 10 blue sparks fall; a scorch ring stays on the floor and fades | `#2a2827` scorch, `#8fb8dc` sparks |
| 3.00-3.50 | Crumble | Unstruck, it collapses into a cone of ash from the head down and fades | `#9a958c` to transparent |

Budget (Rare class): the husk figure (pooled, one a player) + 3 pooled meshes (smear, burst shell, scorch ring) + 30 particles (17 on Normal), 1 effect light (blue, 0.35 s at the burst, intensity × 0.65 on Normal), no ribbon, no impact frame. Peak 0.35 s. Reduced motion: no change needed.

## Sound

`abilityHusk` (new, in `js/data/audio.js`): on the press a dry rustle of ash (pink noise band-passed 1.2-3 kHz, 0.25 s) with a soft stone settle (brown noise low-passed at 300 Hz, 0.2 s); on the burst a transient crack (white noise band-passed at 3 kHz, 20 ms), a body of a blue-fire whoomp (sawtooth 70 Hz gliding to 45 Hz, driven, 0.35 s), a tail of ash raining (pink noise high-passed at 2 kHz, 0.6 s, falling).

## Camera

`CONFIG.camera.feel.powers.husk = [1.6, 0.05]`: on the burst only, a small outward kick.

## Images

- `img/ash-husk-1.webp`: a grey ash statue of the swordsman left standing in a guard pose being struck by a boss and bursting in a blue-cored ash explosion, the real swordsman stepping aside.

pool.md:
# Moon Dome

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Id | `moon-dome` |
| Rarity | Rare (cool blue `#8fb8dc`), 3 levels |
| Kind | Key 2, Guard |
| Trigger | `press`: key 2 pressed with its charge full (16, 15, 14 points) |
| Origin | New |

## Card

**A dome stops shots and blasts for {time}.** (8 words, 36 chars)

- Icon (48×48 line drawing): a half circle over a floor line with two thin crescent arcs inside it, three short arrows breaking against its outside.
- Hover loop (1.8 s): the key 2 square lights (0.2 s); a pale dome rises over a small figure (0.3 s); a volley of shots and a ring of fire hit it and break in ripples on its skin (0.9 s) while the figure inside stands untouched; the dome fades; fade.

## Idea

A pale dome of moonlight rises where you stand and holds for a few seconds: shots and area blasts from outside break on its skin. It is the answer to the bosses that rain projectiles or flood the floor with fire, and the guard's one co-op shelter: a friend who steps in with you is covered too. It never stops a blow from a boss that walks inside, so it is a place to stand, not a wall to hide behind.

## Data

```js
{ id: 'moon-dome', name: 'Moon Dome', rarity: 'rare', key: 'guard',
  text: 'A dome stops shots and blasts for {time}.',
  perk: { when: 'press', then: 'dome' },
  levels: [
    { charge: 16, time: 4, radius: 3 },
    { charge: 15, time: 4.5, radius: 3.2 },
    { charge: 14, time: 5, radius: 3.4 },
  ] },
```

Numbers: 4-5 s covers one shot volley or one area pattern; bosses mix those with melee, so the dome blanks a third to a half of what a ranged phase throws. 16 points at 1-1.4 a second is a dome every 12-16 s, rarer than the single-blow guards because it can cover a friend. A radius of 3-3.4 m holds the holder and one or two friends standing close.

## Engine work

- New perk `press/dome` in `ABILITY_PERKS` (`['charge', 'time', 'radius']`). Though a perk, it is placed in the world: on the press the dome is fixed at the holder's feet (it does not follow them) for `time` s.
- A shared list of live domes (`{ holder, x, y, z, radius, until }`, a fixed pool of 4, one a player) that the combat code reads.
- A shot (js/projectiles.js) whose path crosses a dome's surface from outside stops there (the `boltStopped` event, drawn as a ripple).
- An area hit (an attack box at least `CONFIG.aggro.areaWidth` m wide, a ring, an `impact`, a wall of fire or a ground area mark) does not land on a body inside a dome when the hit's origin (its owner's body, or the impact's centre) is outside that dome. Melee blows from an enemy body, inside or outside, land as normal.
- `validate.js`: `press/dome` needs `charge`, `time`, `radius`.

## Multiplayer

The press is claimed like every press, and the server tells every browser (a dome is the one guard perk shared with the party): `abilityPerk` with `perk: 'press/dome'`, the holder, its place, `radius` and `time`. Each browser drops the area hits on its own body that the dome covers (each client owns its health); the server, which owns the shots, stops them at the dome's skin so every screen sees the same ripple. The shared benefit, its size stated: a teammate standing inside the dome's 3-3.4 m radius gets the same shelter from shots and area blasts for the dome's 4-5 s, nothing more (no heal, no buff, no stop to melee). The dome never moves, slows or pushes anyone and has no collision: bodies walk in and out freely. Domes from two players don't stack on a body; being inside one is enough.

## Effect

Layered, timed from the press (t = 0):

| t | Layer | Look | Colour |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0.00-0.30 | Rise | A half-sphere of pale light grows up from a ring on the floor to `radius`; its skin is flat, 2-tone, with four thin crescent-moon lines drawn on it in brush ink, a hard bright rim where it meets the floor | `#cfe4f2` skin at 20%, `#8fb8dc` rim and crescents, `#0b0d12` ink |
| 0.30-`time` | Hold | The crescents turn slowly round the dome; 12 slow motes rise inside it | `#8fb8dc`, `#f2f6fa` motes |
| each stop | Ripple | A flat ring of hard ripples spreads from where a shot or blast meets the skin, 1.4 m across, with 6 white spark streaks | `#f2f6fa` ring, `#8fb8dc` edge |
| last 0.6 s | Wane | The skin thins, the crescents fade one by one so its end is readable | to `#8fb8dc` at 10% |
| `time`-+0.3 | Set | The dome sinks into its floor ring and goes | to transparent |

Budget (Rare class): 4 pooled meshes (dome, crescent sheet, floor ring, ripple ring) + 12 motes and 6 streaks a ripple (at most 40 alive; 22 on Normal), 1 effect light (blue, low, steady while it holds, intensity × 0.65 on Normal), no ribbon, no impact frame. Peak 0.3 s; it holds `time`. The skin is translucent, so a boss's wind-up behind it stays readable. Reduced motion: ripples spread without the spark streaks.

## Sound

`abilityDome` (new, in `js/data/audio.js`): a rising glass swell (sine 392 Hz with 1.5 and 2.01 partials, 0.3 s attack, 1 s), a body of a soft held chord under it (sine 196 Hz, held `time` s at low gain), a tail as it sets (the chord falling a fifth, 0.4 s). Each ripple: a muffled thud (brown noise low-passed at 250 Hz, 0.15 s) and a short shimmer (sine 1318 Hz, 0.3 s), at most 4 a second.

## Camera

# Waiting Blade

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Id | `waiting-blade` |
| Rarity | Rare (cool blue `#8fb8dc`), 3 levels |
| Kind | Key 2, Guard |
| Trigger | `press`: key 2 pressed with its charge full (14, 13, 12 points) |
| Origin | New |

## Card

**Stance: the next blow is answered with a cut.** (9 words, 45 chars)

- Icon (48×48 line drawing): a sheathed sword held low with a hand on the hilt, a single long arc line drawn over it from corner to corner.
- Hover loop (1.8 s): the key 2 square lights (0.2 s); a small figure settles still, a ring on the floor (0.4 s); a boss blow starts to fall (0.3 s); one enormous blue arc cuts across the card before the blow lands, and the boss reels (0.5 s); hold the arc; fade.

## Idea

The counter stance. Hand on the hilt, eyes closed, perfectly still: any blow that comes in the next breath is answered by one enormous cut before it lands. It is the most patient guard and the biggest payoff of the three single-blow ones, and it asks the player to press it as a boss's wind-up begins, the same read as a deflect, with the whole moment held.

## Data

```js
{ id: 'waiting-blade', name: 'Waiting Blade', rarity: 'rare', key: 'guard',
  text: 'Stance: the next blow is answered with a cut.',
  power: { when: 'press', then: 'counterStance' },
  levels: [
    { charge: 14, time: 1.2, damage: 120 },
    { charge: 13, time: 1.3, damage: 145 },
    { charge: 12, time: 1.4, damage: 170 },
  ] },
```

Numbers: 120-170 is about three to four counters (a counter is about 42) and above Fire Burst's 70-110 on key 1, because it can miss: the stance holds only 1.2-1.4 s and the holder can't move or attack in it. Pressed on a wind-up, it avoids one blow (median 34 of 120 health) and lands the cut. 14 points at 1-1.4 a second is a stance every 10-14 s. Against bosses of 1600-3500 health, four answered stances a fight are 480-680 damage, a strong rare that needs the read.

## Engine work

- New power `press/counterStance` in `ABILITY_POWERS` (`['charge', 'time', 'damage']`).
- The stance lives on the holder's body: a `wait` clock in `abilityPerkState` (s left), a still pose (PS.BLOCK's facing rules, no movement). A dash, an attack or a flask cancels it early; the charge is spent.
- While `perk.wait > 0`, the first enemy blow that would land on the holder from an enemy's body or weapon is answered instead: it never lands (no damage, knock or flinch), `perk.wait` goes to 0, and the holder reports a new `answer` claim with the attacker (`ABILITY_CLAIMS`). Deflectable or not, it is answered; grabs (`seize`, `pull`), shots and ground area hits are not (they have no swing to meet) and land as usual.
- `abilityPowers` resolves `answer`: `wound(e, damage)`, emitted as `abilityPower` `then: 'counterStance'`. The cut is a power's blow, never a counter: the Finishing Blow stays the holder's to earn.
- The answered blow gives no deflect points (it isn't a deflect).
- `validate.js`: `press/counterStance` needs `charge`, `time`, `damage`.

## Multiplayer

The stance is its holder's own defence (the client owns it). The server takes the answer claim only if it accepted the press within `time` s plus its slack and the attacker's blow is live and within reach of the holder, and resolves the cut itself since it owns the boss. Holder only: a teammate beside them is not covered, and the cut hits enemies only.

## Effect

Layered, timed from the press (t = 0) and from the answered blow (t = h):

| t | Layer | Look | Colour |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0.00-0.15 | Settle | A thin hard ring draws itself round the holder's feet, 2 m across, in one brush stroke; the holder's scarf and coat go still | `#8fb8dc` ring, `#0b0d12` ink edge |
| 0.15-`time` | Wait | The ring holds; one white line along the sheathed blade brightens slowly | `#f2f6fa` |
| h | Still | The world dims 20% for 0.12 s (not a flash): the holder and the coming blow stay lit | world × 0.8 |
| h+0.02-h+0.20 | Cut | One enormous flat arc, 7 m long and 0.5 m thick at its middle, sweeps through the attacker from the holder's hip: white core, blue edge, ink outline, a brush smear trailing it | `#f2f6fa` core, `#8fb8dc` edge, `#0b0d12` outline |
| h+0.20-h+0.70 | Hang | The arc hangs in the air, then splits along its length and fades in two halves; 16 spark streaks fall from the split | `#8fb8dc` to transparent, `#f2f6fa` sparks |
| `time`-+0.2 | Lapse | Unanswered, the ring breaks into short dashes and fades | to transparent |

Budget (Rare class): 3 pooled meshes (floor ring, arc, smear ribbon) + 16 particles (9 on Normal), 1 effect light (white-blue, 0.25 s at the cut, intensity × 0.65 on Normal), 1 ribbon (the smear), no impact frame. Peak 0.2 s. The pool's "ink-and-blue frame" is a legendary's impact frame (STYLE.md rule 8), so a rare uses the 20% dim instead. Reduced motion: the dim stays (it is not a flash), the arc's hang is held still.

## Sound

`abilityAnswer` (new, in `js/data/audio.js`): on the press a quiet click of a thumb on a guard (white noise band-passed at 5 kHz, 8 ms) and a held breath (pink noise low-passed at 800 Hz, 0.4 s, falling); on the answer a transient of a sword drawn at once (band-passed noise sweeping 2-7 kHz in 40 ms), a body of a deep cut (sine 110 Hz gliding to 55 Hz, driven, 0.3 s), a tail of a long ring (sine 659 Hz with a 2.76 partial, 1.2 s).

## Camera

`CONFIG.camera.feel.powers.counterStance = [-2, 0.06]`: a push in on the cut, inside the 0.4 s limit.

## Images

- `img/waiting-blade-1.webp`: the swordsman in a still counter stance with eyes closed and hand on the hilt, a boss blow arriving, a single enormous blue arc cutting it first.
