### Model

- File: `tools/blender/glass_mantis.py`, packed to `js/baked/glass-mantis.js` (`'glass-mantis': { sources: ['glass_mantis'] }`).
- Look: a tall upright mantis cut from clear glass in hard flat facets: a narrow triangular head with two blue eye-facets, a long thin neck plate, two scythe forelegs with serrated inner edges and needle tips, four thin walking legs, folded wing plates down its back. Every facet edge is drawn with a black ink line; the blade edges glow blue.
- Height: 2.4 m standing, scythes folded.
- Material: a summon glass shader: near-clear (`#cfe4f2` at 25% opacity) with a strong fresnel rim (`#8fb8dc`), facet edges and outline in ink (`#0b0d12`, an inverted-hull outline), the blade edges and eye-facets emissive blue with white-hot tips (`#f2f6fa`). Slots: `glass`, `edge` (glows), `eye` (glows).
- Rig: rigid pieces on pivots (body, head, two forelegs in two parts each, four walking legs, wing plates); about 1,800 triangles.
- Animations (by hand): arrive (a crystal shard stabs up out of the floor, 0.2 s, and unfolds piece by piece into the mantis, 0.5 s), idle (a slow sway with the forelegs raised and folded, head turning in small jerks), strike (both scythes snap open and scissor through the boss in a crossing cut, 0.12 s, then fold back), draw (it rears with its scythes spread wide and its wing plates fanned, 1 s), leave (cracks run through it from the feet up, 0.3 s, and it shatters into shards that fall and fade, 0.5 s). ## Multiplayer

One summon per holder at a time: a press on key 3 with another summon out sends that one away. The server owns the mantis: it places it, cuts for it and draws the boss's eye with it for `draw` s (1.5-1.9 s) after it arrives; it can't be hurt, and an attack begun on it ends on it. It has no collision: it never blocks, pushes or heals a teammate, and its shards on leaving are drawn only. Every browser draws it from the `abilityPower` events.

## Effect

Layered, timed from the press (t = 0) and from each cut (t = h):

| t | Layer | Look | Colour |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0.00-0.20 | Shard | A crystal shard stabs up from the floor beside the boss, 1.2 m, a crack star on the floor round it | `#cfe4f2` glass, `#0b0d12` outline |
| 0.20-0.70 | Unfold | The shard unfolds into the mantis; its edges light blue from the feet up; 8 glass glints | `#8fb8dc` edges, `#f2f6fa` glints |
| h-h+0.10 | Cut | Two thin straight cut lines cross through the boss in an X, 1.8 m each, hard white core, ink outline | `#f2f6fa` core, `#8fb8dc` edge, `#0b0d12` outline |
| h+0.10-h+0.35 | Hang | The X hangs, then each line slides apart along its length and fades; 4 glass chips | `#8fb8dc` to transparent, `#cfe4f2` chips |
| draw | Fan | Its wing plates fan out and catch light in a blue rim | `#8fb8dc` |
| `time`-0.3-`time` | Crack | White crack lines climb its body | `#f2f6fa` |
| `time`-+0.5 | Shatter | It breaks into 20 shards that fall and fade | `#cfe4f2`, `#8fb8dc` rims |

Budget (Rare summon class): the model + 2 pooled meshes (the X cut, the floor crack star) + 8 glints at the unfold, 4 chips a cut and 20 shards at the end (at most 30 alive; 17 on Normal), 1 effect light while striking (blue-white, 0.1 s a cut, intensity × 0.65 on Normal), no ribbon, no impact frame. Peak 0.1 s a cut; one every 0.7-0.8 s, under 1.5 Hz, and the light is a soft glint, not a flash. Reduced motion: the X fades in place without sliding apart. The cut lines are thin (2 px at their thickest at 10 m) and cross the boss's body, never its weapon arm in a wind-up.

## Sound

`abilityMantis` (new, in `js/data/audio.js`) on the call: a transient of glass stabbing up (a bright click, sine 3.2 kHz with a 2.76 partial, 2 ms attack, 0.1 s), a body of the mantis unfolding (6 small glass ticks band-passed at 4 kHz over 0.5 s, each a little higher), a tail of a ringing glass tone (sine 1320 Hz with a 2.4 partial, 0.8 s). `abilityScissor` on each cut: two crossed metallic swishes 30 ms apart (band-passed noise sweeping 3 to 8 kHz, 60 ms each) and a short glass ring (sine 1760 Hz, 0.2 s) at low gain. `abilityShatter` as it leaves: glass breaking (white noise grains high-passed at 3 kHz, 0.4 s, with three falling tones at 2.6, 2.1 and 1.7 kHz).

## Camera

`CONFIG.camera.feel.powers.mantis = [1, 0.03]` as it unfolds; no kick a cut; `draw = [1.2, 0.03]` on the fan.

## Images

- `img/glass-mantis-1.webp`: a tall slender mantis of clear blue glass unfolding scythe arms and slicing a boss in a fast scissor cut, light refracting through its body.

pool.md:
# Night Owl

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Id | `night-owl` |
| Rarity | Rare (cool blue `#8fb8dc`), 3 levels |
| Kind | Key 3, Summon |
| Trigger | `press`: key 3 pressed with its charge full (16, 15, 14 points) |
| Origin | New |

## Card

**An owl marks the boss; marks take {mark} more.** (9 words, 41 chars)

`mark` is a share, so js/ability-cards.js shows it as a percentage: "marks take 70% more" (`mark` joins `ABILITY_SHARES`; a flat `damage` would read as a number).

- Icon (48×48 line drawing): an owl seen from below with its wings spread wide, a small ring with a cross-mark beneath it.
- Hover loop (1.8 s): the key 3 square lights (0.2 s); an owl glides down out of the dark and starts circling above the boss (0.4 s); it drops a small blue rune that settles on the boss's back (0.3 s); a sword blow lands on the rune and it bursts in a ring of white (0.4 s); the owl drops another; fade.

## Idea

A pale owl glides down out of the dark and circles silently above the boss, dropping a blue rune mark on it every few seconds. The next blow that lands on a marked boss bursts the mark and hits harder. It is the summon that doesn't fight: it makes everyone's blows count, so it pays most to a player who keeps attacking and to a team that does.

## Data

```js
{ id: 'night-owl', name: 'Night Owl', rarity: 'rare', key: 'summon',
  text: 'An owl marks the boss; marks take {mark} more.',
  power: { when: 'press', then: 'owl' },
  levels: [
    { charge: 16, time: 10, every: 2, mark: 0.7 },
    { charge: 15, time: 11, every: 1.8, mark: 0.85 },
    { charge: 14, time: 12, every: 1.6, mark: 1 },
  ] },
```

Numbers: after its 0.7 s arrival it drops about 5, 6 and 7 marks. Each one, burst by a light blow (16), adds 11-16; by a heavy (30-56), 21-56; by a counter (about 42), 29-42. Alone that is about 60-130 damage a call at level I and 110-260 at level III, near the other summons although it never strikes, and it holds no attention (no `draw`). In a team of four every player's blow can burst it, so marks never go to waste. 16 points at 1-1.4 a second is an owl every 11-16 s. It pays most to a player who hits hard and often.

## Engine work

- New power `press/owl` in `ABILITY_POWERS` (`['charge', 'time', 'every', 'mark']`); `owl` joins `SUMMONS` and `ON_ENEMY`, not `SUMMON_STRIKERS` (it never strikes and never draws: it is no decoy).
- `CONFIG.abilities.summons.owl: { gap: 0, flank: 0, speed: 10, height: 0.6, reach: 30, alt: 6, orbit: 0.8 }`: it circles `alt` m above its enemy (`orbit` rad/s, the same rule as the Cinder Fox's and the Thunder Hawk's), so its `reach` is only a sanity bound.
- Every `every` s it puts a mark on its enemy: `e.mark = { mul: mark, by: holder, t: CONFIG.abilities.summons.owl.markLife }` (`markLife: 4` s). One mark at a time per enemy, whoever's owl made it: a new mark on a marked enemy only renews its clock.
- In `wound` (js/combat.js), when the blow is a player's own weapon blow (light, heavy, counter, plunge, the Finishing Blow) and `e.mark` is set, the damage is multiplied by `1 + mark.mul` and the mark is cleared, emitting `abilityPower` `then: 'owlBurst'`. Blows of powers and summons, damage over time and traps neither burst nor consume it.
- `validate.js`: `press/owl` needs `charge`, `time`, `every`, `mark`, with `mark` in (0, 1].
- Drawing: a beast in `js/summon-beasts.js` (shared with the hound, the fox, the hawk, the bear and the mantis), plus a small pooled rune decal that follows the marked enemy's back.
- Summon pools are built when a player in the run takes the ability (at the pick screen) and warmed then.

### Model

- File: `tools/blender/night_owl.py`, packed to `js/baked/night-owl.js` (`'night-owl': { sources: ['night_owl'] }`).
- Look: a large pale owl with a flat round facial disc, soft broad wings with fingered tips, ink barring across its wings and breast, two large blue eyes with ink rims, and short ink talons. It reads as a pale cross against the dark sky.
- Size: 0.7 m tall perched, 1.6 m wingspan.
- Material: the summon shader, lit: pale plumage (`#cfd6dc`, cool, never cream) with ink barring (`#0b0d12`) painted in, a faint blue fresnel rim on the wing edges (`#8fb8dc`), the eyes emissive blue with white-hot pupils (`#f2f6fa`). Slots: `plume`, `bar`, `eye` (glows).
- Rig: rigid pieces on pivots (body, head, two wings in two parts each, tail); about 1,400 triangles.
- Animations (by hand): arrive (it glides down out of the dark in a wide silent spiral to circling height, 0.7 s), idle (a slow circle with rare, slow wing beats, its head always turned to the boss), strike (the mark: it tips its head down and a rune falls from its talons to the boss, 0.3 s; there is no blow), leave (it beats its wings twice and rises back into the dark until only its eyes show, then they close, 0.7 s). It never pops in or out.

## Multiplayer

One summon per holder at a time: a press on key 3 with another summon out sends that one away. The server owns the owl and its marks: it places and circles the owl, puts each mark on the boss and resolves every burst itself, since it owns the boss and checks every hit claim; a client's hit claim on a marked boss gets the bonus only from the server. The owl can't be hurt and draws no attention. Shared benefit: a teammate's blow bursts a mark the same as the holder's (one mark, one blow, whoever lands it), which is the owl's point in a team. It flies above everyone with no collision: it never blocks, pushes or heals a teammate. Every browser draws it and the marks from the `abilityPower` events.

## Effect

Layered, timed from the press (t = 0), from each mark (t = m) and from each burst (t = b):

| t | Layer | Look | Colour |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0.00-0.70 | Glide | It glides down out of the dark in a spiral; its eyes light first | `#cfd6dc` plumage, `#8fb8dc` eyes |
| 0.70-`time` | Circle | It circles at 6 m; no particles | |
| m-m+0.30 | Drop | A small rune falls from its talons along a thin line of light | `#8fb8dc`, `#f2f6fa` core |
| m+0.30-burst | Mark | A flat rune, 0.8 m, sits on the boss's back (never on its weapon arm), a slow brightness pulse once a second | `#8fb8dc` rune, `#0b0d12` ink edge |
| b-b+0.15 | Burst | The rune bursts into a hard ring of white, 1.4 m, and 10 shards fly out from the blow's contact point | `#f2f6fa` ring, `#8fb8dc` shards |
| b+0.15-b+0.40 | Fade | The ring thins and fades | to transparent |
| `time`-+0.7 | Leave | It rises into the dark; the eyes close last | to transparent |

Budget (Rare summon class): the model + 3 pooled meshes (the rune decal, the drop line, the burst ring) + 10 shards a burst (at most 20 alive; 11 on Normal), 1 effect light while a mark is on (a small blue glow on the rune, steady), no ribbon, no impact frame. Peak 0.15 s a burst. The mark's pulse is once a second, and a mark lapses after 4 s unburst (it fades). Reduced motion: the mark holds steady without its pulse. The rune is blue on the back, away from the boss's weapon, so it never reads as an undeflectable wind-up's glow (`#5ab4ff` on the weapon).

## Sound

`abilityOwl` (new, in `js/data/audio.js`) on the call: a transient of soft wing air (pink noise low-passed at 600 Hz, 0.15 s), a body of a low hoot, twice (sine 330 Hz gliding to 290 Hz with a soft attack, 0.25 s each, 0.35 s apart), a tail of a quiet wind (band-passed noise at 400 Hz, 0.6 s). `abilityMark` on each mark: a small chime (sine 1175 Hz, 0.3 s) at low gain. `abilityMarkBurst` on each burst: a bright glass ring (sine 1568 Hz with a 2.4 partial, 0.4 s) layered over the blow's own hit sound.

## Camera

`CONFIG.camera.feel.powers.owl = [0.6, 0]` as it glides in; no kick a mark; `owlBurst = [-0.4, 0.02]` on each burst, small, as it rides the blow's own feel.

## Images

- `img/night-owl-1.webp`: a great pale owl with blue glowing eyes circling above a boss, glowing blue rune circles marked on the boss's body, the swordsman striking one.

pool.md:
# Thunder Call

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Id | `thunder-call` |
| Rarity | Legendary (ember orange `#e59a5c`), 1 level |
| Kind | Key 4, Ultimate |
| Trigger | `press`: key 4 with its charge full (40 points) |
| Origin | Kept from `js/data/abilities.js`. Changed: one level instead of two; its own `then: 'dragon'` (was `press/lightning`, shared with Storm King), so the dragon belongs to Thunder Call alone; 48 damage a strike (was 45); new card text. |

## Card

**A lightning dragon strikes the boss {strikes} times.** (8 words, 44 chars)

- Icon (48×48 line drawing): a serpent's head and two coils drawn as one jagged lightning line, falling from a short horizontal cloud stroke.
- Hover loop (1.8 s): the key cap "4" lights (0.2 s); a small figure raises the blade (0.3 s); the sky line splits and a jagged ember dragon pours down and coils round a boss silhouette (0.6 s); one brighter frame as it bites; two quick bolt ticks (0.4 s); fade.

## Idea

The floor of the legendaries, and the showcase's key-4 beat. The sword goes up, the sky splits, and a dragon of lightning pours out of it, coils once round the boss and strikes it again and again. Every other legendary is measured against this one: as spectacular at least, as strong at least. It is the plainest of them on purpose: aim, press, and the dragon does the rest, so a friend on their first run feels the Ultimate key at once.

## Data

```js
{ id: 'thunder-call', name: 'Thunder Call', rarity: 'legendary', key: 'ultimate',
  text: 'A lightning dragon strikes the boss {strikes} times.',
  power: { when: 'press', then: 'dragon' },
  levels: [
    { charge: 40, strikes: 7, lead: 0.75, every: 0.3, damage: 48 },
  ] },
```

Numbers: the bar. A skilled player fills about one point a second in a boss fight (`CONFIG.abilities.press.gain`: 1 a landed blow, 2 more for a heavy finisher, full charge or counter, 3 a deflect or perfect dodge, 6 a Finishing Blow), so 40 points is a cast every 35-45 s, two or three a fight. 7 × 48 = 336 a cast, 8.4 damage a charge point; 670-1000 a fight against bosses of 1600-3500 health: a quarter to a third of a bar. That turns a fight without ending it. Every other Ultimate is held to at least 8.4 a point, or less damage with a hold or an area that pays the difference.

## Engine work

- `press/dragon` in `ABILITY_POWERS`: `['charge', 'strikes', 'lead', 'every', 'damage']`, run like today's `lightning` (in `ON_ENEMY`; a `running` entry, first strike `lead` s after the press, then every `every` s). If the boss dies mid-run, the strikes left go to the nearest live enemy within `CONFIG.abilities.press.range`, else end.
- `fullHeavy/lightning` leaves with Storm King's rework (`boltCrown`); `press/lightning` goes. `js/ability-fx.js` draws the dragon for `then === 'dragon'` only.
- One level: `CONFIG.abilities.rarity.legendary.levels` 1 and the `legendaries` cap goes (PLAN item 6: no cap on any rarity).
- The shared legendary kit, built in the same pass because every legendary uses it:
  - **Cast pose:** pressing key 4 plays the ability's pose on the upper body only (track A's animator); legs, dash and the camera stay the player's, and the power fires whatever the legs do.
  - **The dim:** over the anticipation the world's light drops 20% (a grade uniform on the output pass), for the holder and anyone within `powerNear`.
  - **The impact frame** (`VIS.impactFrame`): one full-screen two-tone pass, black ink `#0b0b0f` and white-hot `#fff3dc`, the effect's ember `#e59a5c` kept where it is brightest; two frames at 60 fps. Drawn only when the peak is on screen and within `powerNear`; gated to one a second from every source, so flashes stay under 3 Hz with a party of four.
- `validate.js`: `dragon` needs every number above; `strikes` a whole number.
- The showcase (its own session) uses the dragon as its key-4 beat: rename `lightning` to `dragon` in one pass and run the showcase's test, which says if the beat broke.

## Multiplayer

The server resolves it from the press claim (it already checks the charge it counted). One holder per team. Bolts hit enemies only; a teammate under the dragon sees it pass through them. Every browser draws it from the server's `abilityPower` events; each strike is its own event, so the bites line up for everyone.

## Effect

Timed from the press (t = 0):

| t | Layer | Look | Colour |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0.00-0.35 | Anticipation | Upper-body pose: the blade raised straight up, held. The world dims 20%. Three thin ember threads crawl up the blade to its tip | `#e59a5c` threads, `#fff3dc` tip |
| 0.20-0.40 | Sky split | A jagged white line tears across the clouds above the boss, 20 m wide, opening to a hard violet slit with an ember rim | `#ece6ff` line, `#8f7cf0` slit, `#e59a5c` rim |
| 0.35-0.75 | Release | The dragon pours out of the slit: a ribbon tube of 28 segments, white-violet core, violet body, ember fringe, a black ink outline on its leading edge; a flat head shape with two horn strokes | `#ece6ff` core, `#8f7cf0` body, `#e59a5c` fringe, `#0b0b0f` ink |
| 0.55-0.75 | Coil | It loops once round the boss at chest height, its tail still in the sky | as above |
| 0.75 | Peak (first bite) | The head drives into the boss's chest: a hard bolt from the slit to the boss, a star burst of 24 sharp shards, a scorch ring on the floor. **The impact frame** | `#fff3dc` bolt, `#e59a5c` shards, `#2a1a12` scorch |
| 1.05-2.55 | Strikes 2-7 | Every 0.3 s the coil tightens and a jagged bolt cracks from the slit into the boss: 12 shards each, a short white branch; the light stays lit on the coil and swells a little with each bolt (a swell, never a flash: 3.3 bolts a second would break the 3 Hz rule) | `#fff3dc`, `#e59a5c` |
| 2.55-3.40 | Fade | The dragon unwinds upward into the slit, which seals in a last white line; the scorch ring cools from ember to black; ash flakes drift down | `#8f7cf0` to transparent, `#e59a5c` to `#2a1a12` |

Budget (Legendary class): 9 pooled meshes (sky slit, dragon tube, head, 3 bolt meshes reused round-robin, scorch ring, star burst, blade glow) + 24 + 6 × 12 = 96 particles at most alive at once (53 on Normal), 2 effect lights (the bite's flash; the coil's steady light, intensity × 0.65 on Normal), 2 ribbons (the dragon's two crossed strips), 1 impact frame at t = 0.75. Peak 1.8 s (0.75-2.55). Reduced motion: the impact frame becomes a 30% darken for 0.1 s, no shake, the sky slit fades in over 0.3 s instead of tearing.

## Sound

- Cast: `abilityDragon` (kept: the electric snarl that climbs) at t = 0.35, its glide stretched to 0.4 s so it peaks on the bite.
- Each strike: `abilityThunder` (kept: the crack overhead, then thunder rolling away); the first one louder (gain × 1.3) with an extra sub thump (sine 40 Hz falling to 24 Hz, 0.5 s).
- New tail on the last strike: a rumble that rolls round the arena (brown noise, low-pass 300 to 60 Hz over 1.6 s, high reverb send).

## Camera

`CONFIG.camera.feel.powers.dragon = [2.4, 0.08]` for the cast (the view widens as the sky splits) and the existing `strike = [-1.8, 0.06]` for each bolt. Kicks only, under 0.4 s each, faded out by `powerNear` for others. Lock-on keeps the boss framed; the camera never leaves the player.

## Images

- `img/thunder-call-1.webp`: a long serpentine dragon made of white-violet lightning edged with ember orange pouring down from a split sky and coiling around a boss, the swordsman raising the blade.
- `img/thunder-call-2.webp`: the impact frame of a lightning dragon striking a boss: the whole frame inverted to black and white with ember orange accents, hard bolt shapes.

# Cataclysm

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Id | `cataclysm` |
| Rarity | Legendary (ember orange `#e59a5c`), 1 level |
| Kind | Key 4, Ultimate |
| Trigger | `press`: key 4 with its charge full (42 points) |
| Origin | Kept from `js/data/abilities.js`. Changed: one level; 300 damage at radius 8 (was 180 at 7 and 240 at 8), charge 42 (was 40 and 36); the blast now lands after a ring of cracks instead of at once, and it gets its own look (it drew Meteor Fall's burst). |

## Card

**A blast hits all within {radius}.** (6 words, 26 chars)

- Icon (48×48 line drawing): a sword driven point-down into a short ground line, four crack lines running out from it, a half-dome arc over it.
- Hover loop (1.6 s): key cap "4" lights (0.2 s); a small figure drives the blade into the ground (0.3 s); ember cracks race out in a ring (0.4 s); a dome swells and bursts, the one brighter frame (0.2 s); slabs fall, fade (0.5 s).

## Idea

The one Ultimate that answers a crowd. The blade goes into the floor, ember cracks race out round you, and a dome of white fire rises and bursts. Every enemy within eight metres takes it, so it is the pick for the fights with two bosses and for the boss that calls its adds; against one boss it is a big, honest hit you have to be close to land.

## Data

```js
{ id: 'cataclysm', name: 'Cataclysm', rarity: 'legendary', key: 'ultimate',
  text: 'A blast hits all within {radius}.',
  power: { when: 'press', then: 'blast' },
  levels: [
    { charge: 42, radius: 8, damage: 360 },
  ] },
```

Numbers: 360 a cast for 42 points is 8.6 a point against one boss, on the dragon's floor of 8.4; against two bosses it is 720. It asks the holder to stand within 8 m, inside the boss's reach. Two or three casts a fight: 720-1080 on one boss, double that on two.

## Engine work

- `press/blast` exists (round the holder). New: the blast lands `CONFIG.abilities.powers.cataclysm.lead` = 0.45 s after the press (the cracks' run), centred where the holder stood at the press, so the cracks show the whole reach before it lands, as the bosses' own area attacks must (PLAN rework item 4).
- `js/ability-fx.js`: its own drawing for `power === 'cataclysm'` (Meteor Fall keeps the column-and-crater look).
- The floor slabs: one Blender model (`tools/blender/cataclysm_slabs.py`, six broken flagstones in one mesh with a bone each, baked to `js/baked/`), thrown and dropped by the effect.

## Multiplayer

The server resolves it at its `lead` from the press claim's position (checked against the body it knows, within its usual slack). It hits enemies only; a teammate inside the ring is untouched and sees the dome pass through them. No shared buff.

## Effect

Timed from the press (t = 0):

| t | Layer | Look | Colour |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0.00-0.20 | Anticipation | Upper-body pose: both hands on the hilt, the blade driven point-down into the floor. The world dims 20% | `#e59a5c` blade glow |
| 0.10-0.45 | Cracks | Eight jagged crack decals race out from the blade to the full 8 m radius, ember edges, white-hot cores; a thin ring traces the edge at the end | `#fff3dc` core, `#e59a5c` edge, `#0b0b0f` ink |
| 0.30-0.45 | Swell | A flat-shaded dome rises out of the cracks to 3 m high, 2 tones: white-hot top, ember skirt, a black ink outline | `#fff3dc`, `#e59a5c`, `#0b0b0f` |
| 0.45 | Peak (burst) | The dome bursts: a hard shock ring runs out to 8 m in 0.2 s; 40 sharp ember shards and 6 slabs thrown up. **The impact frame** | `#fff3dc` ring, `#e59a5c` shards |
| 0.45-1.10 | Slabs | Six floor slabs arc up 2-4 m and fall back with small dust bursts; 30 ember motes rise | `#4a4440` slabs, `#e59a5c` motes |
| 0.60-1.60 | Fade | The cracks cool from ember to dull red to black; a low heat shimmer over the ring | `#e59a5c` to `#7a1f12` to `#2a1a12` |

Budget (Legendary class): 13 pooled meshes (crack decal sheet, edge ring, dome, shock ring, slab model with 6 bones counted as 6, blade glow, heat plane, dust card ×2) + 40 + 30 + 24 dust = 94 particles (52 on Normal), 2 effect lights (the swell, the burst; × 0.65 on Normal), no ribbon, 1 impact frame at t = 0.45. Peak 0.65 s. Reduced motion: the impact frame becomes a 30% darken, no shake, the cracks fade in rather than race.

## Sound

`abilityBlast` kept as the burst (at t = 0.45). New `abilityCrack` before it: a grinding stone crack (brown noise, band-pass 300 to 900 Hz, sharp clicks every 40 ms, 0.4 s) from t = 0.05, and a rising sub (sine 30 to 55 Hz, 0.4 s) so the burst lands on a swell. Tail: falling slabs, three short thuds (low-pass noise 200 Hz, 60 ms each) at 0.8, 0.95 and 1.05 s.

## Camera

`CONFIG.camera.feel.powers.blast = [4, 0.24]` kept for the burst (a wide kick and a dip). Nothing during the cracks; the camera stays the player's.

## Images

- `img/cataclysm-1.webp`: the swordsman driving the blade into the ground as glowing ember cracks race outward in a ring and a white-hot dome of fire swells and bursts around a boss.
- `img/cataclysm-2.webp`: aerial view of a ring-shaped shockwave of ember fire bursting outward over a dark arena, floor slabs thrown up.

pool.md:
# World of Ink

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Id | `world-of-ink` |
| Rarity | Legendary (ember orange `#e59a5c`), 1 level |
| Kind | Key 4, Ultimate |
| Trigger | `press`: key 4 with its charge full (44 points) |
| Origin | New |

## Card

**For {time}, every hit lands twice in ink.** (8 words, 36 chars)

- Icon (48×48 line drawing): an open hand, palm out, inside a single broken brush circle.
- Hover loop (2.0 s): key cap "4" lights (0.2 s); a small figure opens its hand and a brush circle sweeps round the card (0.4 s), the card face turning to ink on paper, one brighter frame as the circle closes; three quick cuts, each followed a beat later by an ember brush stroke on the same line (1.0 s); the paper bleeds back to dark (0.4 s).

## Idea

A domain. You open your hand and the arena turns into an ink painting with the boss inside it: for six seconds every blow you land is painted again a beat later by a brush you never hold. It does nothing on its own; it makes your next six seconds count double, so it rewards the player who casts it right before a deflect, a counter string or a Finishing Blow. Its spectacle is the world itself changing colour.

## Data

```js
{ id: 'world-of-ink', name: 'World of Ink', rarity: 'legendary', key: 'ultimate',
  text: 'For {time}, every hit lands twice in ink.',
  power: { when: 'press', then: 'inkWorld' },
  levels: [
    { charge: 44, time: 8, share: 1 },
  ] },
```

Numbers: it is worth `share` of what the holder lands in `time`. A skilled player lands 25-40 damage a second in an open window, so 8 s × 30 × 1 = about 240, and a counter (about 42) or a Finishing Blow (480 on a boss) inside it lifts a well-timed cast to 400-700: on the dragon's floor of 8.4 a point for an ordinary cast, far over it for a timed one. That is the point: it is the Ultimate that rewards planning the window.

## Engine work

- New `press/inkWorld`: `['charge', 'time', 'share']`, a timer on the holder's perk clocks (`ink`, like `moon`), not on an enemy (it fires with no enemy in range).
- While it runs, every blow the holder lands (unblocked, the Finishing Blow's cuts included) is echoed on the same enemy 0.25 s later for `share` of its damage, through `abilityPowers`' `running` list like the twin's echo (`wound`, a power's blow: it never counts toward `hits`, a counter or a crack, and sets off no power).
- The ink circle (the ensō) is drawn at the boss's position at the press, radius `CONFIG.abilities.powers.inkWorld.radius` = 14 m; it is the look only: the echo works anywhere.
- The world grade: a new uniform on the output pass that lerps the scene toward ink (luminance mapped to black ink and paper white) inside the ensō for the local camera, with ember, the holder's red scarf and the boss's tells left in colour (the tells' materials skip the grade).
- `validate.js`: `inkWorld` needs `time`, `share` (a share).

## Multiplayer

The server runs the echo for the holder only: teammates' blows are never echoed, and a teammate is never touched. The grade is drawn for the holder at full strength and for teammates inside the ensō at half, so their reads stay clear (no slowing, moving or covering a friend's fight). One holder per team.

## Effect

Timed from the press (t = 0):

| t | Layer | Look | Colour |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0.00-0.40 | Anticipation | Upper-body pose: the off hand raised, palm open toward the boss, held. The world dims 20% | `#e59a5c` palm glow |
| 0.20-0.60 | Brush wave | A wave of ink-wash rolls out from the palm across the floor to the boss; colour drains behind it | `#0b0b0f` wave edge, `#e9e4d8` paper behind |
| 0.45-0.70 | Ensō | A giant brushed ink circle draws itself round the boss in one stroke, 14 m across, dry-brush gaps in it, an ember bleed on its inner edge | `#0b0b0f` stroke, `#e59a5c` bleed |
| 0.70 | Peak (the circle closes) | The stroke meets its start; the whole view snaps to ink inside the circle. **The impact frame** | `#0b0b0f` / `#e9e4d8` |
| 0.70-6.70 | The painting | Inside the circle the arena is ink on paper (2 tones and a mid-grey wash), falling ash turns to black ink flecks; the holder's scarf, the boss's wind-ups and every ember stay in colour | `#0b0b0f`, `#8a8478`, `#e9e4d8`; ember `#e59a5c` |
| each hit | Brush echo | 0.25 s after each of the holder's blows a flat ember brush stroke paints the same cut line, thick in the middle, dry at the ends, then a small black splatter | `#e59a5c` stroke, `#fff3dc` core, `#0b0b0f` splatter |
| 6.70-7.20 | Fade | The circle's ink runs and drips downward, the colour bleeds back from the edge inward | to the scene's own colours |

Budget (Legendary class for the opening, aura class after): opening 5 pooled meshes (brush wave, ensō ring, palm glow, splatter sheet, stroke pool head) + 40 ink flecks (22 on Normal), 1 effect light (palm), no ribbon, 1 impact frame at t = 0.70, peak 0.7 s. The 6 s hold is an aura: 4 meshes (ensō, 3 pooled echo strokes reused round-robin), 30 ink flecks (17 on Normal), no light (the ember strokes are the brightest thing in the painting), no flash. The grade is one uniform, no extra pass. Boss tells: the boss's weapon and wind-up glows are never graded, so nothing is hidden. Reduced motion: the impact frame becomes a 30% darken, no shake, and the grade fades in over 0.3 s instead of snapping.

## Sound

New `abilityInk`: a wet brush swipe (pink noise, band-pass 1.2 to 4 kHz over 0.3 s) at the palm, a deep paper thump at the closing (sine 60 to 35 Hz, 0.4 s, plus a dry tear of white noise 20 ms), and a tail where the world's sound goes muffled (the sfx bus low-passed to 2.2 kHz for the 6 s, restored over 0.4 s). Each echo: `abilityInkStroke`, a short brush flick (band-passed noise 2.5 kHz, 80 ms) and a low ink tap (110 Hz, 50 ms).

## Camera

`CONFIG.camera.feel.powers.inkWorld = [-2.6, 0.06]` at the closing (the view pulls in as the world turns), and each echo uses `echo = [-0.6, 0.02]`. Nothing else.

## Images

- `img/world-of-ink-1.webp`: a whole battle arena turned into a black ink-wash painting on pale paper inside a giant brushed ink circle, the boss trapped inside, ember orange brush strokes painting each sword hit.
- `img/world-of-ink-2.webp`: the moment the world turns to ink: a wave of ink-wash spreading from the swordsman's open hand across the arena, colour draining from everything.

pool.md:
# Heaven's Lance

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Id | `heavens-lance` |
| Rarity | Legendary (ember orange `#e59a5c`), 1 level |
| Kind | Key 4, Ultimate |
| Trigger | `press`: key 4 with its charge full (40 points) |
| Origin | New |

## Card

**A pillar of light pins the boss for {time}.** (9 words, 38 chars)

- Icon (48×48 line drawing): a tall narrow column falling from a gap in two cloud strokes onto a small ring on the ground.
- Hover loop (1.6 s): key cap "4" lights (0.2 s); a small figure points the blade up (0.2 s); a hole opens above a boss silhouette and a column drops onto it, one brighter frame (0.2 s); the boss stands black inside the column, burning ticks along its edge (0.8 s); the column thins to a line, fade (0.2 s).

## Idea

Point the blade at the sky and a pillar of white-gold light lances down onto the boss and holds it where it stands for two seconds, burning. Its gift is the pin: a boss that can't step, lunge or leap for two seconds, while it burns, is a boss you can read and punish. It still swings in place, with its own tells, so the pin opens a window rather than closing the fight.

## Data

```js
{ id: 'heavens-lance', name: "Heaven's Lance", rarity: 'legendary', key: 'ultimate',
  text: 'A pillar of light pins the boss for {time}.',
  power: { when: 'press', then: 'beam' },
  levels: [
    { charge: 40, time: 2, every: 0.2, damage: 30 },
  ] },
```

Numbers: 2 / 0.2 = 10 burns of 30 = 300 for 40 points, 7.5 a point, a little under the dragon's 8.4; the pin pays the rest (two seconds of a boss that can't close or escape, worth a full light string and a heavy, about 60-90 more). About 600-900 a fight with the pin's openings. On the bar.

## Engine work

- New `press/beam`: `['charge', 'time', 'every', 'damage']`, in `ON_ENEMY`; a `running` entry like `blades`, first burn 0.2 s after the column lands (t = 0.55), then every `every` s.
- **The pin** (new, shared with Frozen Lotus): the struck enemy's `rooted` timer is set to `time`. A rooted enemy can't move, lunge, leap or be pushed; it turns at half speed and its attacks run in place with their own tells (a lunge's step is skipped, its blow still swings). A boss that can't be held now (between phases, through a Finishing Blow) burns but isn't pinned.
- **Hold rest** (shared by every hold: pin, freeze, kneel): after any hold on an enemy ends, it can't be held again for `CONFIG.abilities.holdRest` = 3 s; the damage still lands. This keeps a party of four control legendaries from chaining a boss still.
- `validate.js`: `beam` needs its four numbers; `time / every` a whole number.

## Multiplayer

The server resolves it on the press's target and runs the pin on its own enemy (the server owns the boss's movement). A teammate inside the column is untouched and sees the light pass through them; the pin never touches a player. One holder per team.

## Effect

Timed from the press (t = 0):

| t | Layer | Look | Colour |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0.00-0.30 | Anticipation | Upper-body pose: the blade pointed straight up, the off hand on the pommel. The world dims 20%. A thin line of light climbs from the blade tip into the sky | `#fff6d8` line |
| 0.15-0.35 | Sigil | A ring of hard-edged light marks forms on the floor round the boss (its radius + 1 m), drawn clockwise in 0.2 s | `#e59a5c` ring, `#fff6d8` marks |
| 0.25-0.35 | Opening | The clouds over the boss part in a ragged hole; a white-gold disc shows inside | `#fff6d8`, `#e8c46a` rim |
| 0.35 | Peak (the lance lands) | A column 3 m wide drops from the hole to the floor in one frame: white-gold core, ember edges, a black ink outline; a shock ring at its foot, 30 sharp sparks. **The impact frame** | `#fff6d8` core, `#e59a5c` edge, `#0b0b0f` ink |
| 0.35-2.35 | Hold | The column stands; the boss is a black silhouette inside it; ash swirls up the column's edge; each burn sends a ring of 6 sparks up the column (the core holds steady: 5 burns a second must never pulse the light); the column goes 35% translucent within 2 m of the boss's weapon while it winds up | `#fff6d8`, `#e59a5c` sparks, `#5a5550` ash |
| 2.35-2.80 | Fade | The column thins to a line from the edges in and is drawn back up into the hole, which closes; the sigil cools and breaks into flakes | `#e59a5c` to transparent |

Budget (Legendary class): 7 pooled meshes (sky line, sigil ring, cloud hole disc, column, column inner core, shock ring, ash spiral sheet) + 30 + 10 × 6 + 40 ash = 130 particles at most (72 on Normal), 2 effect lights (the landing's flash; the column's foot, steady; × 0.65 on Normal), no ribbon, 1 impact frame at t = 0.35. Peak 2.0 s. Reduced motion: the impact frame becomes a 30% darken, no shake, the column fades in over 0.3 s instead of dropping.

## Sound

New `abilityLance`: a rising choir tone (sine partials at 1, 1.5 and 2 over 440 Hz, swelling 0.3 s) during the anticipation; at the landing a hard crack (high-passed white noise, 25 ms) over a deep boom (sine 50 to 30 Hz, 0.8 s); the hold is a steady roar of light (band-passed pink noise at 1.8 kHz with a slow tremolo, 2 s) with a sizzle tick on each burn (white noise 6 kHz, 30 ms). Tail: the tone falling a fifth as the column lifts.

## Camera

`CONFIG.camera.feel.powers.beam = [-2.8, 0.1]` at the landing (the view tightens on the pinned boss). No kick on the burns.

## Images

- `img/heavens-lance-1.webp`: a colossal pillar of white-gold light with ember orange edges lancing down from a hole in the dark clouds onto a boss, a glowing ring on the ground, the swordsman pointing the blade skyward.
- `img/heavens-lance-2.webp`: the boss silhouetted black inside a column of blinding white-gold light, ash swirling around the column.

pool.md:
# Phoenix Dive

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Id | `phoenix-dive` |
| Rarity | Legendary (ember orange `#e59a5c`), 1 level |
| Kind | Key 4, Ultimate |
| Trigger | `press`: key 4 with its charge full (42 points) |
| Origin | New |

## Card

**Dive through the boss {strikes} times in fire.** (8 words, 38 chars)

- Icon (48×48 line drawing): a bird's spread wings and long tail drawn in three strokes, diving down-left, a small X behind it.
- Hover loop (1.8 s): key cap "4" lights (0.2 s); a small figure crouches and bursts into a bird of flame (0.2 s); three dives through a boss silhouette from three sides, each leaving a fire line, the lines crossing into a star, one brighter frame on the third (0.9 s); the figure lands in a held pose as the star burns (0.5 s).

## Idea

The Ultimate that is you. You burst into a great bird of fire and dive through the boss three times from three angles, untouchable while you fly, then land in a held pose as the crossed trails burn behind you. It is the Finishing Blow's flash steps grown into a technique: the body itself becomes the effect. It also gets you out of trouble, because you can't be hit while you are a bird.

## Data

```js
{ id: 'phoenix-dive', name: 'Phoenix Dive', rarity: 'legendary', key: 'ultimate',
  text: 'Dive through the boss {strikes} times in fire.',
  power: { when: 'press', then: 'phoenix' },
  levels: [
    { charge: 42, strikes: 3, damage: 120 },
  ] },
```

Numbers: 3 × 120 = 360 for 42 points, 8.6 a point, on the dragon's floor of 8.4, plus a 1.55 s untouchable (a cast in the middle of a boss combo dodges the rest of it). 720-1080 a fight.

## Engine work

- New `press/phoenix`: `['charge', 'strikes', 'damage']`, in `ON_ENEMY`.
- The dive is the holder's own movement, like the Finishing Blow's flash steps (`js/finisher.js`): `strikes` dives, each 0.3 s, through the target's body from three angles 120° apart (`CONFIG.abilities.powers.phoenix`: `rise` 4 m, `past` 3 m beyond the far edge, `gap` 0.12 s between dives), driven as a velocity so the body physics keeps it out of walls and off edges. Each dive's pass through the body lands `damage` on the target and every enemy within 1.5 m of the path.
- The holder is untouchable from the burst to the landing (0.25-1.8 s) and for `grace` 0.2 s after; the Ultimate's key pose replaces the run, the camera stays theirs; at the end, control is back at once, as after a Finishing Blow.
- The player's body is hidden during the dives and the phoenix model drawn in its place.
- `validate.js`: `phoenix` needs `strikes` (whole) and `damage`.

## Multiplayer

The client owns its own movement, so it moves its body along the dives from the server-confirmed press, and claims each pass; the server checks each against the path it worked out from the same target (range and timing) and resolves the damage. The holder's untouchable time is checked like a dodge's. Teammates in the path are untouched; the bird passes through them. One holder per team.

## Model

The phoenix is a Blender model, `tools/blender/phoenix.py`: a firebird about 5 m from beak to tail tip, 6 m wingspan, flat-shaded hard planes (a swept head, two wings of four long feather blades each, a tail of five streamers 3 m long), its own bones (wing root, wing tip, tail ×3). Material: the effect shader, white-hot core faces, ember outer faces, a black ink rim. Animations: `burst` (unfolding from a ball, 0.2 s), `dive` (wings swept back, tail streaming), `turn` (a wing beat up and over, 0.12 s), `fold` (into the player's landing, 0.15 s). Baked to `js/baked/`; one in the pool, warmed at load.

## Effect

Timed from the press (t = 0):

| t | Layer | Look | Colour |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0.00-0.25 | Anticipation | A crouch on the spot, blade held low behind; ember feathers flicker up off the scarf and shoulders; the world dims 20% | `#e59a5c` feathers |
| 0.25-0.45 | Burst | The body vanishes in a ball of white fire that unfolds into the phoenix, rising 4 m; 24 burning feathers scatter | `#fff3dc` core, `#e59a5c` wings, `#0b0b0f` ink |
| 0.45-0.75 | Dive 1 | It dives through the boss: a fire trail ribbon 1.5 m wide along the path, a burst of 16 sparks at the pass | `#e59a5c` trail, `#fff3dc` core |
| 0.87-1.17 | Dive 2 | A wing beat up and over, then through from 120° round; its trail crosses the first | as above |
| 1.29-1.59 | Dive 3 (peak) | The third pass; the three trails form a burning star through the boss. **The impact frame** on the third pass | as above |
| 1.59-1.80 | Landing | The bird folds into the player in a held pose 3 m past the boss, back turned, blade out to the side; a shock ring at the feet | `#e59a5c` ring |
| 1.80-3.00 | Burn | The three trails hang in the air and burn down from their ends inward; feathers drift down and go out | `#e59a5c` to `#7a1f12` to transparent |

Budget (Legendary class): 8 pooled meshes (the phoenix model, burst sphere, 3 trail sheets, shock ring, landing ring, blade glow) + 24 feathers + 3 × 16 sparks + 30 embers = 102 particles (56 on Normal), 2 effect lights (one riding the bird, steady, so the passes light the arena as it moves and never strobe; one for the third pass and the landing; × 0.65 on Normal), 2 ribbons (the bird's two tail streamers' trail), 1 impact frame at t = 1.29. Peak 1.35 s (0.45-1.80). Reduced motion: the impact frame becomes a 30% darken, no shake.

## Sound

New `abilityPhoenix`: a fire whoosh as it bursts (pink noise, band-pass 400 to 1800 Hz, 0.3 s) with a bird's high cry (a saw at 1.6 kHz bending to 2.4 kHz and back, 0.25 s, heavy reverb); each dive a roaring pass-by (low-passed noise sweeping 300 to 1200 Hz and back, a fast pan from one side to the other, 0.3 s) with a crackle at the pass; the third pass adds `abilityBlast`'s transient. The landing: a soft fire thump and embers ticking.

## Camera

`CONFIG.camera.feel.powers.phoenix = [3.2, 0.1]` at the burst; each pass uses `strike = [-1.8, 0.06]`. The camera follows the holder's body through the dives as it follows any move (it never cuts or orbits).

## Images

- `img/phoenix-dive-1.webp`: the swordsman transformed into a great ember orange firebird with a white-hot core and long tail feathers diving through a boss, earlier fiery trails crossing in the air.
- `img/phoenix-dive-2.webp`: the swordsman landing in a held pose with burning feathers drifting down while three crossing fire trails burn across the boss behind them.

pool.md:
# Severance

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Id | `severance` |
| Rarity | Legendary (ember orange `#e59a5c`), 1 level |
| Kind | Key 4, Ultimate |
| Trigger | `press`: key 4 with its charge full (46 points) |
| Origin | New |

## Card

**One arena-wide cut hits all on its line.** (8 words, 40 chars)

- Icon (48×48 line drawing): a single straight diagonal line across the whole icon, the two halves of a small circle (the boss) offset along it.
- Hover loop (1.4 s): key cap "4" lights (0.2 s); a small figure stands still, hand on the hilt (0.3 s); one instant draw, a line across the whole card (one frame); the two halves of the card slide apart along it, the brighter frame showing white void in the gap (0.3 s); they snap back, a crack along the boss (0.2 s); hold, fade.

## Idea

The stillest technique in the game. A held breath, one draw too fast to see, and a single line runs across the whole arena; for a moment the two halves of the world slide apart on it, then snap back with the boss cut. No travel, no aim beyond facing: whatever is on the line is cut. It is the calligraphy stroke of the pool, all anticipation and one clean result.

## Data

```js
{ id: 'severance', name: 'Severance', rarity: 'legendary', key: 'ultimate',
  text: 'One arena-wide cut hits all on its line.',
  power: { when: 'press', then: 'worldCut' },
  levels: [
    { charge: 46, damage: 360 },
  ] },
```

Numbers: 360 in one blow for 46 points, 7.8 a point, just under the dragon's 8.4; it can't miss and it lands everything at once (no strikes lost to a phase change), and it cuts every enemy on its line, so two bosses lined up take 720. About 720-1000 a fight. On the bar.

## Engine work

- New `press/worldCut`: `['charge', 'damage']`, in `ON_ENEMY` for its aim.
- The line runs from the holder through the target's centre and on, `CONFIG.abilities.powers.worldCut.length` = 40 m each way; every enemy whose body is within `width` 1.2 m of it takes `damage` at the snap (t = 0.75). Its direction is fixed at the draw (t = 0.35); the line is shown from then, so a second boss can see it coming.
- The split: a screen pass (one full-screen quad, made at load) that samples the finished frame with the two sides of the line's screen projection offset 6 px apart along its normal, a white void showing in the gap. 0.4 s at most. Normal draws it too (VISION: Normal keeps every effect), at 4 px.
- `validate.js`: `worldCut` needs `damage`.

## Multiplayer

The server resolves it from the press claim, with the line from the holder's position at the draw (checked like any press) through the target. Enemies only: a teammate on the line is never cut. Every browser draws the line; the screen split is drawn only by browsers whose view the line crosses, and within `powerNear`. One holder per team.

## Effect

Timed from the press (t = 0):

| t | Layer | Look | Colour |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0.00-0.35 | Anticipation | Upper-body pose: low stance, hand on the hilt, the blade half drawn; the world dims 20% and the falling ash slows to a crawl round the holder (the drawing only) | `#e59a5c` thin glint on the hilt |
| 0.35 | Draw | One frame: the blade is out and back; a razor line appears across the arena, 40 m each way, hair-thin white with an ember glow either side | `#fff3dc` line, `#e59a5c` glow |
| 0.35-0.60 | Hold | The line hangs in the air, still; black ink beads along it; nothing else moves in the effect | `#0b0b0f` beads |
| 0.60-0.75 | Split | The two halves of the world slide apart on the line (the screen pass), a white void with an ember edge in the gap | `#fff3dc` void, `#e59a5c` edge |
| 0.75 | Peak (the snap) | The halves snap back; the cut opens across the boss in a bright seam, 30 sharp shards fly from it along the line. **The impact frame** | `#fff3dc` seam, `#e59a5c` shards, `#0b0b0f` ink |
| 0.75-1.40 | Fade | The line fades from its ends inward to the boss; the seam on the boss glows and closes; the holder's held pose: blade sheathing slowly, back half-turned | `#e59a5c` to transparent |

Budget (Legendary class): 5 pooled meshes (cut line, glow sheet, ink bead strip, boss seam, hilt glint) + the screen pass (one quad, made at load) + 30 shards + 20 ink beads = 50 particles (28 on Normal), 1 effect light at the seam (× 0.65 on Normal), no ribbon, 1 impact frame at t = 0.75. Peak 0.4 s (0.35-0.75). The split never covers a boss's wind-up for longer than its 0.15 s. Reduced motion: no screen split (the line and the seam only), the impact frame becomes a 30% darken, no shake.

## Sound

New `abilitySever`: silence first (the sfx bus ducked 60% for the 0.35 s anticipation); the draw a single very short high ring (sine 3.2 kHz with partials at 2.76 and 5.4, 5 ms attack, 0.9 s decay); the snap a dry, enormous cut (white noise high-passed at 2 kHz, 30 ms, heavy drive) over a sub drop (sine 70 to 25 Hz, 0.6 s). Tail: the ring decaying and the room's sound coming back up over 0.4 s.

## Camera

`CONFIG.camera.feel.powers.worldCut = [-3.4, 0.04]` at the snap (a hard pull in). No kick at the draw: the stillness is the point.

## Images

- `img/severance-1.webp`: a single razor-straight cut across the entire scene, the two halves of the world sliding apart with a blinding ember-white gap, the boss split along the line, the swordsman sheathing the blade.
- `img/severance-2.webp`: close on the swordsman in a held pose after a single draw, the world behind them cut in half along a glowing line.

pool.md:
# Great Wave

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Id | `great-wave` |
| Rarity | Legendary (ember orange `#e59a5c`), 1 level |
| Kind | Key 4, Ultimate |
| Trigger | `press`: key 4 with its charge full (42 points) |
| Origin | New |

## Card

**A wave crashes over all in front.** (7 words, 33 chars)

- Icon (48×48 line drawing): a tall wave crest curling over to the right with three foam claws on its lip, a tiny figure at its foot.
- Hover loop (1.8 s): key cap "4" lights (0.2 s); a small figure raises the blade like a conductor (0.3 s); a wave rises behind it, taller than the card's boss silhouette, foam claws curling (0.6 s); it crashes forward, the brighter frame on the crash (0.2 s); spray and a flat foam sheet run out, fade (0.5 s).

## Idea

The blade raised like a conductor's: a painted wave taller than the boss rises behind you, curls over in foam claws and crashes down on everything in front of you. It is Riptide's water grown into the biggest single shape in the pool, and it rewards positioning: line up the boss, or both bosses, in the sixteen metres ahead and bring the sea down on them.

## Data

```js
{ id: 'great-wave', name: 'Great Wave', rarity: 'legendary', key: 'ultimate',
  text: 'A wave crashes over all in front.',
  power: { when: 'press', then: 'greatWave' },
  levels: [
    { charge: 42, damage: 340, width: 10, reach: 16 },
  ] },
```

Numbers: 340 for 42 points is 8.1 a point on one boss, on the dragon's floor; a 10 × 16 m area makes it 680 on two bosses and clears adds. 680-1020 a fight on one boss.

## Engine work

- New `press/greatWave`: `['charge', 'damage', 'width', 'reach']`. Not in `ON_ENEMY`: it fires with no enemy, along the holder's facing, or toward the target if there is one.
- The hit is a box `width` wide and `reach` long from the holder's position at the press, aimed at the press; every enemy in it takes `damage` once at the crash (t = 0.95). The `wave` resolver (Riptide, Tidal Arc) already hits a line `reach` × `width`: reuse it with a delay.
- The wave: a Blender model, `tools/blender/great_wave.py`: one curling crest 12 m wide and 9 m tall in flat bands (deep body, mid band, foam lip with five claw shapes), with a shape key from rising (low, leaning back) to curled (lip over) to crashed (flat); the effect drives the shape key and slides it forward. Baked to `js/baked/`.
- `validate.js`: `greatWave` needs its four numbers.

## Multiplayer

The server resolves the box from the press claim's position and aim, at the crash. The wave hits enemies only and never pushes anyone; a teammate in front sees it crash through them. One holder per team.

## Effect

Timed from the press (t = 0):

| t | Layer | Look | Colour |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0.00-0.30 | Anticipation | Upper-body pose: the blade raised high in one hand, the other hand open behind; the world dims 20%; water beads lift off the floor round the feet and hang | `#8fb8dc` beads, `#e59a5c` blade glow |
| 0.20-0.70 | Rise | The wave rises out of the floor behind the holder, 9 m tall, leaning back; flat painted bands with black ink lines between them; ember light glints on its face from the blade | `#1f2a5c` body, `#2c5f8a` band, `#f2f6fa` foam, `#e59a5c` glints, `#0b0b0f` ink |
| 0.70-0.95 | Curl | It surges forward over the holder and the lip curls over in five foam claws; spray streaks fly off the lip | `#f2f6fa` claws, `#e59a5c` lit spray |
| 0.95 | Peak (the crash) | The lip comes down across the whole box; a flat foam sheet slams out to the box's edges; 40 spray streaks thrown up. **The impact frame** | `#f2f6fa` sheet, `#e59a5c` spray |
| 0.95-1.60 | Run | The water runs on to the far end of the box as a low foam line, ember-lit spray falling in arcs | `#2c5f8a`, `#f2f6fa`, `#e59a5c` |
| 1.60-2.30 | Fade | The foam sheet breaks into flat rings and drains into the floor; a wet sheen on the stone that fades | `#8fb8dc` to transparent |

Budget (Legendary class): 7 pooled meshes (wave model, foam sheet, foam rings ×2, spray card sheet, blade glow, wet sheen decal) + 24 beads + 40 spray + 30 droplets = 94 particles (52 on Normal), 2 effect lights (one on the wave's face from the blade, one at the crash; × 0.65 on Normal), no ribbon, 1 impact frame at t = 0.95. Peak 0.65 s. The wave is opaque only behind the boss; in front of a boss winding up it goes 35% translucent within 2 m of the weapon. Reduced motion: the impact frame becomes a 30% darken, no shake.

## Sound

New `abilityGreatWave`: a deep inhale of water as it rises (brown noise, low-pass rising 200 to 900 Hz over 0.7 s, slow swell), a hiss of spray off the lip (high-passed noise at 5 kHz, 0.25 s), the crash (`abilityBlast`'s transient with a band-passed noise body at 600 Hz, 1.2 s) and a long tail of water running away (pink noise, band-pass falling 1.2 kHz to 300 Hz, 1 s). `abilityWave`'s slap layered on the crash ties it to Riptide.

## Camera

`CONFIG.camera.feel.powers.greatWave = [3.6, 0.2]` at the crash (wide and heavy). Nothing during the rise; the camera stays the player's, so a wave rising behind them reads from their own view.

## Images

- `img/great-wave-1.webp`: a towering painted-style wave of deep indigo water with white foam claws and ember-lit spray rising behind the swordsman and curling over a boss.
- `img/great-wave-2.webp`: the great wave crashing down on the boss, foam claws and spray filling the frame.

pool.md:
# Black Star

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Id | `black-star` |
| Rarity | Legendary (ember orange `#e59a5c`), 1 level |
| Kind | Key 4, Ultimate |
| Trigger | `press`: key 4 with its charge full (44 points) |
| Origin | New |

## Card

**Holds the boss for {time}, then implodes.** (7 words, 36 chars)

- Icon (48×48 line drawing): a solid black disc ringed by one thin bent circle, four short inward strokes round it.
- Hover loop (1.8 s): key cap "4" lights (0.2 s); a small figure throws from an open palm, a dot flying to the boss (0.3 s); the dot swells into a black sphere with an ember corona, the boss stuck inside, ash spiralling in (0.8 s); it collapses to a point, the brighter frame (0.1 s); a ring of lines, fade (0.4 s).

## Idea

A tiny black sun forms in your palm and is thrown at the boss. It swells, holds the boss still in its pull for a breath and a half while ash and grit spiral in, then collapses into a point with a deafening silence and a white flash. It is the Ultimate of patience: the hold is the window, the implosion the payoff, and anything small nearby is dragged in with it.

## Data

```js
{ id: 'black-star', name: 'Black Star', rarity: 'legendary', key: 'ultimate',
  text: 'Holds the boss for {time}, then implodes.',
  power: { when: 'press', then: 'blackStar' },
  levels: [
    { charge: 44, time: 1.5, damage: 320, radius: 5 },
  ] },
```

Numbers: 320 for 44 points is 7.3 a point; the 1.5 s hold is the difference (a boss that can't swing for 1.5 s is a free light string, about 60-80, and a moment to heal). 320 on every enemy within 5 m, so more on two bosses. About 640-960 a fight on one boss with the hold's hits. On the bar.

## Engine work

- New `press/blackStar`: `['charge', 'time', 'damage', 'radius']`, in `ON_ENEMY`.
- The star travels 0.35 s from the palm to the target's centre and stays where it reached. On arrival every enemy within `radius` m is held: its `frozen` timer (Time Rift's: no step, no blow, no hitbox) set to `time`; ordinary enemies within `radius` are also drawn toward the centre at 3 m/s (bosses are held in place). At `time` after arrival it implodes: `damage` to every enemy within `radius`.
- The shared hold rest (`CONFIG.abilities.holdRest`, see Heaven's Lance): a boss held in the last 3 s still takes the implosion but isn't held again. A boss that can't be held now takes the damage only.
- `validate.js`: `blackStar` needs its four numbers.

## Multiplayer

The server resolves the hold and the implosion on its own enemies from the press claim. Enemies only: the star never pulls, slows or hurts a player; a teammate inside it sees the sphere around them, drawn 50% translucent for them. One holder per team.

## Effect

Timed from the press (t = 0):

| t | Layer | Look | Colour |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0.00-0.30 | Anticipation | Upper-body pose: the off arm out, palm up; a black point forms over the palm with a thin ember ring; the light round the holder bends toward it; the world dims 20% | `#0b0b0f` point, `#e59a5c` ring |
| 0.30-0.65 | Throw | The point flies to the boss on a slight arc, a bent-light trail behind it | `#ece6ff` trail |
| 0.65-0.85 | Swell | It swells to a black sphere `radius` × 0.6 across, a hard ember corona round it, a ring of bent light (a refraction ring sampling the frame behind) tilted across it; the boss stops dead inside | `#0b0b0f` sphere, `#e59a5c` corona, `#ece6ff` ring |
| 0.85-2.15 | Pull | Ash, grit and floor chips spiral in along curved streaks; the corona flickers; the boss is a dark shape inside, its edges ember-lit | `#5a5550` ash, `#e59a5c` streaks |
| 2.15 | Peak (implosion) | The sphere collapses to a point in 3 frames, then a white flash and a ring of shock lines out to `radius`. **The impact frame** | `#fff3dc` flash, `#0b0b0f` lines |
| 2.15-2.90 | Fade | A hollow ring of ember sparks hangs where it was, then falls; a dark scorch circle on the floor cools | `#e59a5c` to `#2a1a12` |

Budget (Legendary class): 7 pooled meshes (palm point, throw trail, sphere, corona, refraction ring, shock-line sheet, scorch disc) + 60 spiral streaks + 30 sparks = 90 particles (50 on Normal), 2 effect lights (the corona, a cold dim light that darkens rather than lights; the implosion flash; × 0.65 on Normal), 1 ribbon (the throw trail), 1 impact frame at t = 2.15. Peak 1.5 s (0.65-2.15). The held boss can't attack, so nothing covers a tell. Reduced motion: the impact frame becomes a 30% darken, no shake, the refraction ring holds still.

## Sound

New `abilityBlackStar`: a low suck of air into the palm (pink noise, band-pass falling 3 kHz to 200 Hz, 0.35 s); during the pull a deep drone that bends downward (sine 55 Hz falling to 38 Hz, with a slow FM wobble) and grit ticks; at the implosion **silence**: every sfx bus ducked to 10% for 0.25 s, then a single soft thump (sine 40 Hz, 0.3 s) and the room's sound returning with a reversed-reverb swell.

## Camera

`CONFIG.camera.feel.powers.blackStar = [-3, 0.04]` at the implosion (the view sucked in), and `starPull = [-1, 0]` at 0.9 and 1.5 s through the pull (kicks only, under 0.4 s each).

## Images

- `img/black-star-1.webp`: a black sphere with an ember orange corona and a ring of bent light swallowing a boss, ash and debris spiralling inward, the swordsman with an outstretched palm.
- `img/black-star-2.webp`: the implosion of a black star: a white flash collapsing to a point over the arena, shockwave lines.

pool.md:
# Colossus

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Id | `colossus` |
| Rarity | Legendary (ember orange `#e59a5c`), 1 level |
| Kind | Key 4, Ultimate |
| Trigger | `press`: key 4 with its charge full (46 points) |
| Origin | New |

## Card

**A giant of embers swings its sword once.** (8 words, 40 chars)

- Icon (48×48 line drawing): a huge armoured shoulder and helm outline behind a tiny figure, one long sword line sweeping across the bottom.
- Hover loop (2.0 s): key cap "4" lights (0.2 s); a small figure takes a stance and a giant outline rises behind it in the same stance (0.6 s); both raise their blades (0.3 s); the giant's sword sweeps across the card through the boss, the brighter frame on the hit (0.3 s); the giant crumbles to embers, fade (0.6 s).

## Idea

A warrior of embers twenty metres tall rises out of the floor behind you, takes your stance, and swings one enormous sword through the boss. It is the shadow behind the hero made real: you and it move as one for a breath, then it is gone. One swing, the widest arc in the pool, everything in front of you within fourteen metres.

## Data

```js
{ id: 'colossus', name: 'Colossus', rarity: 'legendary', key: 'ultimate',
  text: 'A giant of embers swings its sword once.',
  power: { when: 'press', then: 'colossus' },
  levels: [
    { charge: 46, damage: 340, reach: 14 },
  ] },
```

Numbers: 340 in one blow for 46 points, 7.4 a point on one boss, a little under the dragon's 8.4; the swing is a 150° arc 14 m deep, so two bosses take 680 and every add in front is cleared. About 680-1000 a fight. On the bar with the area: the 150° arc is worth the gap on one boss.

## Engine work

- New `press/colossus`: `['charge', 'damage', 'reach']`. Not in `ON_ENEMY`: aimed at the target, or the holder's facing with none.
- The swing lands at t = 1.15: `damage` to every enemy whose body is within `reach` m of the holder's position at the press and within `CONFIG.abilities.powers.colossus.arc` = 150° of the aim. The arc is shown on the floor from t = 0.5 (the giant's shadow), so it reads like a told attack.
- The giant is a Blender model (below), its pose driven by the holder's own cast pose and a swing clip of its own.
- `validate.js`: `colossus` needs `damage`, `reach`.

## Multiplayer

The server resolves the arc from the press claim's position and aim at the swing. Enemies only; the giant's sword passes through teammates. Every browser draws the giant (it is the biggest shape in the pool and the party should see it), at full strength within `powerNear` and 50% translucent beyond. One holder per team.

## Model

`tools/blender/colossus.py`: an armoured giant drawn as a shell of molten seams over dark ash plates, 20 m tall when standing (it rises only to the waist out of the floor, so about 12 m shows), a closed helm with two hollow glowing eye slits, a long sword of fire 16 m long. Hard planes, no fine detail (it is seen huge and briefly): about 3k triangles, a skin of 18 bones (spine ×3, arms, hands, helm, sword). Material: the effect shader with an emissive seam map (white-hot seams, ember edges) and ash-black plates with a black ink rim. Animations: `rise` (out of the floor to the waist, 0.5 s), `stance` (mirrors the holder's cast pose), `swing` (a two-handed horizontal cut, wind-up 0.3 s, strike 0.15 s, follow-through 0.3 s), `crumble` (plates fall away as embers, 0.7 s). Baked to `js/baked/`, one in the pool, warmed at load. Seen in the game, not only in previews, before it ships.

## Effect

Timed from the press (t = 0):

| t | Layer | Look | Colour |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0.00-0.30 | Anticipation | Upper-body pose: a wide two-handed stance, blade back over the shoulder; the world dims 20%; the floor behind the holder cracks in a long seam | `#e59a5c` seam |
| 0.20-0.70 | Rise | The giant rises out of the seam to its waist, plates shedding ash, eye slits lighting last | `#2a2420` plates, `#fff3dc` seams, `#e59a5c` edges, `#0b0b0f` ink |
| 0.50-0.85 | Mirror | It takes the holder's stance; its fire sword ignites from hilt to tip; its shadow lays the arc on the floor | `#e59a5c` sword, `#fff3dc` core |
| 0.85-1.15 | Wind-up | Both blades go back together; ember motes stream off the giant | `#e59a5c` |
| 1.15 | Peak (the swing) | The sword sweeps the arc in 0.15 s: a flat smear 14 m long across the arc, white-hot core, ember edge, black ink outline; 40 sparks off the boss. **The impact frame** | `#fff3dc`, `#e59a5c`, `#0b0b0f` |
| 1.15-1.45 | Follow-through | The giant holds the end of the swing; the smear hangs and burns down; the holder holds the same pose | `#e59a5c` |
| 1.45-2.15 | Crumble | Plates fall away from the helm down as glowing embers and ash; the floor seam closes | `#e59a5c` to `#5a5550` |

Budget (Legendary class): 6 pooled meshes (giant model, its fire sword, swing smear, floor arc, floor seam, eye glow) + 40 sparks + 60 embers + 30 ash = 130 particles (72 on Normal), 2 effect lights (the giant's chest seams, the swing; × 0.65 on Normal), 1 ribbon (the sword tip's trail), 1 impact frame at t = 1.15. Peak 0.65 s (0.85-1.45). The giant stands behind the holder and goes 35% translucent where it overlaps a boss winding up. Reduced motion: the impact frame becomes a 30% darken, no shake.

## Sound

New `abilityColossus`: the rise is a grinding of stone and a furnace roar (brown noise, low-pass 150 to 600 Hz, 0.5 s, plus a crackling fire layer); the wind-up a huge breath in (filtered noise rising 200 to 1 kHz, 0.3 s); the swing a deep whoosh (band-passed noise sweeping 120 to 900 Hz in 0.15 s, panned across) into `abilityBlast`'s transient; the crumble a long fall of embers (crackles over a decaying low rumble, 0.7 s).

## Camera

`CONFIG.camera.feel.powers.colossus = [4.4, 0.18]` at the swing (one of the widest kicks, under Sky Blade's and the Bell's). `colossusRise = [1.2, 0]` at the rise. The camera stays behind the player; the giant is seen rising over their shoulder from their own view.

## Images

- `img/colossus-1.webp`: a twenty-metre giant warrior made of molten ember lines and dark ash rising behind the swordsman and swinging an enormous fire sword through a boss.
- `img/colossus-2.webp`: low angle of the ember giant mirroring the swordsman's stance, both blades raised, the boss tiny before it.

pool.md:
# Frozen Lotus

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Id | `frozen-lotus` |
| Rarity | Legendary (ember orange `#e59a5c`), 1 level |
| Kind | Key 4, Ultimate |
| Trigger | `press`: key 4 with its charge full (42 points) |
| Origin | New |

## Card

**Ice spears the boss for {time}.** (6 words, 26 chars)

- Icon (48×48 line drawing): a lotus of six pointed petals seen from the side, two petals stabbing up taller than the rest.
- Hover loop (2.0 s): key cap "4" lights (0.2 s); a frost ring spreads under a boss silhouette (0.3 s); a lotus opens under it and petals spear up through it one by one, one brighter frame on the first (0.9 s); the flower shatters into shards (0.4 s); fade.

## Idea

An enormous lotus of ice blooms under the boss, and its petals spear up through it one after another for three seconds, holding it where it stands; then the whole flower shatters. It is the slow, beautiful Ultimate: a long pin and a steady burn, the boss framed in a flower of ice while you work round it. Ember light caught in the ice keeps it in the legendary colour.

## Data

```js
{ id: 'frozen-lotus', name: 'Frozen Lotus', rarity: 'legendary', key: 'ultimate',
  text: 'Ice spears the boss for {time}.',
  power: { when: 'press', then: 'iceLotus' },
  levels: [
    { charge: 42, time: 3, every: 0.3, damage: 36 },
  ] },
```

Numbers: 3 / 0.3 = 10 petals of 36 = 360 for 42 points, 8.6 a point, on the dragon's floor; the pin is 3 s (the longest in the pool), worth a light string and a heavy finisher or a free heal, about 80-100 more. About 720-1080 a fight plus the pin's openings.

## Engine work

- New `press/iceLotus`: `['charge', 'time', 'every', 'damage']`, in `ON_ENEMY`; a `running` entry like `blades`, first petal 0.45 s after the press, then every `every` s.
- The pin (shared with Heaven's Lance): the target's `rooted` timer set to `time` from the first petal; it can't move, lunge, leap or be pushed, turns at half speed, and its attacks swing in place with their own tells. The shared hold rest (`CONFIG.abilities.holdRest`, 3 s) applies.
- The lotus: a Blender model, `tools/blender/ice_lotus.py`: a flower 7 m across of twelve faceted petals in two rings, each petal its own bone so it can spear up (a 4 m thrust) and fall back; a translucent ice material with ember-lit facet edges. Baked to `js/baked/`.
- `validate.js`: `iceLotus` needs its four numbers; `time / every` a whole number.

## Multiplayer

The server resolves the petals and runs the pin on its own enemy. Enemies only; a teammate standing on the flower is untouched and sees petals pass through them. One holder per team.

## Effect

Timed from the press (t = 0):

| t | Layer | Look | Colour |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0.00-0.30 | Anticipation | Upper-body pose: the blade's point lowered to the floor, the off hand flat over it; the world dims 20%; a line of frost runs from the point to the boss | `#cfe8f5` frost |
| 0.20-0.45 | Bloom | A frost ring spreads under the boss, then the lotus opens out of it, petals unfolding flat; frost fog rolls off its edges | `#cfe8f5` ice, `#5f8fb0` depth, `#e59a5c` facet edges, `#0b0b0f` ink |
| 0.45 | Peak (first petal) | The first inner petal spears up through the boss, 4 m; a burst of 20 ice shards. **The impact frame** | `#ffffff` core, `#cfe8f5`, `#e59a5c` edges |
| 0.75-3.15 | Petals | Every 0.3 s another petal spears up from a new angle and the last one sinks back, so three stand at once; each throws 8 shards and catches ember light | as above |
| 3.15-3.55 | Shatter | The whole flower cracks along its facets and bursts into glittering shards, the ember light refracting through them | `#ffffff`, `#cfe8f5`, `#e59a5c` glints |
| 3.55-4.20 | Fade | Shards fall and melt to a dark wet ring; the fog thins | `#5f8fb0` to transparent |

Budget (Legendary class): 6 pooled meshes (frost line, frost ring, lotus model, fog sheet, shatter shard sheet, wet ring) + 20 + 10 × 8 + 50 shatter shards = 150 particles at most over the effect, never more than 110 alive at once (61 on Normal), 2 effect lights (cold blue inside the flower, ember on the petal facets; × 0.65 on Normal), no ribbon, 1 impact frame at t = 0.45. Peak 2.7 s (0.45-3.15). The petals stand behind and beside the boss; a petal never rises in front of its weapon during a wind-up (the petal angle skips that side). Reduced motion: the impact frame becomes a 30% darken, no shake.

## Sound

New `abilityLotus`: a creaking freeze as it blooms (band-passed noise 2-6 kHz with sharp crackles, 0.3 s) and a glassy bell chord (sine partials at 1, 2.76 and 5.4 over 880 Hz, 1.5 s decay); each petal a sharp ice spike (white noise at 4 kHz, 20 ms, over a short low crunch at 180 Hz, 80 ms), pitch rising a semitone each; the shatter a cascade of glass (many short high bandpassed clicks over 0.5 s) and a deep crack (sine 60 Hz, 0.3 s).

## Camera

`CONFIG.camera.feel.powers.iceLotus = [-2.2, 0.06]` at the first petal, and `lotusBreak = [1.4, 0.04]` at the shatter. No kick on the petals between.

## Images

- `img/frozen-lotus-1.webp`: an enormous translucent ice lotus with ember-lit edges blooming under a boss, its petals spearing up through it one after another, frost fog.
- `img/frozen-lotus-2.webp`: the ice lotus shattering into thousands of glittering shards around the boss, ember light refracting.

pool.md:
# Ash Legion

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Id | `ash-legion` |
| Rarity | Legendary (ember orange `#e59a5c`), 1 level |
| Kind | Key 4, Ultimate |
| Trigger | `press`: key 4 with its charge full (44 points) |
| Origin | New |

## Card

**A phantom army charges through the boss.** (7 words, 40 chars)

- Icon (48×48 line drawing): three spear points slanting forward in a row over two horse heads, speed lines behind.
- Hover loop (1.8 s): key cap "4" lights (0.2 s); a small figure sweeps the blade forward (0.2 s); grey riders and spearmen rise from the floor behind it (0.3 s) and charge across the card through a boss silhouette, spear points lit, the brighter frame as the front rank hits (0.8 s); dust settles, fade (0.3 s).

## Card

**A storm whirls round the boss for {time}.** (8 words, 36 chars)

- Icon (48×48 line drawing): a funnel of three stacked spiral strokes narrowing to the ground, a short bolt zigzag inside it.
- Hover loop (2.0 s): key cap "4" lights (0.2 s); a small figure spins the blade overhead (0.3 s); wind lines wrap a boss silhouette and build into a funnel, the brighter frame as the first bolt cracks inside (0.4 s); the funnel spins, rain streaks, two more bolt ticks while the figure cuts inside the calm eye (0.8 s); the funnel lifts apart, fade (0.3 s).

## Idea

A cyclone of wind, rain and ember lightning spins up round the boss and shreds it for five seconds, and you fight inside the eye, where it is calm. It is the long Ultimate: not one big hit but a storm that makes the next five seconds of your own fighting louder and brighter. It hits everything within six metres of the boss, so a second boss or adds caught in it are shredded too.

## Data

```js
{ id: 'tempest', name: 'Tempest', rarity: 'legendary', key: 'ultimate',
  text: 'A storm whirls round the boss for {time}.',
  power: { when: 'press', then: 'tempest' },
  levels: [
    { charge: 42, time: 5, every: 0.25, damage: 18, radius: 6 },
  ] },
```

Numbers: 5 / 0.25 = 20 ticks of 18 = 360 for 42 points, 8.6 a point on one boss, on the dragon's floor; a 6 m radius round the boss doubles it on two bosses close together. Its strength is that the holder keeps fighting through it (the storm adds about 72 a second on top of their own 30). About 720-1080 a fight on one boss.

## Engine work

- New `press/tempest`: `['charge', 'time', 'every', 'damage', 'radius']`, in `ON_ENEMY`; a `running` entry centred on the target that follows it (the storm's centre eases toward the target's position at up to 8 m/s, so it stays round the boss as it moves).
- First tick 0.5 s after the press, then every `every` s for `time` s: `damage` to every enemy within `radius` m of the centre.
- The wind never pushes, slows or blinds a player: it is drawing only for bodies.
- `validate.js`: `tempest` needs its five numbers; `time / every` a whole number.

## Multiplayer

The server resolves it on its own enemies from the press claim and moves the storm's centre with the boss. Enemies only. A teammate standing in the funnel's wall sees it 50% translucent round them and is never touched. One holder per team.

## Effect

Timed from the press (t = 0):

| t | Layer | Look | Colour |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0.00-0.30 | Anticipation | Upper-body pose: the blade spun once overhead and held up; the world dims 20%; the falling ash turns and starts to circle the boss | `#5a5550` ash |
| 0.20-0.50 | Build | Wind bands wrap the boss from the floor up, three flat spiral sheets in two tones, black ink edges; rain streaks start slanting round | `#2a3040` bands, `#8a93a6` light band, `#0b0b0f` ink, `#cfd6e2` rain |
| 0.50 | Peak (the first bolt) | The funnel closes overhead, 14 m tall, and a jagged ember-edged bolt cracks down its middle onto the boss; 24 sharp sparks. **The impact frame** | `#ece6ff` bolt core, `#e59a5c` edge |
| 0.50-5.50 | Storm | The funnel spins (bands scroll upward); every tick a white wind streak cuts across the wall (a shape, never a light flash); every fourth tick (once a second) a short ember bolt between the bands, the only flash; rain streaks and torn ash fly round; inside the eye (round the holder if they stand in it) the air is still and the ash hangs | as above |
| 5.50-6.20 | Fade | The funnel lifts off the floor and unwinds upward into thin bands that tear and vanish; the rain falls straight for a beat and stops | `#8a93a6` to transparent |

Budget (Legendary class for the opening, then the hold): opening 6 pooled meshes (3 spiral sheets, cap disc, bolt mesh, eye-calm ash ring) + 24 sparks + 60 rain + 40 ash = 124 particles (68 on Normal), 2 effect lights (the bolt; a cold flicker inside the wall, × 0.65 on Normal), no ribbon, 1 impact frame at t = 0.50, peak 0.5-2.0 s. From 2.0 to 5.5 s the hold drops to its long-aura size: 4 meshes (2 spiral sheets, bolt, ash ring), 30 rain streaks (17 on Normal), 1 light for the small bolts, no flash beyond those (every 1 s at most, so under the 3 Hz bound). The wall goes 35% translucent within 2 m of the boss's weapon while it winds up. Reduced motion: the impact frame becomes a 30% darken, no shake, the small bolts glow instead of flashing.

## Sound

New `abilityTempest`: a wind rising to a howl (pink noise, band-pass sweeping 300 Hz to 1.4 kHz over 0.5 s, then a steady whistling band at 900 Hz with a slow wobble for 5 s, fading), rain hiss (high-passed noise at 6 kHz, low gain, 5 s), the first bolt `abilityThunder` at full, the small bolts `abilityThunder` at gain 0.4 and pitch up a fifth. Tail: the howl falling away upward (band rising to 3 kHz while fading, 0.7 s).
