# Meteor Fall

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Id | `meteor-fall` |
| Rarity | Legendary (ember orange `#e59a5c`), 1 level |
| Kind | Triggered (no key) |
| Trigger | `land` with `action: 'heavy'`: the heavy jump attack lands (5 s cooldown) |
| Origin | Kept from `js/data/abilities.js`. Changed: one level; 140 damage at radius 6 (was 95 at 4.5 and 130 at 6); the look gains a held anticipation at the top of the jump and one impact frame. |

## Card

**Jump heavy: a blast hits all within {radius}.** (8 words, 38 chars)

- Icon (48×48 line drawing): a small figure plunging point-down inside a tall flame teardrop, a crater arc under it.
- Hover loop (1.6 s): a small figure jumps (0.3 s), hangs a beat at the top with the blade raised (0.2 s), and plunges in a column of fire (0.2 s); the burst and shock ring, the brighter frame on landing (0.2 s); the crater glows and cools (0.6 s), loop.

## Idea

The heavy jump attack comes down as a meteor: a column of fire falls with you and a molten crater opens where you land, hitting everything within six metres. It turns the riskiest move in the moveset into a signature: jump in over a boss's sweep, hang a beat at the top, and bring the sky down. Every five seconds at most, so it shapes how you play rather than firing once a fight.

## Data

```js
{ id: 'meteor-fall', name: 'Meteor Fall', rarity: 'legendary',
  text: 'Jump heavy: a blast hits all within {radius}.',
  power: { when: 'land', then: 'blast', action: 'heavy' },
  levels: [
    { radius: 6, damage: 140, cooldown: 5 },
  ] },
```

Numbers: 140 a landing on top of the jump heavy's own blow. A heavy jump attack can land about every 6-10 s in a real fight (it commits, and bosses punish it), so about 14-23 damage a second on top of the holder's own 30: roughly 900-1600 over a 90 s fight if used well, less for a careful player. Strong, but only for the player who takes the jump's risk; it never fires on its own. Over the floor on paper; the risk keeps it fair.

## Engine work

- `land/blast` exists, unchanged: a jump attack whose `action` is `heavy` that lands blasts every enemy within `radius` m.
- The anticipation is the jump heavy's own animation (track A): a held beat of 0.12 s at the top before the plunge when the holder has this ability, so the column reads. It doesn't change the attack's timing on the engine side (the beat is inside the existing air time).
- Its drawing (`js/ability-fx.js` `meteor`) gains the impact frame and the tighter column below; nothing allocated per cast.

## Multiplayer

The client claims `land` with the jump's `action` (it already does); the server checks the landing against the body it knows and the cooldown, and resolves the blast. Enemies only; a teammate in the ring is untouched. One holder per team.

## Effect

Timed from the jump's landing (t = 0); the column starts with the plunge:

| t | Layer | Look | Colour |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| -0.30 to -0.18 | Anticipation | At the top of the jump, the blade raised point-down, held a beat; ember sparks gather on the blade; the world dims 20% (the holder's view only) | `#e59a5c` sparks |
| -0.18 to 0.00 | Column | A hard column of fire falls with the body, 2 m wide, solid flame tongues with dark red inner lines, a white-hot core round the blade; speed lines behind | `#fff3dc` core, `#e59a5c` tongues, `#7a1f12` inner lines, `#0b0b0f` ink |
| 0.00 | Peak (impact) | A white-hot burst at the feet; a hard shock ring runs out to `radius` in 0.15 s; 40 ember shards and 20 rock chips. **The impact frame** | `#fff3dc` burst, `#e59a5c` ring, `#4a4440` chips |
| 0.00-0.50 | Crater | A molten crater decal under the holder, its cracks white-hot, a heat shimmer | `#fff3dc` to `#e59a5c` |
| 0.50-1.80 | Cool | The crater cools from ember to dull red to black; a few motes rise | `#e59a5c` to `#7a1f12` to `#2a1a12` |

Budget (Legendary class): 6 pooled meshes (column, speed-line card, burst sphere, shock ring, crater decal, heat plane) + 40 shards + 20 chips + 20 motes = 80 particles (44 on Normal), 2 effect lights (column, burst; × 0.65 on Normal), 1 ribbon (the column's trailing edge), 1 impact frame at t = 0. Peak 0.5 s. With the 5 s cooldown the impact frame never comes more than once in 5 s from this ability. Reduced motion: the impact frame becomes a 30% darken, no shake.

## Sound

`abilityBlast` kept for the impact. New `abilityMeteorFall` for the plunge: a rising roar of fire (pink noise, band-pass 300 to 1.6 kHz over 0.18 s, heavy drive) and a falling whistle (band-pass 3 kHz down to 900 Hz). Tail: the crater's hiss and crackle cooling (high-passed noise at 4 kHz with crackles, 1.2 s, fading).

## Camera

`CONFIG.camera.feel.powers.blast = [4, 0.24]` kept for the impact. Nothing at the top of the jump; the camera stays the player's.

## Images

- `img/meteor-fall-1.webp`: the swordsman plunging down from the sky in a column of ember fire like a meteor onto a boss, a white-hot burst and shock ring.
- `img/meteor-fall-2.webp`: a cooling molten crater with glowing cracks after a meteor impact, the swordsman rising from its centre.

# Storm King

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Id | `storm-king` |
| Rarity | Legendary (ember orange `#e59a5c`), 1 level |
| Kind | Triggered (no key) |
| Trigger | `fullHeavy`: a fully charged heavy lands on an enemy (6 s cooldown) |
| Origin | Kept from `js/data/abilities.js`. Changed: no longer draws the lightning dragon (that is Thunder Call's alone): a crown of six bolts in a ring round the boss that converge into one; `then: 'boltCrown'` (was `lightning`); one level, 6 strikes of 34 every 0.12 s after 0.5 s (was 3 or 5 strikes of 36-38 every 0.4-0.45 s after 0.75 s). |

## Card

**Full heavy hit: a crown of {strikes} bolts falls.** (9 words, 41 chars)

- Icon (48×48 line drawing): six short vertical bolt zigzags standing in a ring like the points of a crown, bending in at the top.
- Hover loop (1.6 s): a small figure charges a heavy, the blade glowing up to full (0.5 s), and lands it (0.1 s); six bolts slam down round the boss one after another in a ring (0.4 s); they bend inward and meet in one strike, the brighter frame (0.2 s); a crown-shaped scorch, fade (0.4 s).

## Idea

A fully charged heavy that lands calls a crown of lightning: six bolts slam down in a quick ring round the boss, then bend inward and converge into one. It rewards the most committed blow in the moveset with the fastest, tightest burst in the pool, a crown placed on the boss's head by your own blade.

## Data

```js
{ id: 'storm-king', name: 'Storm King', rarity: 'legendary',
  text: 'Full heavy hit: a crown of {strikes} bolts falls.',
  power: { when: 'fullHeavy', then: 'boltCrown' },
  levels: [
    { strikes: 6, lead: 0.5, every: 0.12, damage: 34, cooldown: 6 },
  ] },
```

Numbers: 6 × 34 = 204 a full heavy that lands. A full charge takes over a second and must land, so in a real fight one lands every 8-15 s: about 14-25 a second on top of the holder's own, 1200-2000 over a 90 s fight for a player built round charged heavies, far less for one who isn't. Strong and earned; never fires on its own.

## Engine work

- New `fullHeavy/boltCrown`: `['strikes', 'lead', 'every', 'damage', 'cooldown']`, in `ON_ENEMY`; a `running` entry like `lightning` (first bolt `lead` s after the hit, then every `every` s). `fullHeavy/lightning` goes.
- Each bolt strikes a point on a ring `e.radius + 1.5` m round the struck enemy (evenly spaced, starting from the side facing the holder) and hits every enemy within 2 m of that point; the struck enemy is always inside that reach, so it takes all six. The convergence after the sixth is drawing only: no extra damage.
- `validate.js`: `boltCrown` needs its five numbers; `strikes` whole.

## Multiplayer

The server sees the landed full heavy itself (a strike with `charge >= 1`) and resolves the crown on its own enemies. Enemies only: a teammate standing on the ring is untouched and sees bolts pass by. One holder per team.

## Effect

Timed from the heavy's hit (t = 0):

# Time Rift

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Id | `time-rift` |
| Rarity | Legendary (ember orange `#e59a5c`), 1 level |
| Kind | Triggered (no key) |
| Trigger | `dodge`: a perfect dodge (14 s cooldown) |
| Origin | Kept from `js/data/abilities.js`. Changed: one level (2.5 s, radius 9, cooldown 14: the old level II); the wave and bubble move from violet to the legendary ember over white-violet, and the bubble now shatters like glass with the one impact frame. |

## Card

**Perfect dodge: the boss freezes for {time}.** (7 words, 38 chars)

- Icon (48×48 line drawing): a circle with a clock's two hands, a curved arrow round it turning backwards, a small sidestep arc beside it.
- Hover loop (1.8 s): a small figure sidesteps a falling blow on the beat (0.3 s); a ring of light runs out and the boss silhouette stops mid-swing inside a bubble, a clock face under it turning backwards (0.9 s); the figure walks past and cuts twice; the bubble cracks and shatters, the brighter frame (0.2 s); fade (0.4 s).

## Idea

A perfect dodge tears a rift in time: everything near stops dead inside a bubble of slow light while you move. The boss hangs mid-swing, its clock turning backwards under it, and you have two and a half seconds to do whatever you like; then the bubble shatters and time comes back with a crack. It turns the best defensive moment into the best offensive one, and the world changing colour is its spectacle.

## Data

```js
{ id: 'time-rift', name: 'Time Rift', rarity: 'legendary',
  text: 'Perfect dodge: the boss freezes for {time}.',
  power: { when: 'dodge', then: 'freeze' },
  levels: [
    { time: 2.5, radius: 9, cooldown: 14 },
  ] },
```

Numbers: no damage of its own; 2.5 s of a boss that can't act is a light string, a heavy finisher and a free counter window, about 90-130 damage, plus safety. Every 14 s at most (perfect dodges come every few seconds for a skilled player), so up to about six a fight: 550-800 damage of openings and a lot of health saved. On the bar as a utility, and the one legendary that makes a newcomer feel in control.

## Engine work

- `dodge/freeze` exists, unchanged: every enemy within `radius` m gets `frozen` = `time`.
- New: the shared hold rest (`CONFIG.abilities.holdRest`, 3 s, see Heaven's Lance) applies, so a party can't chain this with other holds into a boss that never moves; the rift still fires and draws, the frozen boss just isn't frozen again until its rest is over.
- Drawing (`js/ability-fx.js` `rift`): new colours, the glass shatter, and the impact frame on the shatter.

## Multiplayer

The client claims `dodge` (it already does); the server checks it against the attack it knows and the cooldown, and freezes its own enemies. Enemies only: a teammate inside the bubble keeps moving at full speed and sees the bubble's tint at 50% for them. One holder per team.

## Effect

Timed from the perfect dodge (t = 0):

| t | Layer | Look | Colour |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0.00-0.20 | Anticipation | The dodge's own slow-motion beat (the counter window's); a hairline crack of light opens in the air where the blow passed; the world dims 20% | `#ece6ff` crack, `#e59a5c` rim |
| 0.20-0.45 | Wave | A ring of ember-tinted light runs out from the crack to `radius` m, flat, hard-edged, white-violet inside | `#ece6ff` core, `#e59a5c` edge, `#0b0b0f` ink |
| 0.45-2.95 | Bubble | Each frozen enemy sits in a sphere of slow light; inside it the colour drains to grey; falling ash inside hangs still; a clock face of thin ember lines turns backwards on the floor under it; the frozen body keeps a faint afterimage of its last motion | `#ece6ff` sphere at 25%, `#8a8478` grey, `#e59a5c` clock |
| 2.70-2.95 | Strain | Cracks run across the bubble; the clock's hands spin faster | `#fff3dc` cracks |
| 2.95 | Peak (the shatter) | The bubble breaks like glass: 40 curved shards fly out and fall; colour snaps back. **The impact frame** | `#fff3dc`, `#e59a5c` shard edges |
| 2.95-3.50 | Fade | Shards fall and fade before they reach the floor; the clock face dissolves | `#e59a5c` to transparent |

Budget (Legendary class): 6 pooled meshes (crack, wave ring, bubble sphere, clock face, afterimage shell, shard sheet), up to 2 bubbles with two bosses (8 meshes) + 30 hanging ash + 40 shards = 70 particles (39 on Normal), 2 effect lights (the wave, cool; the shatter; × 0.65 on Normal), no ribbon, 1 impact frame at the shatter. Peak 0.5 s at the wave, 0.55 s at the shatter (the bubble between is an aura of 3 meshes). A frozen boss makes no wind-up, so nothing is hidden. Reduced motion: the impact frame becomes a 30% darken, no shake, the grey fades in over 0.3 s instead of cutting.

## Sound

`abilityFreeze` kept (the world's sound sucked backwards, a glassy chime, a clock ticking slow). New tail `abilityRiftBreak` at the shatter: a crisp glass burst (many short bandpassed clicks at 4-7 kHz over 0.3 s) and the world's sound rushing back (a reversed-reverb swell into the room tone, 0.25 s).

## Camera

`CONFIG.camera.feel.powers.freeze = [-3.2, 0.05]` kept for the wave; new `riftBreak = [1.6, 0.04]` at the shatter.

## Images

- `img/time-rift-1.webp`: a boss frozen mid-attack inside a bubble of slow ember-tinted light with a giant clock face turning backwards beneath it, the swordsman moving freely past.
- `img/time-rift-2.webp`: the frozen bubble shattering like glass as time resumes.

# Thousand Blades

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Id | `thousand-blades` |
| Rarity | Legendary (ember orange `#e59a5c`), 1 level |
| Kind | Triggered (no key) |
| Trigger | `parry`: a deflect (10 s cooldown) |
| Origin | Kept from `js/data/abilities.js`. Changed: one level (4.5 s, a sword every 0.15 s for 6: the old level II); the swords stay planted and finish in a standing ring, with one impact frame as the sky opens. |

## Card

**Deflect: swords rain on the boss for {time}.** (8 words, 39 chars)

- Icon (48×48 line drawing): five sword silhouettes falling point-down at slight angles, two already standing in a ground line.
- Hover loop (1.8 s): a small figure deflects a blow, a spark (0.2 s); the sky over the boss opens, the brighter frame (0.1 s); swords fall in streaks and stick in the boss and the floor (1.0 s); a ring of planted swords glows and fades (0.5 s).

## Idea

A deflect opens the sky: ghost copies of your own sword rain down on the boss for four and a half seconds and stand where they land, until a ring of them circles it. The deflect is the moveset's most precise moment; this makes every good one a storm of steel, and it builds as you keep deflecting, every ten seconds.

## Data

```js
{ id: 'thousand-blades', name: 'Thousand Blades', rarity: 'legendary',
  text: 'Deflect: swords rain on the boss for {time}.',
  power: { when: 'parry', then: 'blades' },
  levels: [
    { time: 4.5, every: 0.15, damage: 6, cooldown: 10 },
  ] },
```

Numbers: 4.5 / 0.15 = 30 swords of 6 = 180 a deflect, every 10 s at most. Deflects come every few seconds against an aggressive boss, so it fires about every 10-12 s: 15-18 damage a second on top of the holder's own, about 1300-1600 over a 90 s fight for a player who deflects well. Strong, and earned by the hardest timing in the game.

## Engine work

- `parry/blades` exists, unchanged: a `running` entry on the deflected enemy, a sword every `every` s for `time` s.
- Drawing (`js/ability-fx.js` `blades`): swords now stay planted where they land (in the boss's body for 0.6 s, then dropping to the floor beside it) and the last ten stand in a ring, all within the pooled count below.
- The ghost sword is the holder's own sword model (the player's weapon, already a Blender model), drawn with the ghost shader as one instanced mesh (32 instances), so the rain is one draw call.

## Multiplayer

The server sees the deflect itself and resolves the swords on its own enemy. Enemies only; a sword falling near a teammate passes through them and never plants in their path (planted swords have no collision and fade when a player stands within 1 m). One holder per team.

## Effect

Timed from the deflect (t = 0):

| t | Layer | Look | Colour |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0.00-0.15 | Anticipation | The deflect's own spark and hit-stop; a ring of light marks opens in the air 12 m over the boss | `#e59a5c` marks |
| 0.15 | Peak (the sky opens) | The ring tears open into a disc of white light; the first three swords appear in it. **The impact frame** | `#fff3dc` disc, `#e59a5c` rim |
| 0.15-4.65 | Rain | A sword every 0.15 s falls point-down in a hard white streak with an ember edge, at a slight random angle, sticks in the boss or the floor with 6 sparks and a small dust puff; ghost swords are flat-shaded, white core, ember edge, black ink outline | `#fff3dc` streak, `#e59a5c` edge, `#0b0b0f` ink |
| 3.00-4.65 | Ring | The last ten land in a ring round the boss's feet and stand, glowing | `#e59a5c` |
| 4.65-5.40 | Fade | The disc closes; the planted swords glow white along their edges and fade from the hilt down | `#fff3dc` to transparent |

Budget (Legendary class): 4 pooled meshes (sky ring, light disc, instanced ghost swords (32), dust card sheet) + 30 × 6 sparks spread over 4.5 s (never more than 36 alive) + 20 dust = 56 particles alive at most (31 on Normal), 1 effect light (the disc over the boss, steady, never pulsing per sword; × 0.65 on Normal), no ribbon, 1 impact frame at t = 0.15. Peak 0.5 s at the opening, then the rain at aura weight. Swords never fall across the boss's weapon during a wind-up (they land on its far side and back). Reduced motion: the impact frame becomes a 30% darken, no shake, streaks drawn without motion stretch.

## Sound

`abilityBlades` kept (a choir of steel rising as the sky opens) and `abilityBlade` for each sword (a ring of steel and a thud), its pitch varied by the existing jitter. New: at the ring's closing, a single low steel chord (sine partials at 196, 294 and 392 Hz, 1.4 s) under the last sword.

## Camera

`CONFIG.camera.feel.powers.blades = [-1.4, 0.04]` kept, at the opening only. No kick per sword.

## Images

- `img/thousand-blades-1.webp`: dozens of ember-edged ghost swords raining point-down from the sky onto a boss after a deflect, streaks of light, swords stuck in the floor.
- `img/thousand-blades-2.webp`: a ring of ghost swords stuck in the floor around the boss, glowing and fading.

## Card

**Low health: for {time}, hits do more and heal.** (9 words, 41 chars)

- Icon (48×48 line drawing): a large full circle low behind a small kneeling figure, two drops falling from the figure's blade.

## Idea

Near death a red moon rises over you: for twelve seconds your blows cut deeper and drink back the health they take. It is the comeback legendary, once a fight, the moment a run that was slipping turns: the arena goes crimson, you stand up, and you fight your way back up your own bar.

## Data

```js
{ id: 'blood-moon', name: 'Blood Moon', rarity: 'legendary',
  text: 'Low health: for {time}, hits do more and heal.',
  power: { when: 'low', then: 'bloodMoon', once: true },
  levels: [
    { below: 0.33, time: 12, damage: 0.45, drain: 0.35 },
  ] },
```

Numbers: 12 s × 30 a second × 1.45 = about 520 dealt (160 of it the moon's), and 35% of it drunk back, about 180 health, near a full flask. Once a fight. Its value is the health more than the damage: it decides whether the holder lives through the bad moment. A legendary-sized swing, but only when things are going wrong.

## Engine work

- `low/bloodMoon` exists, unchanged (`perk.moon`, `perk.moonV`; the damage in `abilityStrike`, the drink in `abilityLanded`).
- Drawing (`js/ability-fx.js` `bloodMoon`, `slash`): the held beat and the impact frame at the rise, ember edges on the slashes. The crimson grade reuses World of Ink's grade uniform (a tint instead of ink), only round the holder.

The client claims `low` (it already does); the server checks the health it knows and runs the moon on its own copy of the holder's perk clocks. It acts on its holder alone: the moon and the crimson tint are drawn round the holder (12 m) and at 50% for teammates inside it; nobody else hits harder or heals. One holder per team.

## Effect

Timed from the health drop (t = 0):

| t | Layer | Look | Colour |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0.00-0.40 | Anticipation | A heartbeat: the world dims 20% and goes a shade red; the holder's scarf lifts on a wind from nowhere | `#9e1b1b` tint |
| 0.20-0.60 | Rise | A huge red moon rises behind the holder over the arena's edge, flat-shaded with a black ink rim and two darker crater tones | `#c8323a` face, `#9e1b1b` craters, `#e59a5c` rim light, `#0b0b0f` ink |
| 0.60 | Peak (the moon clears the horizon) | The arena tints crimson round the holder; a red aura snaps on round their body. **The impact frame** | `#c8323a` / `#0b0b0f` |
| 0.60-12.0 | Moon | The moon hangs over the holder's side of the arena; the aura burns in hard red flame tongues on the shoulders and blade; each blow the holder lands leaves a flat red slash with an ember edge on the cut line, and a thin red thread flows from the struck enemy back to the holder | `#c8323a` aura, `#9e1b1b` inner lines, `#e59a5c` slash edge |
| 11.0-12.0 | Wane | The moon sinks, the aura thins, the tint lifts | to the scene's colours |

# Gale Crescent

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Id | `gale-crescent` |
| Rarity | Legendary (ember orange `#e59a5c`), 1 level |
| Kind | Triggered (no key) |
| Trigger | `hits`: every 8th blow the holder lands |
| Origin | Kept from `js/data/abilities.js`. Changed: no longer a single wind blade flying through the boss (that is the rare Wind Blade's): a cage of wind crescents spinning round the boss for 2 s; `then: 'bladeCage'` (was `gale`); one level, every 8th hit, 10 cuts of 12. |

## Card

**Every {hits}th hit: blades whirl round the boss.** (8 words, 43 chars)

- Icon (48×48 line drawing): a tall cylinder drawn as four stacked crescents leaning the same way, a small circle inside.
- Hover loop (1.6 s): a small figure lands quick hits, a tally of eight ticks filling under it (0.6 s); on the eighth, crescents spin up round the boss silhouette in a tight cylinder, the brighter frame as it closes (0.2 s); it spins and shreds (0.6 s); it bursts outward, fade (0.2 s).

## Idea

Every eighth blow you land, a cage of wind crescents spins up round the boss and shreds it for two seconds with a whistling howl. It makes the steady rhythm of light strings pay off in a burst you can see coming (the tally on the blade), and it rewards keeping the pressure on instead of waiting for one big moment.

## Data

```js
{ id: 'gale-crescent', name: 'Gale Crescent', rarity: 'legendary',
  text: 'Every {hits}th hit: blades whirl round the boss.',
  power: { when: 'hits', then: 'bladeCage' },
  levels: [
    { hits: 8, time: 2, every: 0.2, damage: 12 },
  ] },
```

Numbers: 2 / 0.2 = 10 cuts of 12 = 120 a cage, every 8 landed blows. A skilled player lands about one blow a second against a boss that doesn't flinch, so a cage every 8-10 s: 12-15 a second on top of their own, about 1000-1300 over a 90 s fight. It also hits anything else inside the cage. Steady and strong, not a single swing that ends a fight.

## Engine work

- New `hits/bladeCage`: `['hits', 'time', 'every', 'damage']`, in `ON_ENEMY`; `hits/gale` goes from the legendaries (the rare Wind Blade keeps `press/gale`).
- A `running` entry on the struck enemy that follows it: first cut 0.2 s after the 8th blow, then every `every` s for `time` s, `damage` to every enemy within `e.radius + 1.2` m of its centre. A second cage on the same enemy while one runs starts it afresh (no stacking).
- The tally: the blade shows the count toward the next cage (a thin ember line along the fuller, one segment a blow), drawn for the holder only.
- `validate.js`: `bladeCage` needs its four numbers; `hits` whole.

## Multiplayer

The server counts the holder's landed blows itself and resolves the cage on its own enemies. Enemies only; a teammate inside the cage's radius is untouched and sees the crescents pass through them. One holder per team.

## Effect

Timed from the 8th blow (t = 0):

| t | Layer | Look | Colour |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| before | Tally | A thin ember line along the holder's fuller fills a segment with each landed blow | `#e59a5c` |
| 0.00-0.20 | Anticipation | The 8th blow's hit-stop; the falling ash round the boss snaps sideways; a pale ring forms at its feet | `#e8eef4` ring |
| 0.20 | Peak (the cage closes) | Twelve pale crescents with ember edges spin up from the ring into a tight cylinder as tall as the boss in 0.1 s; black ink lines on their inner edges. **The impact frame** | `#e8eef4` crescent, `#e59a5c` edge, `#0b0b0f` ink |
| 0.20-2.20 | Spin | The cylinder spins fast (crescents scroll round and climb); each cut throws 4 sharp white slivers outward; ash streaks wind round it | `#e8eef4`, `#e59a5c`, `#5a5550` |
| 2.20-2.60 | Burst | The crescents fly outward in every direction, flatten and fade 3 m out | `#e59a5c` to transparent |

Budget (Legendary class): 4 pooled meshes (floor ring, crescent instanced mesh (12), tally line, burst sheet) + 10 × 4 slivers + 30 ash = 70 particles (39 on Normal), 1 effect light (inside the cage, steady; × 0.65 on Normal), 1 ribbon (the top crescent's trail), 1 impact frame at t = 0.20. Peak 2.0 s. The crescents are 60% translucent on the side facing the holder, so the boss's wind-ups read through the cage. Reduced motion: the impact frame becomes a 30% darken, no shake, the spin slows to half.

## Sound

`abilityGale` reworked into `abilityCage`: a quick rising whoosh as it closes (band-passed noise sweeping 500 Hz to 2.5 kHz in 0.1 s), a whistling vortex for the 2 s (a narrow band at 1.4 kHz with a fast tremolo, plus a lower band at 600 Hz), a soft slicing tick each cut (high-passed noise 30 ms); the burst a short outward gust.

## Camera

`CONFIG.camera.feel.powers.bladeCage = [-1.6, 0.03]` at the closing. The old `gale = [-2.4, 0.05]` stays for the rare Wind Blade.

## Images

- `img/gale-crescent-1.webp`: a tight cylinder of many pale wind crescents with ember edges spinning around a boss like a cage, a whistling vortex.
- `img/gale-crescent-2.webp`: top-down view of the crescent cage spinning round the boss.

A counter lights a pillar of fire under the boss that burns for six seconds. The counter is the skill the fight is built on; Pyre makes each one leave the boss standing in a column of flame while you reset, so the reward of a good counter keeps paying while you get back to safety.

## Data

```js
{ id: 'pyre', name: 'Pyre', rarity: 'legendary',
  text: 'Counter: fire burns the foe for {time}.',
  power: { when: 'counter', then: 'pyre' },
  levels: [
    { time: 4, every: 0.35, damage: 17, cooldown: 2 },
  ] },
```

Numbers: 4 / 0.35 = 11 burns of 17 = 187 a counter. A second counter while it burns lights it afresh rather than stacking, so with counters every 10-15 s it adds 187 each: about 1100 over a fight of six counters, 750 for four. Among the strongest triggered legendaries, and the one that most rewards the skill the game is about, without outdamaging the Ultimates.

## Engine work

- `counter/pyre` exists, unchanged (one pillar an enemy; a new counter relights it).
- Drawing (`js/ability-fx.js` `pyre`): the eruption beat, the impact frame, hard-edged flame tongues as flat cards with dark red inner lines.

## Multiplayer

The server sees the counter itself and resolves the pillar on its own enemy. Enemies only; a teammate standing in the pillar is untouched and sees it at 50% translucent. One holder per team.

## Effect

Timed from the counter's hit (t = 0):

| t | Layer | Look | Colour |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0.00-0.20 | Anticipation | The counter's own hit-stop; a ring of cracks under the boss glows white-hot | `#fff3dc` cracks, `#e59a5c` rim |
| 0.20 | Peak (eruption) | A pillar of fire erupts up through the boss, 2.5 m wide, 9 m tall: solid flame tongues in two tones, dark red inner lines, a black ink outline; 30 sparks thrown out. **The impact frame** | `#fff3dc` core, `#e59a5c` tongues, `#7a1f12` inner lines, `#0b0b0f` ink |
| 0.20-6.20 | Burn | The pillar burns steadily, its tongues licking up; motes rise off it; it follows the boss; its light paints the arena | `#e59a5c`, `#fff3dc` motes |
| 5.70-6.40 | Sink | The pillar shrinks into the floor; the crack ring cools to black | `#e59a5c` to `#2a1a12` |

Budget (Legendary class at the eruption, aura class for the burn): 4 pooled meshes (crack ring, pillar shell, inner tongue cards, scorch decal) + 30 sparks at the eruption, then 30 rising motes (17 on Normal), 2 effect lights at the eruption, 1 steady for the burn (× 0.65 on Normal), no ribbon, 1 impact frame at t = 0.20 (and the 2 s cooldown keeps it from repeating within a second). Peak 0.4 s, then the burn as an aura. The pillar is 50% translucent from the holder's view where it covers the boss's weapon during a wind-up. Reduced motion: the impact frame becomes a 30% darken, no shake.

## Sound

`abilityPyre` kept. New eruption layer: a deep whump (sine 55 to 30 Hz, 0.3 s) and a roar (pink noise band-pass 400 Hz to 1.2 kHz, drive 2, 0.4 s) at t = 0.20; the burn a low crackling bed (filtered noise with random clicks, 6 s, quiet).

## Camera

`CONFIG.camera.feel.powers.pyre = [3.2, 0.16]` kept, at the eruption.

## Images

- `img/pyre-1.webp`: a tall hard-edged pillar of ember fire with dark red inner lines erupting under a boss after a counter slash, motes rising.
- `img/pyre-2.webp`: the pillar of fire seen from far, lighting the dark arena.

# Ember Twin

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Id | `ember-twin` |
| Rarity | Legendary (ember orange `#e59a5c`), 1 level |
| Kind | Triggered (no key) |
| Trigger | `flask`: the holder drinks a flask (20 s cooldown) |
| Origin | Kept from `js/data/abilities.js`. Changed: one level (12 s, 55% share, draws the boss 3 s, cooldown 20: the old level II); its own Blender model in place of `js/rig.js`'s figure (PLAN item 6: a summon never reuses the bot figure). |

## Card

**Flask: a twin fights with you for {time}.** (8 words, 36 chars)

- Icon (48×48 line drawing): two identical small figures facing each other across a circle (the boss), one drawn in broken ember cracks.
- Hover loop (1.8 s): a small figure drinks a flask (0.3 s); on the boss's far side a twin in ember cracks rises out of the floor, the brighter frame as it stands (0.4 s); both strike at once from both sides, three times (0.8 s); the twin burns away into sparks (0.3 s).

## Idea

Drinking calls an ember copy of yourself up out of the floor at the boss's far side: for twelve seconds, every blow you land, it lands too from the other side, and for its first three seconds the boss turns on it. It makes the most defensive act in the game, drinking, into an attack, and gives a lone player a partner for a breath: a pincer of two blades.

## Data

```js
{ id: 'ember-twin', name: 'Ember Twin', rarity: 'legendary',
  text: 'Flask: a twin fights with you for {time}.',
  power: { when: 'flask', then: 'twin' },
  levels: [
    { time: 12, share: 0.55, draw: 3, cooldown: 20 },
  ] },
```

Numbers: 12 s × 30 a second × 0.55 = about 200 echoed a call, plus 3 s of the boss drawn off the holder (a safe drink and a free string, about 60-90). Every 20 s at most, and flasks are few (3-5 a fight), so two to four calls: 500-1100 a fight. On the bar, and the summon most worth a flask.

## Engine work

- `flask/twin` exists, unchanged (`summonStep`, `echo`, the draw).
- The model (below) replaces the rig figure in `js/ability-fx.js` `makeTwins`; its strikes follow the holder's attack by id (the twin plays the same move from its own clip set, mirrored), so online every client draws the same swing.

## Multiplayer

The client claims `flask` (it already does); the server checks it and resolves the twin and its echoes, and the draw on its own boss. The twin fights only the boss, takes its attention for `draw` s, never blocks a teammate (no collision with players), and never revives anyone. One summon per player at a time (another kind's call waits). One holder per team.

## Model

`tools/blender/ember_twin.py`: the holder's silhouette, not their mesh: a hooded swordsman about 1.8 m tall with a scarf and a round shield, built of dark ash plates split by glowing ember cracks, the face a dark hollow with two ember points. Its own skeleton matching the player rig's bone names so the player's attack clips play on it unchanged (mirrored when it faces the holder). About 4k triangles. Material: ash-black flat base, an emissive crack map (white-hot centre, ember edge), a thin black ink rim; the scarf trails embers. Animations: `rise` (out of the floor from the feet up, a seam of light climbing it, 0.7 s), every attack clip of the player (shared), `idle` (a guard stance, breathing embers), `burn-away` (cracks widen from the head down, plates fall as sparks, 0.6 s). Baked to `js/baked/`; four in the pool (one a player), warmed at load. Seen in the game beside the player before it ships.

## Effect

Timed from the drink (t = 0):

| t | Layer | Look | Colour |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0.00-0.30 | Anticipation | The flask's own drink; ember threads run from the flask down the holder's arm into the floor and under the boss | `#e59a5c` threads |
| 0.30-0.70 | Rise | At the boss's far side the floor cracks in the holder's outline and the twin rises out of it, a seam of white light climbing from feet to hood | `#2a2420` plates, `#fff3dc` seam, `#e59a5c` cracks, `#0b0b0f` ink |
| 0.70 | Peak (it stands) | The twin snaps into the holder's stance, its eyes light, a ring of ember sparks bursts at its feet. **The impact frame** | `#fff3dc`, `#e59a5c` |
| 0.70-12.0 | Fight | Each blow the holder lands, the twin lands 0.06 s later from its side with an ember slash on its cut line (flat, two tones, ink outline); while it draws the boss, a thin ember line joins the boss's eyes to it | `#e59a5c` slash, `#fff3dc` core |
| 11.4-12.0 | Burn away | Cracks widen from the head down, plates fall as sparks; its scarf goes last | `#e59a5c` to `#5a5550` |

Budget (Legendary class at the rise, summon after): the rise 4 pooled meshes (the twin model, floor crack decal, seam card, spark ring) + 40 sparks, 2 effect lights (the seam, the stand; × 0.65 on Normal), 1 impact frame at t = 0.70, peak 0.4 s. While it fights: the model + 2 meshes (slash pool head, draw line), 20 embers off it (11 on Normal), 1 light on its chest, steady, 1 ribbon (its blade's trail). Reduced motion: the impact frame becomes a 30% darken, no shake.

## Sound

`abilityTwin` kept for the rise; `abilityEcho` kept for each mirrored blow; `abilityTaunt` for the draw. New `abilityTwinFade` at the burn-away: a soft crackle falling in pitch and a breath of air (band-passed noise at 900 Hz fading, 0.6 s).

## Camera

`CONFIG.camera.feel.powers.twin = [2.6, 0.1]` kept at the rise; `echo = [-0.6, 0.02]` and `draw = [1.2, 0.03]` kept.

## Images

- `img/ember-twin-1.webp`: an ember copy of the swordsman made of glowing cracks and dark ash on the far side of a boss, both striking at once in a pincer.
- `img/ember-twin-2.webp`: the ember twin burning away into sparks as its time ends.

# Hundred Suns

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Id | `hundred-suns` |
| Rarity | Legendary (ember orange `#e59a5c`), 1 level |
| Kind | Triggered (no key) |
| Trigger | `finisher`: the holder's Finishing Blow opens its cuts |
| Origin | New |

## Card

**Finishing Blow: every cut erupts in sunfire.** (7 words, 44 chars)

- Icon (48×48 line drawing): three crossed cut lines over a small circle, each line flaring into a long blade shape at both ends, a star.
- Hover loop (1.8 s): a small figure flash-steps through a boss three times, three cut lines hanging (0.6 s); they open, and each erupts into two blades of sun fire bursting outward, the brighter frame (0.2 s); the star burns behind the figure's back-turned held pose (0.7 s); fade (0.3 s).

## Idea

When the Finishing Blow's cut lines open, each one erupts in blades of sun fire bursting outward in a star. The biggest moment of every fight gets bigger: the time stop, the flash steps, the held pose with your back to the boss, and then a sun goes off behind you. It needs no key and no aim; it asks only that you earn the Finishing Blow.

## Data

```js
{ id: 'hundred-suns', name: 'Hundred Suns', rarity: 'legendary',
  text: 'Finishing Blow: every cut erupts in sunfire.',
  power: { when: 'finisher', then: 'sunLines' },
  levels: [
    { strikes: 6, damage: 45 },
  ] },
```

Numbers: 6 × 45 = 270 a Finishing Blow, on top of its own 480 on a boss (a 56% boost). Finishing Blows come one to three times a fight (three counters within the crack's 10 s), so 270-810 a fight; the sheets also cut any other enemy within reach of the star. On the bar for a player who counters well, nothing for one who doesn't.

## Engine work

- New `finisher/sunLines`: `['strikes', 'damage']`, fired from the `finisher` event (`js/finisher.js`, the cuts opening) on the finished enemy.
- `strikes` sheets, two from each cut line (`CONFIG.finisher.steps` = 3), one out each side of the body along the cut's direction, each 8 m long and 1.5 m wide: `damage` to the finished enemy for each sheet (so all six land on it) and to every other enemy a sheet crosses. `validate.js` checks `strikes` is a whole multiple of `CONFIG.finisher.steps` and that `damage` is set.
- The Finishing Blow's own bossCap rule is unchanged; the sheets are a power's blows after it (they never leave a boss at 1 hp or skip a phase change).

## Multiplayer

The server runs the Finishing Blow (any player's counters count, the one landing the third gets it), so it fires the sheets for that holder only. Enemies only; sheets pass through teammates. One holder per team.

## Effect

Timed from the cuts opening (t = 0; the Finishing Blow's own 1.06 s and hit-stop come first):

| t | Layer | Look | Colour |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| -1.06 to 0.00 | Anticipation | The Finishing Blow's own frozen time and flash steps; each cut line it leaves hangs with a thin white-gold core, brighter than usual | `#fff6d8` lines |
| 0.00 | Peak (eruption) | The cuts open and every line erupts: two flat sheets of sun fire burst out of each, 8 m long, white-gold core, ember edges, black ink outline, in a six-pointed star round the boss; 40 sparks. **The impact frame** (it replaces the Finishing Blow's own flash at this moment, so there is still one) | `#fff6d8` core, `#e59a5c` edge, `#0b0b0f` ink |
| 0.00-0.60 | Burn | The sheets hang and burn from their tips inward; heat shimmer; the holder holds the Finishing Blow's pose, back to the boss | `#e59a5c`, `#fff3dc` |
| 0.60-1.30 | Fade | The star shrinks into the boss and goes out; sun motes drift up | `#e59a5c` to transparent |

Budget (Legendary class): 4 pooled meshes (6 sheets as one instanced mesh, star glow disc, heat plane, the brighter cut-line core) + 40 sparks + 40 motes = 80 particles (44 on Normal), 2 effect lights (the star's centre, a warm fill; × 0.65 on Normal), no ribbon, 1 impact frame at t = 0 (shared with the Finishing Blow's moment, never added to it). Peak 0.6 s. The boss is held through the Finishing Blow, so no tell is hidden. Reduced motion: the impact frame becomes a 30% darken, no shake.

## Sound

New `abilitySuns`: layered on the Finishing Blow's own cut sound, a bright rising shimmer (sine partials at 880, 1320 and 1760 Hz, 0.1 s attack) into a wide roar of fire (pink noise, band-pass 600 Hz to 2 kHz, drive 2, 0.6 s) and a sub bloom (sine 48 to 30 Hz, 0.8 s). Tail: a high choir-like tone fading (sine 1760 Hz, 1 s, heavy reverb).

## Camera

`CONFIG.camera.feel.powers.sunLines = [3.4, 0.1]` at the eruption, on top of the Finishing Blow's own punch (the total stays under `maxFov`).

## Images

- `img/hundred-suns-1.webp`: many white-gold sheets of sun fire with ember edges erupting from the cut lines of a multi-cut finishing blow on a boss, a star pattern.
- `img/hundred-suns-2.webp`: the swordsman in a held pose with their back to the boss as the sun fire erupts behind them.

pool.look: A jagged white-violet lightning line with ember fringes along each dash path, a thunderclap at both ends.
pool.img: the swordsman reappearing at the end of a jagged white-violet lightning line with ember fringes that cuts through a boss, a thunderclap burst at both ends

pool.md:
# Thunder God Step

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Id | `thunder-god-step` |
| Rarity | Legendary (ember orange `#e59a5c`), 1 level |
| Kind | Triggered (no key) |
| Trigger | `dash` (new): every dash, resolved at its end (0.6 s cooldown) |
| Origin | New |

## Card

**Dashes become lightning that cuts all you pass.** (8 words, 47 chars)

- Icon (48×48 line drawing): a jagged lightning line running corner to corner, a small crouched figure at its lower end, a short cut mark crossing the line's middle.
- Hover loop (1.6 s): a small figure crouches beside a boss silhouette (0.2 s); it vanishes and a jagged line snaps through the boss to the far side, the brighter frame (0.1 s); the figure is crouched at the line's end, the cut on the boss opens (0.5 s); a second dash crosses the first in an X (0.4 s); the lines fade (0.4 s).

## Idea

Every dash becomes a bolt: for the dash's untouchable instant the body is gone, a jagged white-violet line is where you went, and you land crouched at its end with a thunderclap while everything the line crossed is cut. It changes nothing about how the dash moves or protects you; it turns the most-pressed button in the game into an attack, so a fight becomes a web of lightning lines round the boss. It rewards dashing through, not away.

## Data

```js
{ id: 'thunder-god-step', name: 'Thunder God Step', rarity: 'legendary',
  text: 'Dashes become lightning that cuts all you pass.',
  power: { when: 'dash', then: 'lightningDash' },
  levels: [
    { damage: 30, cooldown: 0.6 },
  ] },
```

Numbers: a skilled player dashes every 2-3 s in a boss fight (three dashes, one back every 1.3 s) and through or close past the boss about half the time, so 15-25 cuts in a 90 s fight: 450-750 on the boss, plus every other enemy a line crosses. The 0.6 s cooldown keeps a three-dash burst to two cuts. On the bar for a player who dashes through blows; a player who dashes away gets the look and little else, which is the lesson.

## Engine work

- New `when: 'dash'`: fired once at the end of every dash (the `roll` state ending) with `ctx`: `{ from: { x, z }, to: { x, z } }`, the dash's path. It shares Spark Step's path check (`dashPast`, `CONFIG.abilities.commons.pastGap` = 1.2 m) but needs no "past": any live enemy whose body edge comes within `pastGap` of the segment, through it or beside it, is crossed. A dash that crosses nothing still draws the line and spends no cooldown.
- New `then: 'lightningDash'`: `ABILITY_POWERS['dash/lightningDash'] = ['damage', 'cooldown']`. `damage` to every crossed enemy as a power's blow (`wound`: it never counts toward `hits`, a counter or a crack, and sets off no power), resolved at the dash's end so the cut opens as the holder lands (the delayed cut).
- The dash's movement, length, i-frames and counter window are unchanged. Drawing only: the holder's body is hidden for `CONFIG.player.rollIFrames` and the line stands where it went (teammates see the line, never a missing friend: their view draws the body as a white-violet streak along it).
- `validate.js`: `dash/lightningDash` needs `damage` and `cooldown`.

## Multiplayer

A dash is its player's own, so `dash` joins `ABILITY_CLAIMS`: the browser claims it with the path; the server checks the player's poses showed a dash in the last 0.5 s, that the path starts and ends within 1.5 m of those poses and is no longer than a dash can go, and the cooldown; then it finds the crossed enemies itself from its own positions and resolves the cuts. Enemies only: a line through a teammate passes through them. One holder per team.

## Effect

Timed from the dash's start (t = 0; a dash lasts about 0.4 s):

| t | Layer | Look | Colour |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0.00-0.04 | Anticipation | The dash's own crouch; four short ember sparks jump off the feet; a thin white crack of light at the start point | `#e59a5c` sparks, `#ece6ff` crack |
| 0.04 | Release | The body is gone; a jagged ribbon line snaps from start to end in one frame, 0.25 m wide, white-violet core, ember fringe, black ink outline; short branch forks off its corners | `#ece6ff` core, `#8f7cf0` body, `#e59a5c` fringe, `#0b0b0f` ink |
| 0.04-0.20 | Clap (start) | A flat star burst of 8 hard shards and a small ring of dust at the start | `#fff3dc`, `#e59a5c` |
| end of dash | Peak (landing) | The holder is crouched at the line's end, blade low; a second clap there; every crossed enemy's body shows a hanging cut line that opens a beat later with 10 shards. **The impact frame**, only when the line crossed a boss and no more than one every 3 s from this ability | `#fff3dc` cut, `#e59a5c` shards |
| +0.0-0.6 | Fade | The line burns from both ends toward the middle, leaving a dark scorch line on the floor that cools ember to black | `#e59a5c` to `#2a1a12` |

Budget (Legendary class): 5 pooled meshes (2 line ribbons reused, so two dashes can stand at once; clap star, cut line, scorch decal) + 8 + 8 + 10 shards a dash, at most 52 alive with two lines (29 on Normal), 1 effect light (a soft, short glow along the line that fades over 0.3 s and never pops: three dashes in a second must not read as flashes), 2 ribbons (the two lines), 1 impact frame at a boss cut, at most one every 3 s. Peak 0.1 s. A line never hides a wind-up: it is thin and gone in 0.6 s. Reduced motion: the impact frame becomes a 30% darken, no shake, the line fades in over 0.1 s instead of snapping.

## Sound

New `abilityThunderStep`: at the release a tight electric snap (white noise high-passed at 3 kHz, 20 ms) over a short rising zap (saw 400 to 1600 Hz, 0.08 s); at the landing a thunderclap (pink noise burst, low-passed from 4 kHz to 400 Hz over 0.3 s) with a dull sub hit (sine 55 Hz, 0.2 s); each cut adds `abilityBlade`'s ring of steel pitched up. No tail: three in a row must not pile into a roar.

## Camera

`CONFIG.camera.feel.powers.lightningDash = [-1.2, 0.03]`, only on a cut that crossed a boss. The dash's own camera is otherwise unchanged.

## Images

- `img/thunder-god-step-1.webp`: the swordsman reappearing at the end of a jagged white-violet lightning line with ember fringes that cuts through a boss, a thunderclap burst at both ends.
- `img/thunder-god-step-2.webp`: several jagged lightning dash lines criss-crossing around a boss, the swordsman crouched.

pool.md:
# Fourfold

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Id | `fourfold` |
| Rarity | Legendary (ember orange `#e59a5c`), 1 level |
| Kind | Triggered perk (no key) |
| Trigger | `castUltimate` (new): the holder's key-4 ability fires |
| Origin | New |

## Card

**Your Ultimate refills your other keys.** (6 words, 38 chars)

- Icon (48×48 line drawing): four small square key caps in a row, the fourth drawn heavy, three curved threads running from it back into the other three.
- Hover loop (1.6 s): the card's four key caps sit at the bottom, 1-3 dim, 4 full (0.2 s); cap 4 fires and a small figure's big strike bursts above (0.3 s); the burst splits into three ember threads that slam into caps 1, 2 and 3, the brighter frame as they land (0.2 s); the four caps flare full together (0.5 s); dim back (0.4 s).

## Idea

The Ultimate's light doesn't end: it splits into three ember threads that run back into the holder's arms, and keys 1, 2 and 3 stand full again. Four techniques back to back: the Ultimate, then the strike, the guard and the summon while the boss is still reeling. It does nothing on its own; it turns the biggest moment of the fight into the first of four, and asks the player to plan the chain.

## Data

```js
{ id: 'fourfold', name: 'Fourfold', rarity: 'legendary',
  text: 'Your Ultimate refills your other keys.',
  power: { when: 'castUltimate', then: 'refillKeys' },
  levels: [
    { share: 1 },
  ] },
```

Numbers: keys 1-3 fill in about 12-20 s on their own (every key gains from every blow), and the Ultimate comes every 35-45 s, so each cast gives one extra press of each key the holder has: a rare strike (about 80-120), a guard (a heal or a stance, about 60-100 of worth) and a summon (about 100-150), so 250-350 a cast, 500-1000 a fight at two or three Ultimates. On the bar, but only for a holder with a key-4 ability; without one it does nothing, so the offer leaves it out for a player without one (an offer filter on the held keys, built like `party`).

## Engine work

- New `when: 'castUltimate'`: fired when the holder's `ultimate`-key ability fires (`abilityPowers.trigger('press', …)` for a power whose ability has `key: 'ultimate'`, after the press is accepted), with no enemy needed (`ctx`: `{}`; not in `ON_ENEMY`).
- New `then: 'refillKeys'`, a perk (`ABILITY_PERKS`): for each of `strike`, `guard` and `summon` the holder holds, set its charge to at least `share` of that ability's `charge` (never lower). `ABILITY_POWERS['castUltimate/refillKeys'] = ['share']`. The Ultimate's own key is spent as usual.
- Order: the refill lands 0.3 s after the press (as the threads reach the caps), so the strike key can't fire in the same frame as the Ultimate and the four stay a sequence.
- `validate.js`: `refillKeys` needs `share` (a share, above 0 and at most 1).

## Multiplayer

The server already counts every key's charge and accepted the Ultimate's press itself, so it fires the refill on its own count (no new claim) and sends it in the `abilityPower` event; the browser sets its caps from it. Holder only: a teammate's keys are never touched. One holder per team.

## Effect

Timed from the Ultimate's press (t = 0; the Ultimate's own effect plays as usual):

| t | Layer | Look | Colour |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0.00-0.20 | Anticipation | The Ultimate's own cast pose; a ring of ember light gathers round the holder's waist | `#e59a5c` ring |
| 0.20-0.30 | Split | The ring tears into three ember threads (flat ribbons, white-hot core, black ink edge) that whip up and wrap round the holder's arms and blade | `#fff3dc` core, `#e59a5c` edge, `#0b0b0f` ink |
| 0.30 | Peak (keys full) | The threads sink in; the holder's silhouette flares with an ember rim for a breath; on the HUD three threads slam into key caps 1-3 and each fills in one sweep with a short ember ring. No impact frame: the Ultimate's is the moment's one | `#e59a5c` rim, `#fff3dc` cap sweep |
| 0.30-1.20 | Fade | The rim fades from the hands up; caps 1-3 keep a thin ember edge until each is pressed | `#e59a5c` to transparent |

Budget (Legendary class, kept small to sit inside the Ultimate's): 3 pooled meshes (waist ring, the three threads as one ribbon mesh, rim shell) + 18 sparks off the threads (10 on Normal), no effect light (the Ultimate owns both), 1 ribbon (the threads), no impact frame of its own. Peak 0.1 s, on the holder, never near the boss's weapon. Reduced motion: the rim fades in over 0.2 s instead of flaring; the HUD sweep stays.

## Sound

New `abilityFourfold`: under the Ultimate's own cast, three short rising tones landing one after another at 0.30 s, 0.35 s and 0.40 s (sine at 392, 494 and 587 Hz, 0.15 s each, a soft click on each attack) that ring together as a chord (0.6 s, light reverb): the three keys catching.

## Camera

No kick of its own: the Ultimate's is the moment.

## Images

- `img/fourfold-1.webp`: the swordsman firing a huge technique while three ember orange threads of light split off from it and wrap around their arms, ready for the next three techniques.
- `img/fourfold-2.webp`: four techniques chained back to back: a strike, a guard, a summon and an ultimate in one sweeping panel.

pool.md:
# Shade Host

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Id | `shade-host` |
| Rarity | Legendary (ember orange `#e59a5c`), 1 level |
| Kind | Triggered (no key) |
| Trigger | `dodge`: a perfect dodge (2 s cooldown) |
| Origin | New |

## Card

**Perfect dodge: a shadow clone joins for {time}.** (8 words, 42 chars)

- Icon (48×48 line drawing): three hooded figures in a fan, the front one solid, the two behind drawn as ink outlines with two small dots for eyes.
- Hover loop (2.0 s): a small figure sidesteps a falling blow (0.2 s); its afterimage stays behind, darkens to ink and steps out as a clone, the brighter frame as its eyes light (0.3 s); a second dodge, a second clone (0.4 s); figure and clones strike the boss together from three sides (0.7 s); the first clone splashes into ink (0.4 s).

## Idea

Every perfect dodge leaves something behind: the afterimage you dodged out of darkens to black ink, opens two ember eyes and steps out to fight beside you for six seconds, copying your blows from its own side of the boss. Dodge well three times and you fight as four. It is the army technique, built on the hardest defensive timing, so the clones come in the middle of a good exchange and leave when it ends.

## Data

```js
{ id: 'shade-host', name: 'Shade Host', rarity: 'legendary',
  text: 'Perfect dodge: a shadow clone joins for {time}.',
  power: { when: 'dodge', then: 'shadeClone' },
  levels: [
    { time: 6, share: 0.35, most: 3, cooldown: 2 },
  ] },
```

Numbers: each clone echoes `share` of every blow the holder lands; three out at once is 1.05, so the holder hits twice as hard. A skilled player lands about 30 a second in an open exchange and keeps one or two clones out about half the fight: 30 × 0.35 × 1.5 × 45 s = about 700 in a 90 s fight, up to about 1000 for a player who perfect-dodges every two or three seconds. On the bar, and scaled by the hardest timing in the game. The clones draw nothing: the boss keeps its target.

## Engine work

- New `dodge/shadeClone`: `['time', 'share', 'most', 'cooldown']`, a summon of a new kind, `shade`, run by `summonStep` like the twin and echoing like it (`echo`, a power's blow: it never counts toward `hits`, a counter or a crack, and sets off no power).
- A host, not one body: the holder's summon slot holds one `shade` entry with up to `most` clones, each with its own `until`. A perfect dodge with `most` out renews the oldest one's `until` instead of adding one. The slot rule stands: while a host is out, another kind's call waits (and a twin out keeps the host waiting); the host counts as the holder's one summon.
- Places: `CONFIG.abilities.summons.shade = { gap: 1.0, flanks: [1.3, -1.3, 3.14], speed: 18, height: 1.8 }`, clone n standing at `flanks[n]` rad round from the holder's side, so the first two pincer and the third comes from behind. `summonStep` takes `flanks[n]` where a kind has `flanks` (its one `flank` otherwise).
- A clone appears where the dodge happened (the afterimage, `js/afterimage.js`) and flash-steps to its place at `speed`.
- `validate.js`: `shadeClone` needs `time`, `share` (a share), `most` (a whole number 1-4) and `cooldown`.

## Multiplayer

The client claims `dodge` (it already does); the server checks it against the attack it knows and the cooldown, adds the clone and resolves each echo on its own enemy. Clones fight only enemies, have no collision with players, draw nothing and revive no one. One summon slot per player, so a party of four has at most twelve clones, each only echoing its own holder. One holder per team.

## Model

`tools/blender/shade_clone.py`: the holder's silhouette in black ink: a hooded swordsman about 1.8 m tall with a scarf and a round shield, built as flat brush-ink planes over a simple body (the hood, coat tails and scarf end in dry-brush splits), two ember points for eyes and an ember rim on the blade and shield edge. Its skeleton matches the player rig's bone names, so the player's attack clips play on it unchanged (mirrored for clones facing the holder). About 2.5k triangles. Material: flat ink black `#0b0b0f` with a 15% inner ink-wash gradient, an emissive ember rim map, eyes `#fff3dc` over `#e59a5c`. Animations: `step-out` (from the afterimage pose, ink drips upward into the shape, 0.3 s), every attack clip of the player (shared), `idle` (a low stance, the coat tails drifting like ink in water), `splash` (it collapses into an ink splash from the feet up, 0.4 s). Baked to `js/baked/`; twelve in the pool (three a player), warmed at load. Seen in the game beside the player before it ships.

## Effect

Timed from the perfect dodge (t = 0):

| t | Layer | Look | Colour |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0.00-0.15 | Anticipation | The dodge's own slow beat; the afterimage left behind stays, darkening from its edges inward to ink | `#0b0b0f`, `#e59a5c` edge |
| 0.15 | Peak (eyes open) | The ink figure's eyes light ember and white; a ring of ink splashes out from its feet. **The impact frame**, only for the first clone of a host (the others get the ring alone) | `#fff3dc` eyes, `#e59a5c` iris, `#0b0b0f` ink |
| 0.15-0.45 | Step | It flash-steps to its place round the boss: a brush smear of ink along its path with speed lines | `#0b0b0f` smear, `#e59a5c` fringe |
| 0.45-6.15 | Fight | Each blow the holder lands, every clone lands 0.08 s later from its side, an ink slash with an ember edge on its cut line | `#0b0b0f` slash, `#e59a5c` edge |
| 5.75-6.15 | Splash | The clone collapses into an ink splash that soaks into the floor; the eyes go last | `#0b0b0f` to transparent |

Budget (Legendary class at the first step-out, summon after): the step-out 4 pooled meshes (the clone model, afterimage shell, ink ring, smear) + 30 ink drops (17 on Normal), 1 effect light (the eyes' glow at step-out; × 0.65 on Normal), 1 impact frame per host. While they fight: up to 3 models + 2 meshes (a pooled slash head and the splash), 8 ink motes a clone (24 at most, 13 on Normal), no light (ink casts none; the ember rims are emissive), 1 ribbon shared by the clones' blade trails. Clones stand at the boss's sides and back, never between the camera and its weapon; a clone within 1.5 m of the weapon during a wind-up goes 50% translucent. Reduced motion: the impact frame becomes a 30% darken, no shake, the smear holds still.

## Sound

New `abilityShade`: at the eyes opening a wet ink drop (sine 900 to 300 Hz, 60 ms) and a low breath (band-passed noise at 300 Hz, 0.3 s); the step a brush whip (band-passed noise 1.5 to 4 kHz, 0.1 s). `abilityEcho` kept for each clone's blow, softer (gain × 0.6) and jittered so three clones don't sound as one. The splash: a soft liquid collapse (low-passed noise falling from 1.2 kHz to 200 Hz, 0.4 s).

## Camera

`CONFIG.camera.feel.powers.shadeClone = [1.4, 0.03]` at the first clone of a host only; `echo = [-0.6, 0.02]` is not used for clones (three would shake the view).

## Images

- `img/shade-host-1.webp`: three black ink shadow clones of the swordsman with ember orange eyes and rims surrounding a boss and attacking with the real swordsman.
- `img/shade-host-2.webp`: a shadow clone stepping out of the swordsman's afterimage after a perfect dodge.

pool.md:
# Scarlet Draw

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Id | `scarlet-draw` |
| Rarity | Story (scarf crimson `#b3262e`, oath gold `#e8c46a`), 1 level, never offered in a pick |
| Kind | Key 1, Strike, kept for good |
| Trigger | `press`: key 1 with its charge full (14 points) |
| Origin | New |
| Given | Chapter 2, The Sunken Keep, the Seven's oath hall |

## Card

**Your scarf lashes out as a blade.** (7 words, 33 chars)

- Icon (48×48 line drawing): a hooded head and shoulders in profile, the scarf's tail streaming forward from the neck in one long S-curve that ends in a blade point.
- Hover loop (1.8 s): the key cap "1" lights crimson (0.2 s); a small figure stands still and its scarf lifts in a wind from nowhere (0.4 s); the scarf unrolls forward in an S-curve through a boss silhouette, a gold edge along it (0.3 s); the cut line hangs crimson, then opens, the brighter frame (0.2 s); the scarf curls back to the neck (0.7 s).

## Idea

The prisoner's red scarf is the one thing they woke with, and in the hall where kings swore the Oath it turns out to know something its wearer doesn't: pressed, it streams out twelve metres as a crimson ribbon blade edged in gold, draws through everything in front in one flowing S-curve, and curls back. The hands keep the sword and the shield; the scarf does the cutting. It is the first gift of the road and the plainest key-1 strike in the game, made strange by where it comes from.

## Where it's given

The first time the player crosses into the oath hall of the Sunken Keep, a wind with no source moves through the hall and lifts the red scarf, and the key 1 cap lights crimson with the ability's name under it, already full. Nothing pauses, the camera stays the player's, and no one speaks: the scarf settles and the player walks on into whatever waits in the hall. The hall's fight is the first place to press it. A player who has been here before (a load or a second run of the story) already holds it, and the wind still moves the scarf as they enter.

## Data

```js
{ id: 'scarlet-draw', name: 'Scarlet Draw', rarity: 'story', key: 'strike',
  story: { chapter: 2, place: "The Sunken Keep, the Seven's oath hall" },
  text: 'Your scarf lashes out as a blade.',
  power: { when: 'press', then: 'scarfBlade' },
  levels: [
    { charge: 14, damage: 120, reach: 12 },
  ] },
```

Numbers: 120 a press for 14 points is 8.6 a point, just over the legendary floor (Thunder Call's 8.4), and every enemy in the 12 m band takes it, not only the boss. Key 1 fills about every 14 s, so six presses in a 90 s fight: about 720 on a boss of 1600-3500 health, a quarter to a third of its bar. Strong enough to turn a fight, never to end one, which is the bar Story's four share.

## Engine work

- New `press/scarfBlade`: `['charge', 'damage', 'reach']`, in `ON_ENEMY` (aimed at the locked enemy, else the nearest within `CONFIG.abilities.press.range`; with none, straight ahead).
- The hit is a band `reach` m long and `CONFIG.abilities.powers.scarfBlade.width` = 1.6 m wide from the holder toward the target (the S-curve is the look; the band is straight), resolved as the line opens, 0.55 s after the press: `damage` to every enemy in it as a power's blow (it never counts toward `hits`, a counter or a crack, and sets off no power). The same line hit as Riptide's and Tidal Arc's `wave`.
- New rarity `story` (`CONFIG.abilities.rarity.story = { levels: 1, weight: 0 }`): never offered in a pick, never in Boss Rush. A story ability carries `story: { chapter, place }` and is given by its level (below). `validate.js`: a `story` ability names one key and a `story` with a chapter and a place, and its key has no other story ability; the key rule ("key ultimate is a legendary's, strike, guard and summon a rare's") and the power rule ("a rare or a legendary") both let a `story` ability through, and the offer-count check skips `story` (it is never offered).
- Given: a level opts in with `giveAbility: { id: 'scarlet-draw', trigger: [x0, x1, z0, z1] }` (the oath hall's entrance), run by `Game.updateLevel` like a flask find: the first time the player is inside the rectangle, the ability goes to the story save's owned list (`CONFIG.story.saveVersion` bumps for the new field) with its key's charge full, and the HUD's key cap plays its light-up. No pause, no camera, no input taken.
- Drawing: the ribbon blade is anchored at the scarf's knot on the player model; the scarf's tail mesh hides while the ribbon is out and shows again as it curls back.

## Multiplayer

The press is checked by the server as every press is (its own charge count, range); the server resolves the band on its own enemies. Enemies only: the ribbon passes through a teammate. Played together, every player in the party is given the scarf's gift when they first enter the hall, each their own, so the four keys stay per player. The wind and the scarf lifting are drawn only for the player it lifts.

## Effect

Timed from the press (t = 0):

| t | Layer | Look | Colour |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0.00-0.40 | Anticipation | The holder keeps moving; the scarf lifts and streams forward on a wind no one else feels; a few grey ash flakes around the holder blow the same way; the world dims 20% | `#b3262e` scarf, `#5a5550` ash |
| 0.40-0.55 | Release | The scarf unrolls into a ribbon blade 12 m long in a flowing S-curve through the target, flat crimson with a hard oath-gold edge and a black ink outline, its tip a blade point; a thin gold speed line follows the tip | `#b3262e` body, `#e8c46a` edge, `#0b0b0f` ink |
| 0.40-0.55 | Cut line | Where the ribbon passed, a straight cut line hangs in the air through every enemy in the band, glowing crimson | `#b3262e` line, `#fff3dc` core |
| 0.55 | Peak (the line opens) | The line opens; every enemy in the band takes the cut; 30 crimson and gold shards burst along it like torn cloth. **The impact frame**, two-tone ink and white with the crimson kept | `#fff3dc`, `#b3262e`, `#e8c46a` |
| 0.55-1.40 | Return | The ribbon curls back along its own S in a long flowing arc and winds onto the neck; gold threads drift off its edge | `#b3262e`, `#e8c46a` threads |
| 1.40-2.00 | Fade | The threads and shards fade; the scarf hangs still | to transparent |

Budget (Story class): 5 pooled meshes (the ribbon, cut line, shard sheet, speed line, the scarf tail's hide swap) + 30 shards + 20 gold threads + 12 ash = 62 particles (34 on Normal), 1 effect light (crimson-gold along the ribbon, steady through its 1 s out; × 0.65 on Normal), 2 ribbons (the blade and its gold speed line), 1 impact frame at t = 0.55. Peak 0.15 s. The ribbon crosses the boss at chest height and is 35% translucent within 2 m of the boss's weapon during a wind-up. Reduced motion: the impact frame becomes a 30% darken, no shake, the speed line holds still.

## Sound

New `abilityScarf`: during the anticipation a rising wind with cloth flutter in it (band-passed noise 400 Hz to 2 kHz rising over 0.4 s, amplitude-modulated at 14 Hz); at the release a long cloth whip (noise sweep 3 kHz to 600 Hz, 0.15 s) with a thin steel ring on top (sine partials at 1760 and 2640 Hz, 0.3 s); at the opening a tearing cut (white noise high-passed at 2 kHz, 40 ms) over a soft low thud (sine 80 Hz, 0.2 s). Tail: the wind dropping away (0.6 s).

## Camera

`CONFIG.camera.feel.powers.scarfBlade = [-1.6, 0.05]` at the opening. The press itself never moves the view.

## Images

- `img/scarlet-draw-1.webp`: the swordsman's red scarf unrolling into a twelve-metre crimson ribbon blade edged with ember gold, cutting through a boss in a flowing S-curve, in an ancient sunken hall.
- `img/scarlet-draw-2.webp`: close on the red scarf lifting in a wind from nowhere in a dark stone oath hall, the prisoner's face hidden.
- `img/scarlet-draw-3.webp`: the crimson ribbon blade wrapping around the boss in a spiral before tightening into the cut.

pool.md:
# Oath Guard

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Id | `oath-guard` |
| Rarity | Story (scarf crimson `#b3262e`, oath gold `#e8c46a`), 1 level, never offered in a pick |
| Kind | Key 2, Guard, kept for good |
| Trigger | `press`: key 2 with its charge full (16 points) |
| Origin | New |
| Given | Chapter 5, The Final Castle's chapel, the defaced statue |

## Card

**A great shield turns and answers every blow.** (8 words, 44 chars)

- Icon (48×48 line drawing): a large round shield seen face-on, a small boss in its centre, a ring of short dashes round the rim, one curved arrow bouncing off its edge.
- Hover loop (2.0 s): the key cap "2" lights crimson (0.2 s); a small figure raises its round shield and a great shield of light blooms round it, the brighter frame (0.3 s); three blows fall from different sides and the shield turns to meet each, a gold ring off each one (0.9 s); the shield bashes forward once (0.2 s); it folds back into the small one (0.4 s).

## Idea

The prisoner's round shield blooms into a great round shield of red-gold light, three times their height, with a worn boss in its centre and a ring of old script round its rim. For three seconds it turns by itself to meet every blow, from any side, and answers each one with a bash. The player doesn't time anything: they press it when the boss starts a string, and the string becomes the boss's punishment. The last fight's opponent turns blows in much the same way, and the player is left to make of that what they will.

## Where it's given

In the castle chapel the defaced statue stands: hooded, a round shield, a scarf painted red, its face struck off. When the player first walks within a few metres of it, their own round shield answers the stone one: a faint ring of red-gold light runs once round its rim, and the key 2 cap lights crimson with the ability's name, already full. Nothing pauses, the camera stays free, the statue does not move and no one speaks. The plinth's inscription can still be read with Talk, as before.

## Data

```js
{ id: 'oath-guard', name: 'Oath Guard', rarity: 'story', key: 'guard',
  story: { chapter: 5, place: "The Final Castle's chapel, the defaced statue" },
  text: 'A great shield turns and answers every blow.',
  power: { when: 'press', then: 'oathShield' },
  levels: [
    { charge: 16, time: 3, damage: 40 },
  ] },
```

Numbers: a boss string runs 3-5 blows in 2-3 s, so a press at its start turns the whole string: 3-5 bashes of 40 (120-200), the string's damage never taken, and a riposte after the last turned blow (about 40), so 160-240 for 16 points, 10-15 a point, above the floor (8.4). Pressed into nothing it does nothing, so its worth is the read. Key 2 fills about every 16 s: five or six presses a fight.

## Engine work

- New `press/oathShield`: `['charge', 'time', 'damage']`, a timer on the holder (`perk.oath`, like `perk.stance`), not on an enemy.
- While it runs, every blow a deflect could turn is deflected whatever its side and the player's timing (Iron Stance's `canDeflectNow` path, plus any facing: the shield turns to the blow). Each turned blow is a deflect for the boss's posture and the last-blow riposte, and sends `damage` back to the attacker as a power's blow (it never counts toward `hits` or a crack, and sets off no power). Grabs and floor fire are not blows and still land.
- As with Iron Stance, a deflect made only because `perk.oath > 0` gives no points to the `guard` key (the other keys still fill).
- Given by the level as Scarlet Draw is: `giveAbility: { id: 'oath-guard', trigger: [...] }` round the statue in the chapel (`js/levels/final-castle.js`).
- `validate.js`: `oathShield` needs `charge`, `time` and `damage`.

## Multiplayer

The shield is its holder's own defence (the client owns it). The server knows it from the press it accepted, so for `time` s plus its slack it takes the holder's untimed deflect claims from any side, range- and rate-checking each against the boss's live blow, and resolves each bash on its own enemy. It shelters the holder only: a teammate standing behind it is not covered, and its bash never touches a player. Played together, each player is given it at the statue.

## Effect

Timed from the press (t = 0):

| t | Layer | Look | Colour |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0.00-0.40 | Anticipation | Upper-body pose: the round shield raised before the chest, held; a ring of old script strokes (shapes only, no letters) lights round its rim one stroke at a time; the world dims 20% | `#e8c46a` strokes, `#b3262e` rim |
| 0.40 | Peak (the bloom) | The shield blooms into a great round shield of translucent light 2.6 m across, a worn boss in its centre and the script ring round its rim; a ring of 24 gold shards bursts out from its edge. **The impact frame**, ink and white with crimson and gold kept | `#b3262e` face at 40%, `#e8c46a` rim and boss, `#0b0b0f` ink outline |
| 0.40-3.40 | Guard | The great shield hovers round the holder and turns to face each blow in 0.08 s; each turned blow throws a flat red-gold shock ring off its face and 10 hard sparks, and the shield bashes forward 1 m and back; the script ring turns slowly the whole time | `#e8c46a` ring, `#fff3dc` sparks, `#b3262e` face |
| 3.10-3.40 | Strain | The face's translucency thins and the script ring's strokes go out one by one | `#e8c46a` to `#5a5550` |
| 3.40-4.40 | Fade | The great shield folds back into the round one on the arm; a last thin gold ring runs round its rim | to transparent |

Budget (Story class): 6 pooled meshes (shield face, script ring, centre boss, shock ring reused, shard sheet, small rim ring) + 24 shards + 10 sparks a turned blow (at most 54 alive with three turns in a second; 30 on Normal) + 16 gold motes, 1 effect light (on the shield's face, steady through the guard: the shocks never pulse it, so three turns a second stay well under 3 Hz; × 0.65 on Normal), 1 ribbon (the bash's arc), 1 impact frame at the bloom. Peak 0.2 s. The shield sits between the holder and the blow, never between the camera and the boss's weapon: within 2 m of the weapon during a wind-up its face drops to 15% so the tell reads through it. Reduced motion: the impact frame becomes a 30% darken, no shake, the shield turns without a motion smear.

## Sound

New `abilityOath`: during the anticipation a low choir-like hum rising (sine partials at 110, 165 and 220 Hz, 0.4 s swell); at the bloom a deep struck metal (sine partials at 98, 270 and 530 Hz, 1.5 s decay, a short bright click on the attack) with a low boom (sine 45 Hz, 0.4 s). Each turned blow: the game's deflect sound plus a short gong (sine partials at 196 and 520 Hz, 0.5 s) and a bash thud (sine 70 Hz, 0.12 s). Tail: the hum falling a fourth as it folds.

## Camera

`CONFIG.camera.feel.powers.oathShield = [-1.2, 0.04]` at the bloom; each turned blow keeps the deflect's own feel, nothing added.

## Images

- `img/oath-guard-1.webp`: the swordsman's round shield blooming into a huge translucent round shield of red-gold light with an oath ring of old script around its rim, turning a boss blow into a shockwave.
- `img/oath-guard-2.webp`: a defaced stone statue of a hooded champion with a round shield and a red-painted scarf in a dark castle chapel, the prisoner standing before it.
- `img/oath-guard-3.webp`: the great shield bashing forward into the boss with a red-gold shock ring.
